name: DescriptiveSetTheoryTest.constructionRank_complementTower
statement:
private theorem constructionRank_complementTower (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] (n : ℕ) :
    (complementTower X n).constructionRank = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      change GeneratedCode.constructionRank
        (GeneratedCode.empty : GeneratedCode (openGenerator X)) = 0
      rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      change GeneratedCode.constructionRank (GeneratedCode.compl (complementTower X n)) =
        (n : Ordinal) + 1
      rw [GeneratedCode.constructionRank_compl, ih]

name: DescriptiveSetTheoryTest.analyticSet_univ_cantor
statement:
private theorem analyticSet_univ_cantor :
    MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (univ : Set (ℕ → Bool))
proof:
:= by
  rw [MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet]
  exact Or.inr ⟨baireToCantor, continuous_baireToCantor,
    Set.range_eq_univ.mpr surjective_baireToCantor⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheoryTest.analyticSet_univ_baire

name: DescriptiveSetTheoryTest.not_countable_univ_cantor
statement:
private theorem not_countable_univ_cantor :
    ¬(univ : Set (ℕ → Bool)).Countable
proof:
:= by
  intro hcount
  rcases hcount.exists_eq_range univ_nonempty with ⟨g, hg⟩
  let diagonal : ℕ → Bool := fun n => !(g n n)
  have hd : diagonal ∈ range g := by rw [← hg]; exact mem_univ _
  rcases hd with ⟨n, hn⟩
  have hcoordinate := congrFun hn n
  cases h : g n n <;> simp [diagonal, h] at hcoordinate

name: DescriptiveSetTheoryTest.not_countable_univ_baire
statement:
private theorem not_countable_univ_baire :
    ¬(univ : Set (ℕ → ℕ)).Countable
proof:
:= by
  intro hcount
  rcases hcount.exists_eq_range univ_nonempty with ⟨g, hg⟩
  let diagonal : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => g n n + 1
  have hd : diagonal ∈ range g := by rw [← hg]; exact mem_univ _
  rcases hd with ⟨n, hn⟩
  have hcoordinate := congrFun hn n
  change g n n = g n n + 1 at hcoordinate
  exact (Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self (g n n))) hcoordinate

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.take_initialSegment
statement:
private theorem take_initialSegment {A : Type*} (x : ℕ → A) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    (initialSegment x n).take m = initialSegment x m
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp [length_initialSegment, hmn]
  · intro i hi₁ hi₂
    simp [initialSegment]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.initialSegment_prefix
statement:
theorem initialSegment_prefix {A : Type*} (x : ℕ → A) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    initialSegment x m <+: initialSegment x n
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.prefix_iff_eq_take, length_initialSegment]
  exact (take_initialSegment x hmn).symm

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.BinarySplittingSystem.branchMap_apply_eq_getElem_node
proof:
:= by
  have hdepth := S.depth_le_node_length (initialSegment q (i + 1))
  have hib : i < (S.node (initialSegment q (i + 1))).length := by
    exact (Nat.lt_succ_self i).trans_le (by simpa using hdepth)
  rw [branchMap, List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hib]
  rcases le_total m (i + 1) with hmi | him
  · exact (S.node_prefix_of_prefix (initialSegment_prefix q hmi)).getElem hi |>.symm
  · exact (S.node_prefix_of_prefix (initialSegment_prefix q him)).getElem hib

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.BinarySplittingSystem.node_eq_initialSegment_branchMap
statement:
theorem node_eq_initialSegment_branchMap (q : ℕ → Bool) (m : ℕ) :
    S.node (initialSegment q m) =
      initialSegment (S.branchMap q) (S.node (initialSegment q m)).length
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp [length_initialSegment]
  · intro i hi₁ hi₂
    simpa [initialSegment] using (S.branchMap_apply_eq_getElem_node q m hi₁).symm

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.BinarySplittingSystem.initialSegment_branchMap_eq_take
statement:
theorem initialSegment_branchMap_eq_take (q : ℕ → Bool) (m : ℕ) :
    initialSegment (S.branchMap q) m = (S.node (initialSegment q m)).take m
proof:
:= by
  have hdepth : m ≤ (S.node (initialSegment q m)).length := by
    simpa using S.depth_le_node_length (initialSegment q m)
  calc
    initialSegment (S.branchMap q) m =
        (initialSegment (S.branchMap q) (S.node (initialSegment q m)).length).take m :=
      (take_initialSegment (S.branchMap q) hdepth).symm
    _ = (S.node (initialSegment q m)).take m := by
      rw [← S.node_eq_initialSegment_branchMap q m]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.BinarySplittingSystem.branchMap_mem_body
statement: theorem branchMap_mem_body (q : ℕ → Bool) : S.branchMap q ∈ body T
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  rw [S.initialSegment_branchMap_eq_take q m]
  exact Descriptive.Tree.take_mem ⟨S.node (initialSegment q m), S.node_mem _⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.BinarySplittingSystem.range_branchMap_subset_body
statement: theorem range_branchMap_subset_body : range S.branchMap ⊆ body T
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨q, rfl⟩
  exact S.branchMap_mem_body q

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.BinarySplittingSystem.continuous_branchMap
statement: theorem continuous_branchMap : Continuous S.branchMap
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_pi
  intro n
  change Continuous ((fun r : Fin (n + 1) → Bool =>
      (S.node (List.ofFn r)).getD n 0) ∘
    (fun q : ℕ → Bool => fun i : Fin (n + 1) => q i))
  exact continuous_of_discreteTopology.comp
    (continuous_pi fun i => continuous_apply (i : ℕ))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.BinarySplittingSystem.initialSegments_comparable
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total m n with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (initialSegment_prefix x h)
  · exact Or.inr (initialSegment_prefix x h)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.BinarySplittingSystem.injective_branchMap
statement: theorem injective_branchMap : Function.Injective S.branchMap
proof:
:= by
  intro q r hqr
  have hsegments : ∀ n, initialSegment q n = initialSegment r n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
        have hbit : q n = r n := by
          by_contra hbit
          have hinc := S.children_incompatible_of_ne (initialSegment q n) hbit
          have hqnode := S.node_eq_initialSegment_branchMap q (n + 1)
          have hrnode := S.node_eq_initialSegment_branchMap r (n + 1)
          rw [initialSegment_succ] at hqnode
          rw [initialSegment_succ, ← ih] at hrnode
          have hcomp :
              S.node (initialSegment q n ++ [q n]) <+:
                  S.node (initialSegment q n ++ [r n]) ∨
                S.node (initialSegment q n ++ [r n]) <+:
                  S.node (initialSegment q n ++ [q n]) := by
            rw [hqnode, hrnode, hqr]
            exact initialSegments_comparable _ _ _
          exact hcomp.elim hinc.1 hinc.2
        simp [initialSegment_succ, ih, hbit]
  funext n
  have h := hsegments (n + 1)
  rw [initialSegment_succ, initialSegment_succ, hsegments n] at h
  simpa using List.append_cancel_left h

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.BinarySplittingSystem.isClosedEmbedding_branchMap
statement: theorem isClosedEmbedding_branchMap : IsClosedEmbedding S.branchMap
proof:

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.nodeRankLT_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem nodeRankLT_zero (s : List ℕ) : nodeRankLT 0 s = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  simp [nodeRankLT]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.nodeRankLT_mono
statement:
theorem nodeRankLT_mono {i j : Ordinal.{0}} (hij : i ≤ j) (s : List ℕ) :
    nodeRankLT i s ⊆ nodeRankLT j s
proof:
:= by
  rintro c ⟨hs, h, hrank⟩
  exact ⟨hs, h, hrank.trans_le hij⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.nodeRankLT_succ
statement:
theorem nodeRankLT_succ (i : Ordinal.{0}) (s : List ℕ) :
    nodeRankLT (Order.succ i) s =
      {c | s ∈ decodeTree c} ∩
        ⋂ a : ℕ, ({c | s ++ [a] ∉ decodeTree c} ∪ nodeRankLT i (s ++ [a]))
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hs, h, hrank⟩
    refine ⟨hs, Set.mem_iInter.2 fun a => ?_⟩
    by_cases hchild : s ++ [a] ∈ decodeTree c
    · refine Or.inr ⟨hchild, h.inv ⟨a, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      exact (Acc.rank_lt_of_rel h ⟨a, rfl⟩).trans_le (Order.lt_succ_iff.mp hrank)
    · exact Or.inl hchild
  · rintro ⟨hs, hall⟩
    have hchild : ∀ (a : ℕ) (ha : s ++ [a] ∈ decodeTree c),
        ∃ h : Acc (Child (decodeTree c))
            (⟨s ++ [a], ha⟩ : decodeTree c), h.rank < i := by
      intro a ha
      rcases Set.mem_iInter.1 hall a with hmissing | hstage
      · exact (hmissing ha).elim
      · rcases hstage with ⟨_, h, hrank⟩
        exact ⟨h, hrank⟩
    let hroot : Acc (Child (decodeTree c)) (⟨s, hs⟩ : decodeTree c) :=
      Acc.intro _ fun t ht => by
        obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ht
        have hmem : s ++ [a] ∈ decodeTree c := by
          rw [← ha]
          exact t.property
        obtain ⟨h, _⟩ := hchild a hmem
        have htEq : t = (⟨s ++ [a], hmem⟩ : decodeTree c) := Subtype.ext ha
        simpa [htEq] using h
    refine ⟨hs, hroot, Order.lt_succ_iff.mpr ?_⟩
    rw [hroot.rank_eq]
    refine Ordinal.iSup_le fun t => ?_
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := t.property
    have hmem : s ++ [a] ∈ decodeTree c := by
      rw [← ha]
      exact t.1.property
    obtain ⟨h, hrank⟩ := hchild a hmem
    have htEq : t.1 = (⟨s ++ [a], hmem⟩ : decodeTree c) := Subtype.ext ha
    have h' : Acc (Child (decodeTree c)) t.1 := by
      simpa [htEq] using h
    have hrank' : h'.rank < i := by
      simpa [htEq] using hrank
    rw [Subsingleton.elim (hroot.inv t.property) h']
    exact Order.succ_le_iff.mpr hrank'

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.nodeRankLT_limit
statement:
theorem nodeRankLT_limit {i : Ordinal.{0}} (hi : Order.IsSuccLimit i) (s : List ℕ) :
    nodeRankLT i s = ⋃ j : Set.Iio i, nodeRankLT j.1 s
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hs, h, hrank⟩
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨Order.succ h.rank, hi.succ_lt hrank⟩, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨hs, h, Order.lt_succ h.rank⟩
  · intro hc
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.1 hc with ⟨j, hs, h, hrank⟩
    exact ⟨hs, h, hrank.trans j.property⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.isClopen_nodeMem
statement: theorem isClopen_nodeMem (s : List ℕ) : IsClopen {c : TreeCode | s ∈ decodeTree c}
proof:
:= by
  have hcontinuous : Continuous (fun c : TreeCode => c.1 s) :=
    (continuous_listNatBoolCoordinate s).comp continuous_subtype_val
  have heq : {c : TreeCode | s ∈ decodeTree c} =
      (fun c : TreeCode => c.1 s) ⁻¹' ({true} : Set Bool) := by
    ext c
    simp
  rw [heq]
  exact (isClopen_discrete ({true} : Set Bool)).preimage hcontinuous

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.borelMeasurableSet_nodeRankLT
statement:
theorem borelMeasurableSet_nodeRankLT {i : Ordinal.{0}} (hi : IsCountableBorelLevel i)
    (s : List ℕ) : @MeasurableSet TreeCode (borel TreeCode) (nodeRankLT i s)
proof:
:= by
  induction i using WellFoundedLT.induction generalizing s with
  | ind i ih =>
      rcases Ordinal.zero_or_succ_or_isSuccLimit i with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩ | hlim
      · simp
      · rw [nodeRankLT_succ]
        have hnode : @MeasurableSet TreeCode (borel TreeCode)
            {c | s ∈ decodeTree c} :=
          MeasurableSpace.GenerateMeasurable.basic _ (isClopen_nodeMem s).isOpen
        refine hnode.inter (MeasurableSet.iInter fun a => ?_)
        have hchild : @MeasurableSet TreeCode (borel TreeCode)
            {c | s ++ [a] ∈ decodeTree c} :=
          MeasurableSpace.GenerateMeasurable.basic _ (isClopen_nodeMem (s ++ [a])).isOpen
        exact hchild.compl.union
          (ih j (Order.lt_succ j) ((Order.lt_succ j).trans hi) (s ++ [a]))
      · letI : Countable (Set.Iio i) := countable_Iio_of_isCountableBorelLevel hi
        rw [nodeRankLT_limit hlim]
        exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun j => ih j.1 j.2 (j.2.trans hi) s

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.acc_of_root
proof:
:= by
  induction s using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => simpa using hacc
  | append_singleton s a ih =>
      exact (ih (T.property hs)).inv ⟨a, rfl⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.nodeRank_eq_accRank
statement:
private theorem nodeRank_eq_accRank {T : Descriptive.tree ℕ} (hT : IsWellFounded T)
    (s : T) (hacc : Acc (Child T) s) : nodeRank hT s = hacc.rank
proof:
:= by
  letI : _root_.IsWellFounded T (Child T) := ⟨hT⟩
  unfold nodeRank _root_.IsWellFounded.rank
  rw [Subsingleton.elim (_root_.IsWellFounded.apply (Child T) s) hacc]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.acc_root_iff_isWellFounded
statement:
theorem acc_root_iff_isWellFounded {T : Descriptive.tree ℕ} (hroot : [] ∈ T) :
    Acc (Child T) (⟨[], hroot⟩ : T) ↔ IsWellFounded T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hacc
    change WellFounded (Child T)
    exact WellFounded.intro fun t : T => by
      simpa using acc_of_root hroot hacc t.1 t.2
  · intro hT
    change WellFounded (Child T) at hT
    exact hT.apply (⟨[], hroot⟩ : T)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.mem_treeRankLT
statement:
theorem mem_treeRankLT {i : Ordinal.{0}} {c : TreeCode} :
    c ∈ treeRankLT i ↔
      ∃ hT : IsWellFounded (decodeTree c), rank (decodeTree c) hT < i
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.mem_treeRankLT_succ_iff_le
statement:
theorem mem_treeRankLT_succ_iff_le {i : Ordinal.{0}} {c : TreeCode} :
    c ∈ treeRankLT (Order.succ i) ↔
      ∃ hT : IsWellFounded (decodeTree c), rank (decodeTree c) hT ≤ i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hT, hrank⟩
    exact ⟨hT, Order.lt_succ_iff.mp hrank⟩
  · rintro ⟨hT, hrank⟩
    exact ⟨hT, Order.lt_succ_iff.mpr hrank⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.treeRankLT_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem treeRankLT_zero : treeRankLT 0 = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  simp [treeRankLT]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.treeRankLT_eq_root
statement:
theorem treeRankLT_eq_root {i : Ordinal.{0}} (hi : 0 < i) :
    treeRankLT i = {c | [] ∉ decodeTree c} ∪ nodeRankLT i []
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hT, hrank⟩
    by_cases hroot : [] ∈ decodeTree c
    · have hacc : Acc (Child (decodeTree c)) (⟨[], hroot⟩ : decodeTree c) :=
        (acc_root_iff_isWellFounded hroot).2 hT
      refine Or.inr ⟨hroot, hacc, ?_⟩
      calc
        hacc.rank = nodeRank hT ⟨[], hroot⟩ := (nodeRank_eq_accRank hT _ hacc).symm
        _ = rank (decodeTree c) hT := (rank_eq_nodeRank hT hroot).symm
        _ < i := hrank
    · exact Or.inl hroot
  · rintro (hroot | hstage)
    · have hbot : decodeTree c = ⊥ := Descriptive.Tree.tree_eq_bot.mpr hroot
      have hT : IsWellFounded (decodeTree c) := by
        rw [hbot]
        exact (isWellFounded_iff_body_eq_empty.mpr body_bot)
      refine ⟨hT, ?_⟩
      rw [rank_eq_zero_of_nil_not_mem hT hroot]
      exact hi
    · rcases hstage with ⟨hroot, hacc, hrank⟩
      have hT : IsWellFounded (decodeTree c) :=
        (acc_root_iff_isWellFounded hroot).1 hacc
      refine ⟨hT, ?_⟩
      rw [rank_eq_nodeRank hT hroot]
      rw [nodeRank_eq_accRank hT _ hacc]
      exact hrank

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.treeRankLT_mono
statement:
theorem treeRankLT_mono {i j : Ordinal.{0}} (hij : i ≤ j) :
    treeRankLT i ⊆ treeRankLT j
proof:
:= by
  rintro c ⟨hT, hrank⟩
  exact ⟨hT, hrank.trans_le hij⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.not_mem_treeRankLT_of_not_isWellFounded
statement:
theorem not_mem_treeRankLT_of_not_isWellFounded {i : Ordinal.{0}} {c : TreeCode}
    (hc : ¬IsWellFounded (decodeTree c)) : c ∉ treeRankLT i
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨hT, -⟩
  exact hc hT

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.treeRankLT_succ
statement:
theorem treeRankLT_succ (i : Ordinal.{0}) :
    treeRankLT (Order.succ i) =
      {c | [] ∉ decodeTree c} ∪
        ({c | [] ∈ decodeTree c} ∩
          ⋂ a : ℕ, ({c | [a] ∉ decodeTree c} ∪ nodeRankLT i [a]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [treeRankLT_eq_root (bot_le.trans_lt (Order.lt_succ i)), nodeRankLT_succ]
  rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.treeRankLT_limit
statement:
theorem treeRankLT_limit {i : Ordinal.{0}} (hi : Order.IsSuccLimit i) :
    treeRankLT i = ⋃ j : Set.Iio i, treeRankLT j.1
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hT, hrank⟩
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨Order.succ (rank (decodeTree c) hT), hi.succ_lt hrank⟩, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨hT, Order.lt_succ _⟩
  · intro hc
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.1 hc with ⟨j, hT, hrank⟩
    exact ⟨hT, hrank.trans j.property⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.borelMeasurableSet_treeRankLT
statement:
theorem borelMeasurableSet_treeRankLT {i : Ordinal.{0}} (hi : IsCountableBorelLevel i) :
    @MeasurableSet TreeCode (borel TreeCode) (treeRankLT i)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    simp
  · rw [treeRankLT_eq_root (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hi0)]
    have hroot : @MeasurableSet TreeCode (borel TreeCode)
        {c | [] ∈ decodeTree c} :=
      MeasurableSpace.GenerateMeasurable.basic _ (isClopen_nodeMem []).isOpen
    exact hroot.compl.union (borelMeasurableSet_nodeRankLT hi [])

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.exists_borelCode_treeRankLT
statement:
theorem exists_borelCode_treeRankLT {i : Ordinal.{0}} (hi : IsCountableBorelLevel i) :
    ∃ c : BorelCode TreeCode, c.eval = treeRankLT i
proof:
:=
  BorelCode.borelMeasurableSet_iff_exists_code.mp (borelMeasurableSet_treeRankLT hi)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.isClopen_relationCoordinate
statement:
private theorem isClopen_relationCoordinate (s t : List ℕ) :
    IsClopen {p : (TreeCode × TreeCode) × NodeRelationCode | p.2.Relates s t}
proof:
:= by
  have hcontinuous : Continuous (fun p : (TreeCode × TreeCode) × NodeRelationCode =>
      p.2 (nodePairEquiv (s, t))) :=
    (continuous_listNatBoolCoordinate (nodePairEquiv (s, t))).comp continuous_snd
  simpa [NodeRelationCode.Relates, Set.preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using
    (isClopen_discrete ({true} : Set Bool)).preimage hcontinuous

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.isClopen_sourceCoordinate
statement:
private theorem isClopen_sourceCoordinate (s : List ℕ) :
    IsClopen {p : (TreeCode × TreeCode) × NodeRelationCode | s ∈ decodeTree p.1.1}
proof:
:= by
  have hcontinuous : Continuous (fun p : (TreeCode × TreeCode) × NodeRelationCode =>
      p.1.1.1 s) :=
    ((continuous_listNatBoolCoordinate s).comp continuous_subtype_val).comp
      (continuous_fst.comp continuous_fst)
  simpa [Set.preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using
    (isClopen_discrete ({true} : Set Bool)).preimage hcontinuous

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.isClopen_targetCoordinate
statement:
private theorem isClopen_targetCoordinate (t : List ℕ) :
    IsClopen {p : (TreeCode × TreeCode) × NodeRelationCode | t ∈ decodeTree p.1.2}
proof:
:= by
  have hcontinuous : Continuous (fun p : (TreeCode × TreeCode) × NodeRelationCode =>
      p.1.2.1 t) :=
    ((continuous_listNatBoolCoordinate t).comp continuous_subtype_val).comp
      (continuous_snd.comp continuous_fst)
  simpa [Set.preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using
    (isClopen_discrete ({true} : Set Bool)).preimage hcontinuous

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.measurableSet_rankSimulationWitnesses
statement:
theorem measurableSet_rankSimulationWitnesses (s₀ t₀ : List ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet (rankSimulationWitnesses s₀ t₀)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show rankSimulationWitnesses s₀ t₀ =
      {p | p.2.Relates s₀ t₀} ∩
        ⋂ s : List ℕ, ⋂ t : List ℕ, ⋂ a : ℕ,
          ({p | p.2.Relates s t} ∩
            {p | s ++ [a] ∈ decodeTree p.1.1})ᶜ ∪
              ⋃ b : ℕ, ({p | t ++ [b] ∈ decodeTree p.1.2} ∩
                {p | p.2.Relates (s ++ [a]) (t ++ [b])}) by
    ext p
    simp only [rankSimulationWitnesses, IsRankSimulation, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
      Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_compl_iff,
      Set.mem_iUnion, not_and_or]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hroot, hsim⟩
      refine ⟨hroot, fun s t a => ?_⟩
      by_cases hrel : p.2.Relates s t
      · by_cases hsource : s ++ [a] ∈ decodeTree p.1.1
        · exact Or.inr (hsim s t a hrel hsource)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hsource)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hrel)
    · rintro ⟨hroot, hall⟩
      refine ⟨hroot, fun s t a hrel hsource => ?_⟩
      rcases hall s t a with (hmissing | hexists)
      · rcases hmissing with hmissing | hmissing
        · exact (hmissing hrel).elim
        · exact (hmissing hsource).elim
      · exact hexists]
  refine (isClopen_relationCoordinate s₀ t₀).isOpen.measurableSet.inter
    (MeasurableSet.iInter fun s => MeasurableSet.iInter fun t =>
      MeasurableSet.iInter fun a => ?_)
  exact ((isClopen_relationCoordinate s t).isOpen.measurableSet.inter
      (isClopen_sourceCoordinate (s ++ [a])).isOpen.measurableSet).compl.union
    (MeasurableSet.iUnion fun b =>
      (isClopen_targetCoordinate (t ++ [b])).isOpen.measurableSet.inter
        (isClopen_relationCoordinate (s ++ [a]) (t ++ [b])).isOpen.measurableSet)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.analyticSet_rankSimulationFrom
statement:
theorem analyticSet_rankSimulationFrom (s t : List ℕ) :
    MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (rankSimulationFrom s t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show rankSimulationFrom s t = Prod.fst '' rankSimulationWitnesses s t by
    ext p
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨r, hr, hsim⟩
      exact ⟨(p, r), ⟨hr, hsim⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨q, r⟩, ⟨hr, hsim⟩, hq⟩
      change q = p at hq
      subst q
      exact ⟨r, hr, hsim⟩]
  exact (measurableSet_rankSimulationWitnesses s t).analyticSet.image_of_continuous
    continuous_fst

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.analyticSet_treeRankLeSimulation
statement:
theorem analyticSet_treeRankLeSimulation :
    MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet treeRankLeSimulation
proof:
:=

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.analyticSet_treeRankLtSimulation
statement:
theorem analyticSet_treeRankLtSimulation :
    MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet treeRankLtSimulation
proof:
:= by
  rw [show treeRankLtSimulation = ⋃ b : ℕ,
      Prod.fst ''
        (rankSimulationWitnesses [] [b] ∩
          {p : (TreeCode × TreeCode) × NodeRelationCode |
            [b] ∈ decodeTree p.1.2}) by
    ext p
    simp only [treeRankLtSimulation, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion,
      Set.mem_image, Set.mem_inter_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨b, hb, r, hr, hsim⟩
      exact ⟨b, (p, r), ⟨⟨hr, hsim⟩, hb⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨b, ⟨q, r⟩, ⟨⟨hr, hsim⟩, hb⟩, hq⟩
      change q = p at hq
      subst q
      exact ⟨b, hb, r, hr, hsim⟩]
  exact MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.iUnion fun b =>
    ((measurableSet_rankSimulationWitnesses [] [b]).inter
      (isClopen_targetCoordinate [b]).isOpen.measurableSet).analyticSet.image_of_continuous
        continuous_fst

  · rw [rankAt_eq_nodeRank hT hroot, rank_eq_nodeRank hT hroot]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.exists_acc_rank_le_of_simulation
proof:
:= by
  induction haccT generalizing source with
  | intro target hbelow ih =>
      have hmatch (sourceChild : decodeTree S)
          (hsourceChild : Child (decodeTree S) sourceChild source) :
          ∃ targetChild : decodeTree T,
            Child (decodeTree T) targetChild target ∧
              r.Relates sourceChild.1 targetChild.1 := by
        obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hsourceChild
        have hsourceMem : source.1 ++ [a] ∈ decodeTree S := by
          rw [← ha]
          exact sourceChild.2
        obtain ⟨b, htargetMem, hchildRel⟩ :=
          hsim source.1 target.1 a hrel hsourceMem
        let targetChild : decodeTree T := ⟨target.1 ++ [b], htargetMem⟩
        refine ⟨targetChild, ⟨b, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        simpa [targetChild, ha] using hchildRel
      let haccS : Acc (Child (decodeTree S)) source :=
        Acc.intro _ fun sourceChild hsourceChild => by
          obtain ⟨targetChild, htargetChild, hchildRel⟩ :=
            hmatch sourceChild hsourceChild
          exact (ih targetChild htargetChild hchildRel).choose
      refine ⟨haccS, ?_⟩
      rw [haccS.rank_eq]
      refine Ordinal.iSup_le fun sourceChild => ?_
      obtain ⟨targetChild, htargetChild, hchildRel⟩ :=
        hmatch sourceChild.1 sourceChild.2
      obtain ⟨haccSource, hrank⟩ :=
        ih targetChild htargetChild hchildRel
      have hsourceRank : (haccS.inv sourceChild.2).rank = haccSource.rank :=
        congrArg Acc.rank (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
      calc
        Order.succ (haccS.inv sourceChild.2).rank = Order.succ haccSource.rank :=
          congrArg Order.succ hsourceRank
        _ ≤ Order.succ (hbelow targetChild htargetChild).rank :=
          Order.succ_le_succ hrank
        _ ≤ (Acc.intro target hbelow).rank := by
          rw [(Acc.intro target hbelow).rank_eq]
          exact Ordinal.le_iSup
            (fun child : {child : decodeTree T // Child (decodeTree T) child target} =>
              Order.succ ((Acc.intro target hbelow).inv child.2).rank)
            ⟨targetChild, htargetChild⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.ordinalComparisonCode_isRankSimulation
proof:
:= by
  intro s t a hrel hsourceChild
  have hsource : s ∈ decodeTree S := (decodeTree S).property hsourceChild
  have hsourceLt :
      rankAt (decodeTree S) hS (s ++ [a]) < rankAt (decodeTree S) hS s := by
    rw [rankAt_eq_nodeRank hS hsourceChild, rankAt_eq_nodeRank hS hsource]
    exact nodeRank_lt_of_child hS ⟨a, rfl⟩
  have hle := (ordinalComparisonCode_relates S T hS hT s t).mp hrel
  have hsourceTargetLt :
      rankAt (decodeTree S) hS (s ++ [a]) < rankAt (decodeTree T) hT t :=
    hsourceLt.trans_le hle
  by_cases htarget : t ∈ decodeTree T
  · rw [rankAt_eq_nodeRank hS hsourceChild, rankAt_eq_nodeRank hT htarget,
      nodeRank_eq hT] at hsourceTargetLt
    rw [Ordinal.lt_iSup_iff] at hsourceTargetLt
    obtain ⟨targetChild, htargetChildRank⟩ := hsourceTargetLt
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := targetChild.2
    have htargetChildMem : t ++ [b] ∈ decodeTree T := by
      rw [← hb]
      exact targetChild.1.2
    refine ⟨b, htargetChildMem, ?_⟩
    rw [ordinalComparisonCode_relates]
    rw [rankAt_eq_nodeRank hS hsourceChild, rankAt_eq_nodeRank hT htargetChildMem]
    rw [Order.lt_succ_iff] at htargetChildRank
    have htargetEq : targetChild.1 =
        (⟨t ++ [b], htargetChildMem⟩ : decodeTree T) := Subtype.ext hb
    simpa [htargetEq] using htargetChildRank
  · rw [rankAt_eq_zero hT htarget] at hsourceTargetLt
    exact (not_lt_zero hsourceTargetLt).elim

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.isWellFounded_of_root_simulation_to_node
statement:
private theorem isWellFounded_of_root_simulation_to_node {S T : TreeCode}
    {r : NodeRelationCode} {t : List ℕ} (htarget : t ∈ decodeTree T)
    (hT : IsWellFounded (decodeTree T)) (hrel : r.Relates [] t)
    (hsim : IsRankSimulation S T r) : IsWellFounded (decodeTree S)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsource : [] ∈ decodeTree S
  · have haccT : Acc (Child (decodeTree T))
        (⟨t, htarget⟩ : decodeTree T) :=
      (show WellFounded (Child (decodeTree T)) from hT).apply _
    obtain ⟨haccS, -⟩ :=
      exists_acc_rank_le_of_simulation
        (source := (⟨[], hsource⟩ : decodeTree S))
        (target := (⟨t, htarget⟩ : decodeTree T)) hsim (by simpa using hrel) haccT
    exact (acc_root_iff_isWellFounded hsource).1 haccS
  · have hbot : decodeTree S = ⊥ := Descriptive.Tree.tree_eq_bot.mpr hsource
    rw [hbot]
    exact isWellFounded_iff_body_eq_empty.mpr body_bot

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.mem_treeRankLtSimulation_iff
statement:
theorem mem_treeRankLtSimulation_iff {S T : TreeCode}
    (hT : IsWellFounded (decodeTree T)) :
    (S, T) ∈ treeRankLtSimulation ↔
      ∃ hS : IsWellFounded (decodeTree S),
        rank (decodeTree S) hS < rank (decodeTree T) hT
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, htargetChild, hsimulation⟩
    rcases hsimulation with ⟨r, hrootChildRel, hsim⟩
    have hS : IsWellFounded (decodeTree S) :=
      isWellFounded_of_root_simulation_to_node htargetChild hT hrootChildRel hsim
    refine ⟨hS, ?_⟩
    have hle := (rankSimulationFrom_iff_rankAt_le hS hT [] [b]).1
      ⟨r, hrootChildRel, hsim⟩
    have htargetRoot : [] ∈ decodeTree T := (decodeTree T).property htargetChild
    rw [rankAt_nil_eq_rank, rankAt_eq_nodeRank hT htargetChild] at hle
    rw [rank_eq_nodeRank hT htargetRoot]
    exact hle.trans_lt (nodeRank_lt_of_child hT ⟨b, rfl⟩)
  · rintro ⟨hS, hrank⟩
    by_cases htargetRoot : [] ∈ decodeTree T
    · rw [rank_eq_nodeRank hT htargetRoot, nodeRank_eq hT,
        Ordinal.lt_iSup_iff] at hrank
      obtain ⟨targetChild, htargetChildRank⟩ := hrank
      rw [Order.lt_succ_iff] at htargetChildRank
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := targetChild.2
      have hb' : targetChild.1.1 = [b] := by simpa using hb
      have htargetChild : [b] ∈ decodeTree T := by
        rw [← hb']
        exact targetChild.1.2
      refine ⟨b, htargetChild, ?_⟩
      apply (rankSimulationFrom_iff_rankAt_le hS hT [] [b]).2
      rw [rankAt_nil_eq_rank, rankAt_eq_nodeRank hT htargetChild]
      have htargetEq : targetChild.1 =
          (⟨[b], htargetChild⟩ : decodeTree T) := Subtype.ext hb'
      simpa [htargetEq] using htargetChildRank
    · rw [rank_eq_zero_of_nil_not_mem hT htargetRoot] at hrank
      exact (not_lt_zero hrank).elim

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.isCoanalytic_treeRankLeCoanalytic
statement: theorem isCoanalytic_treeRankLeCoanalytic : IsCoanalytic treeRankLeCoanalytic
proof:

    (({p : TreeCode × TreeCode | p.1 ∈ illFoundedTrees} ∪
      {p | (p.2, p.1) ∈ treeRankLtSimulation})ᶜ)ᶜ

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.mem_treeRankLeAnalytic_iff
statement:
theorem mem_treeRankLeAnalytic_iff {S T : TreeCode} :
    (S, T) ∈ treeRankLeAnalytic ↔
      ¬IsWellFounded (decodeTree T) ∨
        ∃ hT : IsWellFounded (decodeTree T),
          ∃ hS : IsWellFounded (decodeTree S),
            rank (decodeTree S) hS ≤ rank (decodeTree T) hT
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro (htarget | hsimulation)
    · exact Or.inl htarget
    · by_cases hT : IsWellFounded (decodeTree T)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hT, (mem_treeRankLeSimulation_iff hT).1 hsimulation⟩
      · exact Or.inl hT
  · rintro (hT | ⟨hT, hS, hrank⟩)
    · exact Or.inl hT
    · exact Or.inr ((mem_treeRankLeSimulation_iff hT).2 ⟨hS, hrank⟩)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.mem_treeRankLeCoanalytic_iff
statement:
theorem mem_treeRankLeCoanalytic_iff {S T : TreeCode} :
    (S, T) ∈ treeRankLeCoanalytic ↔
      ∃ hS : IsWellFounded (decodeTree S),
        ¬IsWellFounded (decodeTree T) ∨
          ∃ hT : IsWellFounded (decodeTree T),
            rank (decodeTree S) hS ≤ rank (decodeTree T) hT
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hcomparison
    change ¬(S ∈ illFoundedTrees ∨ (T, S) ∈ treeRankLtSimulation) at hcomparison
    have hS : IsWellFounded (decodeTree S) := by
      by_contra hS
      exact hcomparison (Or.inl hS)
    refine ⟨hS, ?_⟩
    by_cases hT : IsWellFounded (decodeTree T)
    · refine Or.inr ⟨hT, ?_⟩
      have hnotLt : ¬rank (decodeTree T) hT < rank (decodeTree S) hS := by
        intro hrank
        exact hcomparison (Or.inr ((mem_treeRankLtSimulation_iff hS).2 ⟨hT, hrank⟩))
      exact not_lt.mp hnotLt
    · exact Or.inl hT
  · rintro ⟨hS, htarget⟩
    change ¬(S ∈ illFoundedTrees ∨ (T, S) ∈ treeRankLtSimulation)
    rintro (hsource | hcomparison)
    · exact hsource hS
    · obtain ⟨hT, hrank⟩ := (mem_treeRankLtSimulation_iff hS).1 hcomparison
      rcases htarget with htarget | ⟨hT', hle⟩
      · exact htarget hT
      · have hp : hT = hT' := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        subst hT
        exact (not_lt_of_ge hle hrank)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.mem_treeRankLeAnalytic_iff_of_isWellFounded
statement:
theorem mem_treeRankLeAnalytic_iff_of_isWellFounded {S T : TreeCode}
    (hT : IsWellFounded (decodeTree T)) :
    (S, T) ∈ treeRankLeAnalytic ↔
      ∃ hS : IsWellFounded (decodeTree S),
        rank (decodeTree S) hS ≤ rank (decodeTree T) hT
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hcomparison
    rcases mem_treeRankLeAnalytic_iff.mp hcomparison with hnot | ⟨hT', hresult⟩
    · exact (hnot hT).elim
    · have hp : hT' = hT := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst hT'
      exact hresult
  · intro hresult
    exact mem_treeRankLeAnalytic_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨hT, hresult⟩)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.mem_treeRankLeCoanalytic_iff_of_isWellFounded
statement:
theorem mem_treeRankLeCoanalytic_iff_of_isWellFounded {S T : TreeCode}
    (hT : IsWellFounded (decodeTree T)) :
    (S, T) ∈ treeRankLeCoanalytic ↔
      ∃ hS : IsWellFounded (decodeTree S),
        rank (decodeTree S) hS ≤ rank (decodeTree T) hT
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hcomparison
    obtain ⟨hS, hnot | ⟨hT', hrank⟩⟩ :=
      mem_treeRankLeCoanalytic_iff.mp hcomparison
    · exact (hnot hT).elim
    · have hp : hT' = hT := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst hT'
      exact ⟨hS, hrank⟩
  · rintro ⟨hS, hrank⟩
    exact mem_treeRankLeCoanalytic_iff.mpr ⟨hS, Or.inr ⟨hT, hrank⟩⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.treeRankLe_polarities_agree
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_treeRankLeAnalytic_iff_of_isWellFounded hT,
    mem_treeRankLeCoanalytic_iff_of_isWellFounded hT]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.treeRankLT_eq_treeRankLtAnalytic_section
statement:
theorem treeRankLT_eq_treeRankLtAnalytic_section (T : TreeCode)
    (hT : IsWellFounded (decodeTree T)) :
    treeRankLT (rank (decodeTree T) hT) =
      {S | (S, T) ∈ treeRankLtAnalytic}
proof:
:= by
  ext S
  exact mem_treeRankLtAnalytic_iff_of_isWellFounded hT |>.symm

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.treeRankLT_succ_eq_treeRankLeAnalytic_section
statement:
theorem treeRankLT_succ_eq_treeRankLeAnalytic_section (T : TreeCode)
    (hT : IsWellFounded (decodeTree T)) :
    treeRankLT (Order.succ (rank (decodeTree T) hT)) =
      {S | (S, T) ∈ treeRankLeAnalytic}
proof:
:= by
  ext S
  rw [mem_treeRankLT_succ_iff_le]
  change (∃ hS : IsWellFounded (decodeTree S),
      rank (decodeTree S) hS ≤ rank (decodeTree T) hT) ↔
    (S, T) ∈ treeRankLeAnalytic
  exact (mem_treeRankLeAnalytic_iff_of_isWellFounded hT).symm

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.treeRankComparison_isCoanalyticNorm
statement:
theorem treeRankComparison_isCoanalyticNorm :
    IsCoanalytic wellFoundedTrees ∧
      MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet treeRankLeAnalytic ∧
      IsCoanalytic treeRankLeCoanalytic ∧
      MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet treeRankLtAnalytic ∧
      IsCoanalytic treeRankLtCoanalytic ∧
      ∀ (T : TreeCode) (hT : IsWellFounded (decodeTree T)) (S : TreeCode),
        ((∃ hS : IsWellFounded (decodeTree S),
            rank (decodeTree S) hS ≤ rank (decodeTree T) hT) ↔
          (S, T) ∈ treeRankLeAnalytic) ∧
        ((∃ hS : IsWellFounded (decodeTree S),
            rank (decodeTree S) hS ≤ rank (decodeTree T) hT) ↔
          (S, T) ∈ treeRankLeCoanalytic) ∧
        ((∃ hS : IsWellFounded (decodeTree S),
            rank (decodeTree S) hS < rank (decodeTree T) hT) ↔
          (S, T) ∈ treeRankLtAnalytic) ∧
        ((∃ hS : IsWellFounded (decodeTree S),
            rank (decodeTree S) hS < rank (decodeTree T) hT) ↔
          (S, T) ∈ treeRankLtCoanalytic)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isCoanalytic_wellFoundedTrees, analyticSet_treeRankLeAnalytic,
    isCoanalytic_treeRankLeCoanalytic, analyticSet_treeRankLtAnalytic,
    isCoanalytic_treeRankLtCoanalytic, ?_⟩
  intro T hT S
  exact ⟨(mem_treeRankLeAnalytic_iff_of_isWellFounded hT).symm,
    (mem_treeRankLeCoanalytic_iff_of_isWellFounded hT).symm,
    (mem_treeRankLtAnalytic_iff_of_isWellFounded hT).symm,
    (mem_treeRankLtCoanalytic_iff_of_isWellFounded hT).symm⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.isPerfectTree_top
statement: theorem isPerfectTree_top : IsPerfectTree (⊤ : Descriptive.tree ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by simp, fun {s} _ => ?_⟩
  refine ⟨s ++ [0], by simp, s ++ [1], by simp, ⟨[0], rfl⟩, ⟨[1], rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  constructor <;> intro h
  · have heq := h.eq_of_length (by simp)

  · have heq := h.eq_of_length (by simp)

proof:
:= by
  rcases hT.exists_incompatible_extensions s.2 with ⟨t, ht, u, hu, hst, hsu, htu⟩
  exact ⟨⟨(⟨t, ht⟩, ⟨u, hu⟩), hst, hsu, htu⟩⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.IsPerfectTree.node_length_lt_nextNode
statement:
private theorem IsPerfectTree.node_length_lt_nextNode {T : Descriptive.tree ℕ}
    (hT : IsPerfectTree T) (s : T) (b : Bool) : s.1.length < (hT.nextNode s b).1.length
proof:
:= by
  have hpref := hT.node_prefix_nextNode s b
  have hne : s.1 ≠ (hT.nextNode s b).1 := by
    cases b with
    | false =>
        change s.1 ≠ (hT.chosenSplit s).1.1.1
        intro h
        apply (hT.chosenSplit s).2.2.2.1
        rw [← h]
        exact (hT.chosenSplit s).2.2.1
    | true =>
        change s.1 ≠ (hT.chosenSplit s).1.2.1
        intro h
        apply (hT.chosenSplit s).2.2.2.2
        rw [← h]
        exact (hT.chosenSplit s).2.1
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne hpref.length_le fun hlen => hne (hpref.eq_of_length hlen)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.ChildChain.length_lower
statement:
private theorem length_lower (f : ℕ → T) (hf : ∀ n, Child T (f (n + 1)) (f n))
    (n : ℕ) : n ≤ (f n).1.length
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Nat.zero_le _
  | succ n ih =>
      exact (Nat.succ_le_succ ih).trans (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Child.length_lt (hf n)))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.ChildChain.initialSegment_sequence
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp [length_initialSegment, List.length_take, Nat.min_eq_left (length_lower f hf n)]
  · intro i hi₁ hi₂
    have hi : i < n := by simpa using hi₁
    have hfi : i < (f (i + 1)).1.length := by
      have := length_lower f hf (i + 1)
      omega
    have hfn : i < (f n).1.length := hi.trans_le (length_lower f hf n)
    have hcoord : (f (i + 1)).1[i]'hfi = (f n).1[i]'hfn :=
      (isPrefix f hf (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hi)).getElem hfi
    simpa [initialSegment, sequence] using hcoord

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.isWellFounded_iff_body_eq_empty
statement: theorem isWellFounded_iff_body_eq_empty : IsWellFounded T ↔ body T = ∅
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hT
    apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    intro x hx
    have hchain : ∀ n, Child T
        (⟨initialSegment x (n + 1), hx (n + 1)⟩ : T)
        (⟨initialSegment x n, hx n⟩ : T) := fun n =>
      ⟨x n, initialSegment_succ x n⟩
    exact (wellFounded_iff_isEmpty_descending_chain.mp hT).false
      ⟨fun n => ⟨initialSegment x n, hx n⟩, hchain⟩
  · intro hbody
    change WellFounded (Child T)
    rw [wellFounded_iff_isEmpty_descending_chain]
    constructor
    rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
    have hx : ChildChain.sequence f hf ∈ body T := fun n =>
      ChildChain.initialSegment_mem f hf n
    rw [hbody] at hx
    exact hx

statement:
private theorem accRank_lt_omega_one {T : Descriptive.tree ℕ} {s : T}
    (h : Acc (Child T) s) : h.rank < (ω₁ : Ordinal.{0})
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | intro s hbelow ih =>
      rw [Acc.rank_eq]
      apply Ordinal.iSup_lt_omega_one
      intro child
      exact (isSuccLimit_omega 1).succ_lt (ih child.1 child.2)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.treeRank_lt_omega_one
statement:
theorem treeRank_lt_omega_one (T : Descriptive.tree ℕ) (hT : IsWellFounded T) :
    rank T hT < (ω₁ : Ordinal.{0})
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hroot : [] ∈ T
  · rw [rank_eq_nodeRank hT hroot]
    exact nodeRank_lt_omega_one hT ⟨[], hroot⟩
  · rw [rank_eq_zero_of_nil_not_mem hT hroot]
    exact omega_pos 1

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.rank_bounded_of_continuous_baire_family
statement:
theorem rank_bounded_of_continuous_baire_family (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → TreeCode)
    (hf : Continuous f) (hWF : ∀ x, IsWellFounded (decodeTree (f x))) :
    ∃ ξ : Ordinal.{0}, ξ < ω₁ ∧
      ∀ x, rank (decodeTree (f x)) (hWF x) < ξ
proof:
:= by
  have hrange : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (Set.range f) :=
    MeasureTheory.analyticSet_range_of_polishSpace hf
  have hrangeWF : Set.range f ⊆ wellFoundedTrees := by
    rintro T ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact hWF x
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hbound⟩ :=
    rank_bounded_of_analytic_subset_wellFounded hrange hrangeWF
  refine ⟨ξ, hξ, fun x => ?_⟩
  exact hbound (f x) (Set.mem_range_self x) (hWF x)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.rank_bounded_empty
statement:

        ∀ hT : IsWellFounded (decodeTree T), rank (decodeTree T) hT < ξ
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨0, omega_pos 1, fun _ hT => hT.elim⟩

proof:

proof:
:= by
  intro s
  constructor
  · intro hs
    refine ⟨baireParameterUniversalOpenCode b s, Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
    · rintro x ⟨n, hn, hxn⟩
      exact (baireParameterUniversalOpenCode_apply_iff b s n).1 hn hxn
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hxu, hus⟩ := hb.exists_subset_of_mem_open hx hs
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hu
      exact ⟨n, (baireParameterUniversalOpenCode_apply_iff b s n).2 hus, hxu⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    have hbo : ∀ n, IsOpen (b n) := fun n => hb.isOpen (Set.mem_range_self n)
    exact (isOpen_baireParameterUniversalOpen hbo).preimage
      (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_verticalSection_baireUniversalAnalytic
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ :=
    (Tree.analyticSet_iff_exists_projectedBody_baire s).1 hs
  let c : Set (ℕ → ℕ) :=
    bairePairHomeomorph ⁻¹' Tree.pairedBody T
  have hc : IsClosed c :=
    (Tree.isClosed_pairedBody T).preimage bairePairHomeomorph.continuous
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ :=
    isUniversalClosed_baireUniversalClosed.exists_section hc
  refine ⟨cantorToBaire q, ?_⟩
  ext x
  rw [mem_verticalSection_baireUniversalAnalytic,
    baireToCantor_cantorToBaire]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    have hpack : packBairePair (x, y) ∈ c := by
      rw [← hq]
      exact hy
    have hxy : (x, y) ∈ Tree.pairedBody T := by
      simpa [c, packBairePair] using hpack
    rw [← hT]
    exact Tree.mem_projectedBody.2 ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · intro hx
    have hxT : x ∈ Tree.projectedBody T := by
      rw [hT]
      exact hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := Tree.mem_projectedBody.1 hxT
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    have hpack : packBairePair (x, y) ∈ c := by
      simpa [c, packBairePair, Tree.pairedBody] using hxy
    rw [← hq] at hpack
    exact hpack

    (hi : IsCountableBorelLevel i) : Countable (PositiveBorelLevelBelow i)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Countable (Set.Iio i) := countable_Iio_of_isCountableBorelLevel hi
  apply Function.Injective.countable (f := fun x : PositiveBorelLevelBelow i =>
    (⟨x.1, x.2.2⟩ : Set.Iio i))

  letI : Countable (PositiveBorelLevelBelow i) := countable_positiveBorelLevelBelow hic
  rw [← Set.range_eq_univ]
  simpa [positiveBorelLevelSequence] using
    (Set.range_enumerateCountable_of_mem (Set.countable_univ :
      (Set.univ : Set (PositiveBorelLevelBelow i)).Countable)
      (Set.mem_univ (⟨1, zero_lt_one, hi⟩ : PositiveBorelLevelBelow i)))

    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (hU sᶜ).1 ((ordinalSigma0_compl_iff_pi0 i s).2 hs)
    refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
    rw [verticalSection_compl_baireParameters, hp]
    simp
  · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
    have hsection : OrdinalSigma0 i (verticalSection U p) := (hU _).2 ⟨p, rfl⟩
    have hcompl := hsection.compl
    rw [← verticalSection_compl_baireParameters U p, hp] at hcompl
    exact hcompl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ordinalSigma0_baireIndexedIUnion
statement:
theorem ordinalSigma0_baireIndexedIUnion [TopologicalSpace X]
    {i : Ordinal.{0}} (hi : (1 : Ordinal) < i)
    (j : ℕ → PositiveBorelLevelBelow i) {U : ℕ → Set ((ℕ → ℕ) × X)}
    (hU : ∀ k, OrdinalPi0 (j k).1 (U k)) : OrdinalSigma0 i (baireIndexedIUnion U)
proof:
:= by
  have hi0 : i ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans hi)
  have hi1 : i ≠ 1 := ne_of_gt hi
  let f : ℕ → Set ((ℕ → ℕ) × X) := fun z =>
    baireSelector z.unpair.1 z.unpair.2 ∩ baireUnpackProd z.unpair.1 ⁻¹' U z.unpair.2
  let level : ℕ → Set.Iio i := fun z => ⟨(j z.unpair.2).1, (j z.unpair.2).2.2⟩
  refine (ordinalSigma0_of_ne_zero_one hi0 hi1).2 ⟨f, level, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z
    have hselector :
        OrdinalPi0 (j z.unpair.2).1 (baireSelector (X := X) z.unpair.1 z.unpair.2) :=
      ordinalPi0_of_isClopen (j z.unpair.2).2.1
        (isOpen_baireSelector z.unpair.1 z.unpair.2)
        (isClosed_baireSelector z.unpair.1 z.unpair.2)
    have hpayload :
        OrdinalPi0 (j z.unpair.2).1 (baireUnpackProd z.unpair.1 ⁻¹' U z.unpair.2) :=
      (hU z.unpair.2).preimage (continuous_baireUnpackProd z.unpair.1)
    exact hselector.inter hpayload
  · rw [baireIndexedIUnion_eq_iUnion]
    exact (Set.iUnion_unpair fun n k =>
      baireSelector n k ∩ baireUnpackProd n ⁻¹' U k).symm

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isUniversalFor_baireIndexedIUnion_ordinal
proof:
:= by
  have hi0 : i ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans hi)
  have hi1 : i ≠ 1 := ne_of_gt hi
  intro s
  constructor
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨f, level, hf, rfl⟩ := (ordinalSigma0_of_ne_zero_one hi0 hi1).1 hs
    have hpositive : ∀ n, 0 < (level n).1 := by
      intro n
      by_contra hn
      have hz : (level n).1 = 0 := bot_unique (not_lt.mp hn)
      exact ordinalPi0_zero (f n) (by simpa [hz] using hf n)
    let positiveLevel : ℕ → PositiveBorelLevelBelow i := fun n =>
      ⟨(level n).1, hpositive n, (level n).2⟩
    choose k hk using fun n => hj (positiveLevel n)
    have hfk : ∀ n, OrdinalPi0 (j (k n)).1 (f n) := by
      intro n
      rw [hk n]
      exact hf n
    choose p hp using fun n => (hU (k n) (f n)).1 (hfk n)
    refine ⟨bairePack (fun n => baireCons (k n) (p n)), ?_⟩
    rw [verticalSection_baireIndexedIUnion]
    simp_rw [baireUnpack_pack, baireHead_cons, baireTail_cons, hp]
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    refine (ordinalSigma0_of_ne_zero_one hi0 hi1).2
      ⟨fun n => verticalSection
          (U (baireHead (baireUnpack p n))) (baireTail (baireUnpack p n)),
        fun n => ⟨(j (baireHead (baireUnpack p n))).1,
          (j (baireHead (baireUnpack p n))).2.2⟩, ?_,
        verticalSection_baireIndexedIUnion U p⟩
    intro n
    exact (hU (baireHead (baireUnpack p n)) _).2
      ⟨baireTail (baireUnpack p n), rfl⟩

statement:

proof:

    ⟨fun i => cantorUnpackProd i ⁻¹' U,

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsUniversalFor.cantorIUnion
proof:

    refine ⟨cantorPack p, ?_⟩
    rw [verticalSection_cantorIUnion]
    simp_rw [cantorUnpack_pack, hp]
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    refine sigma0_succ_succ.2
      ⟨fun i => verticalSection U (cantorUnpack p i), ?_, verticalSection_cantorIUnion U p⟩
    intro i

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ordinalUniversalSigma_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem ordinalUniversalSigma_of_one_lt (b : ℕ → Set X) {i : Ordinal.{0}}
    (hic : IsCountableBorelLevel i) (hi : (1 : Ordinal) < i) :
    ordinalUniversalSigma b i hic = baireIndexedIUnion fun k =>
      (ordinalUniversalSigma b (positiveBorelLevelSequence i hi hic k).1
        ((positiveBorelLevelSequence i hi hic k).2.2.trans hic))ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordinalUniversalSigma, ordinalUniversalSigmaAux.eq_1]
  simp only [dif_neg (ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans hi)), dif_neg (ne_of_gt hi)]
  rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ordinalSigma0_ordinalUniversalSigma
proof:
:= by
  induction i using WellFoundedLT.induction with
  | ind i ih =>
      by_cases hi1 : i = 1
      · subst i
        rw [ordinalUniversalSigma_one]
        have hbo : ∀ n, IsOpen (b n) := fun n => hb.isOpen (Set.mem_range_self n)
        exact ordinalSigma0_one_iff.2 (isOpen_baireParameterUniversalOpen hbo)
      · have hi : (1 : Ordinal) < i :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne (Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hi0)) (Ne.symm hi1)
        rw [ordinalUniversalSigma_of_one_lt b hic hi]
        apply ordinalSigma0_baireIndexedIUnion hi (positiveBorelLevelSequence i hi hic)
        intro k
        let j := positiveBorelLevelSequence i hi hic k
        exact (ih j.1 j.2.2 (j.2.2.trans hic) j.2.1).compl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isUniversalFor_ordinalUniversalSigma
proof:
:= by
  induction i using WellFoundedLT.induction with
  | ind i ih =>
      by_cases hi1 : i = 1
      · subst i
        rw [ordinalUniversalSigma_one]
        intro s
        simpa only [ordinalSigma0_one_iff] using
          (isUniversalFor_baireParameterUniversalOpen hb s)
      · have hi : (1 : Ordinal) < i :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne (Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hi0)) (Ne.symm hi1)
        rw [ordinalUniversalSigma_of_one_lt b hic hi]
        apply isUniversalFor_baireIndexedIUnion_ordinal hi
          (positiveBorelLevelSequence i hi hic)
          (surjective_positiveBorelLevelSequence i hi hic)
        intro k
        let j := positiveBorelLevelSequence i hi hic k
        exact (ih j.1 j.2.2 (j.2.2.trans hic) j.2.1).compl_ordinalSigma0

  intro s
  constructor
  · intro hs
    rcases projectiveSigma_succ.mp hs with ⟨R, hR, hproj⟩
    have hPacked : ProjectivePi n (unpackBairePair ⁻¹' R) :=
      hR.preimage continuous_unpackBairePair
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (hU (unpackBairePair ⁻¹' R)).mp hPacked
    refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
    rw [← hproj]
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
      have hw' : packBairePair (w, x) ∈ verticalSection U p := hw
      rw [hp] at hw'
      exact ⟨w, by simpa using hw'⟩
    · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
      refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
      have hw' : packBairePair (w, x) ∈ unpackBairePair ⁻¹' R := by
        simpa using hw
      rw [← hp] at hw'
      exact hw'
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact (projectiveSigma_projectiveSuccessorUniversal hTotal).verticalSection p

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.baireUniversalProjective_mutual
statement:
private theorem baireUniversalProjective_mutual (n : ℕ) :
    (ProjectiveSigma (n + 1) (baireUniversalProjectiveSigma (n + 1)) ∧
      IsUniversalFor (ProjectiveSigma (n + 1))
        (baireUniversalProjectiveSigma (n + 1))) ∧
    (ProjectivePi (n + 1) (baireUniversalProjectivePi (n + 1)) ∧
      IsUniversalFor (ProjectivePi (n + 1))
        (baireUniversalProjectivePi (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      refine ⟨⟨projectiveSigma_one_iff_analyticSet.mpr
          analyticSet_baireUniversalAnalytic, ?_⟩,
        ⟨projectivePi_one_iff_isCoanalytic.mpr
          isCoanalytic_baireUniversalCoanalytic, ?_⟩⟩
      · intro s
        rw [projectiveSigma_one_iff_analyticSet]
        exact isUniversalAnalytic_baireUniversalAnalytic.2 s
      · intro s
        rw [projectivePi_one_iff_isCoanalytic]
        exact isUniversalCoanalytic_baireUniversalCoanalytic.2 s
  | succ n ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨⟨hSigma, hUniversalSigma⟩, ⟨hPi, hUniversalPi⟩⟩
      have hNextSigma : ProjectiveSigma (n + 2)
          (baireUniversalProjectiveSigma (n + 2)) := by
        simpa [baireUniversalProjectiveSigma, baireUniversalProjectivePi] using
          projectiveSigma_projectiveSuccessorUniversal hPi
      have hNextUniversalSigma : IsUniversalFor (ProjectiveSigma (n + 2))
          (baireUniversalProjectiveSigma (n + 2)) := by
        simpa [baireUniversalProjectiveSigma, baireUniversalProjectivePi] using
          isUniversalFor_projectiveSuccessorUniversal hPi hUniversalPi
      refine ⟨⟨hNextSigma, hNextUniversalSigma⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · simpa [baireUniversalProjectivePi] using hNextSigma.compl
      · exact isUniversalFor_projectivePi_compl hNextUniversalSigma

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_verticalSection_baireUniversalProjectivePi

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.take_initialSegment
statement:
private theorem take_initialSegment (f : ℕ → ℕ) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    (initialSegment f n).take m = initialSegment f m
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp [length_initialSegment, hmn]
  · intro i hi₁ hi₂
    simp [initialSegment]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsViablePrefix.of_prefix
statement:
theorem IsViablePrefix.of_prefix {A : List ℕ → Set X} {s t : List ℕ}
    (ht : IsViablePrefix A t) (hst : s <+: t) : IsViablePrefix A s
proof:
:= by
  rcases ht with ⟨x, f, hft, hf⟩
  rcases hst with ⟨u, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨x, f, ?_, hf⟩
  have hlen : s.length ≤ (s ++ u).length := by simp
  calc
    initialSegment f s.length = (initialSegment f (s ++ u).length).take s.length :=
      (take_initialSegment f hlen).symm
    _ = (s ++ u).take s.length := congrArg (List.take s.length) hft
    _ = s := by simp

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsViablePrefix.exists_extension

theorem IsViablePrefix.exists_extension {A : List ℕ → Set X} {s : List ℕ}

proof:
:= by
  rcases hs with ⟨x, f, hfs, hf⟩
  refine ⟨f s.length, x, f, ?_, hf⟩
  rw [List.length_append, List.length_singleton, initialSegment_succ, hfs]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.eq_initialSegment_length_of_prefix
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : s.length ≤ n := by simpa using hs.length_le
  have htake := congrArg (List.take s.length) (List.prefix_iff_eq_append.mp hs)
  rw [List.take_append, List.take_length, Nat.sub_self, List.take_zero, List.append_nil] at htake
  rw [take_initialSegment f hlen] at htake
  exact htake

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.nonempty_normalizeScheme_iff
statement:
theorem nonempty_normalizeScheme_iff (A : List ℕ → Set X) (s : List ℕ) :
    (normalizeScheme A s).Nonempty ↔ IsViablePrefix A s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact hx.1
  · intro hs
    rcases hs with ⟨x, f, hfs, hf⟩
    let hs : IsViablePrefix A s := ⟨x, f, hfs, hf⟩
    refine ⟨x, hs, ?_⟩
    intro t hts
    rw [← hfs] at hts
    rw [eq_initialSegment_length_of_prefix f hts]
    exact hf t.length

  intro s hs

  rcases hs.exists_extension with ⟨a, ha⟩
  exact ⟨a, (nonempty_normalizeScheme_iff A _).2 ha⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.suslinOperation_normalizeScheme
statement:
@[simp]
theorem suslinOperation_normalizeScheme (A : List ℕ → Set X) :
    suslinOperation (normalizeScheme A) = suslinOperation A
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact suslinOperation_mono fun s => normalizeScheme_subset A s
  · intro x hx
    rcases suslinOperation_subset_regularizeScheme A hx with ⟨f, hfreg⟩
    have hf : ∀ n, x ∈ A (initialSegment f n) :=
      fun n => regularizeScheme_subset A _ (hfreg n)
    refine ⟨f, fun n => ⟨?_, hfreg n⟩⟩
    exact ⟨x, f, by simp, hf⟩

proof:
:= by
  rw [show regularizeScheme A s = ⋂ t : {t : List ℕ // t <+: s}, A t.1 by
    ext x
    simp [regularizeScheme]]
  exact isClosed_iInter fun t => hA t.1

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isClosed_normalizeScheme
statement:
theorem isClosed_normalizeScheme (A : List ℕ → Set X)
    (hA : ∀ s, IsClosed (A s)) (s : List ℕ) : IsClosed (normalizeScheme A s)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs : IsViablePrefix A s
  · have heq : normalizeScheme A s = regularizeScheme A s := by
      ext x
      simp [normalizeScheme, hs]
    rw [heq]
    exact isClosed_regularizeScheme A hA s
  · have heq : normalizeScheme A s = ∅ := by
      ext x
      simp [normalizeScheme, hs]
    rw [heq]
    exact isClosed_empty

statement:
theorem analyticSet_iff_exists_normalized_closed_suslinScheme_baire
    (s : Set (ℕ → ℕ)) :
    MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s ↔
      ∃ A : List ℕ → Set (ℕ → ℕ),
        (∀ t, IsClosed (A t)) ∧ IsRegularSuslinScheme A ∧
          IsPrunedSuslinScheme A ∧ suslinOperation A = s

    rcases (analyticSet_iff_exists_closed_suslinScheme_baire s).1 hs with ⟨A, hA, hAs⟩
    refine ⟨normalizeScheme A, isClosed_normalizeScheme A hA,
      isRegularSuslinScheme_normalizeScheme A,
      isPrunedSuslinScheme_normalizeScheme A, ?_⟩
    rw [suslinOperation_normalizeScheme, hAs]

    exact analyticSet_suslinOperation_of_isClosed A hA

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isClosed_closedSchemeConstraint
proof:
:= by
  let R : Set ((Fin n → ℕ) × X) :=
    {q | q.2 ∈ A (List.ofFn q.1)}
  have hR : IsClosed R := by
    rw [← isOpen_compl_iff]
    have hcompl :
        Rᶜ = ⋃ s : Fin n → ℕ,
          ({s} : Set (Fin n → ℕ)) ×ˢ (A (List.ofFn s))ᶜ := by
      ext q
      simp [R]
    rw [hcompl]
    exact isOpen_iUnion fun s =>
      (isOpen_discrete {s}).prod (hA _).isOpen_compl
  have hfirst : Continuous (fun p : (ℕ → ℕ) × X =>
      fun i : Fin n => p.1 (i : ℕ)) :=
    continuous_pi fun i =>
      (continuous_apply (i : ℕ)).comp continuous_fst
  have hcontinuous : Continuous (fun p : (ℕ → ℕ) × X =>
      ((fun i : Fin n => p.1 i), p.2)) :=
    hfirst.prodMk continuous_snd
  simpa [R, initialSegment] using hR.preimage hcontinuous

      {p : (ℕ → ℕ) × X | p.2 ∈ A (initialSegment p.1 n)} by
    ext p
    simp [closedSchemeRelation]]
  exact isClosed_iInter (isClosed_closedSchemeConstraint A hA)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.isClosed_suslinScheme
statement:
theorem isClosed_suslinScheme (T : Descriptive.tree (A × ℕ)) (s : List ℕ) :
    IsClosed (suslinScheme T s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show suslinScheme T s =
      (fun x : ℕ → A => fun i : Fin s.length => x i) ⁻¹'
        {f : Fin s.length → A | (List.ofFn f).zip s ∈ T} by
    rfl]
  have hcontinuous : Continuous (fun x : ℕ → A =>
      fun i : Fin s.length => x (i : ℕ)) :=
    continuous_pi fun i => continuous_apply (i : ℕ)
  exact (isClopen_discrete
    {f : Fin s.length → A | (List.ofFn f).zip s ∈ T}).isClosed.preimage

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.analyticSet_iff_exists_closed_suslinScheme_baire
statement:
theorem analyticSet_iff_exists_closed_suslinScheme_baire (s : Set (ℕ → ℕ)) :

      ∃ A : List ℕ → Set (ℕ → ℕ),
        (∀ t, IsClosed (A t)) ∧ suslinOperation A = s
proof:

  constructor
  · intro hs
    rcases (analyticSet_iff_exists_projectedBody_baire s).1 hs with ⟨T, hT⟩
    refine ⟨suslinScheme T, isClosed_suslinScheme T, ?_⟩
    exact (projectedBody_eq_suslinOperation T).symm.trans hT
  · rintro ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩
    exact analyticSet_suslinOperation_of_isClosed A hA

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.AnalyticSet.inter
statement:
private theorem AnalyticSet.inter {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y]
    {s t : Set Y} (hs : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s)
    (ht : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet t) : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (s ∩ t)
proof:
:= by
  let f : Bool → Set Y := fun b => if b then s else t
  have hf : ∀ b, MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (f b) := by
    intro b
    cases b <;> simp [f, hs, ht]
  rw [show s ∩ t = ⋂ b, f b by
    ext x
    simp [f, and_comm]]
  exact MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.iInter hf

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.analyticSet_analyticSchemeConstraint
statement:
theorem analyticSet_analyticSchemeConstraint (A : List ℕ → Set X)
    (hA : ∀ s, MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (A s)) (n : ℕ) :
    MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (analyticSchemeConstraint A n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show analyticSchemeConstraint A n =
      ⋃ s : Fin n → ℕ,
        {p : (ℕ → ℕ) × X | (fun i : Fin n => p.1 i) = s} ∩
          Prod.snd ⁻¹' A (List.ofFn s) by
    ext p
    simp [analyticSchemeConstraint, initialSegment]]
  exact MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.iUnion fun s => by
    apply AnalyticSet.inter
    · have hfirst : Continuous (fun p : (ℕ → ℕ) × X =>
          fun i : Fin n => p.1 (i : ℕ)) :=
        continuous_pi fun i =>
          (continuous_apply (i : ℕ)).comp continuous_fst
      exact (isClosed_eq hfirst continuous_const).analyticSet
    · exact (hA (List.ofFn s)).preimage continuous_snd

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.analyticSet_suslinOperation_of_analytic
statement:
theorem analyticSet_suslinOperation_of_analytic (A : List ℕ → Set X)
    (hA : ∀ s, MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (A s)) :
    MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (suslinOperation A)
proof:
:= by
  have hregular : ∀ s, MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (regularizeScheme A s) :=
    analyticSet_regularizeScheme A hA
  have hrelation := analyticSet_analyticSchemeRelation (regularizeScheme A) hregular
  have himage := hrelation.image_of_continuous continuous_snd
  rw [← suslinOperation_eq_snd_image_analyticSchemeRelation,
    suslinOperation_regularizeScheme] at himage
  exact himage

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelCode.eval_mem_delta_bound
statement:
private theorem eval_mem_delta_bound (c : BorelCode X) :
    OrdinalDelta0 ((c.constructionRank + 1) + 1) c.eval
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | basic U =>
      change OrdinalDelta0 (((0 : Ordinal) + 1) + 1) (U : Set X)
      have hsigma : OrdinalSigma0 (2 : Ordinal) (U : Set X) :=
        (ordinalSigma0_one_iff.2 U.property).mono (by norm_num)
      have hpi : OrdinalPi0 (2 : Ordinal) (U : Set X) :=
        ordinalPi0_two_iff_isGδ.2 U.property.isGδ
      rw [zero_add, one_add_one_eq_two]
      change OrdinalSigma0 2 (U : Set X) ∧ OrdinalPi0 2 (U : Set X)
      exact ⟨hsigma, hpi⟩
  | empty =>
      change OrdinalDelta0 (((0 : Ordinal) + 1) + 1) (∅ : Set X)
      have hdelta : OrdinalDelta0 (2 : Ordinal) (∅ : Set X) :=
        ⟨ordinalSigma0_of_isClopen (by norm_num) isOpen_empty isClosed_empty,
          ordinalPi0_of_isClopen (by norm_num) isOpen_empty isClosed_empty⟩
      simpa only [zero_add, one_add_one_eq_two] using hdelta
  | compl c ih =>
      have hle : (c.constructionRank + 1) + 1 ≤ ((c.constructionRank + 1) + 1) + 1 :=
        le_of_lt (lt_add_one _)
      change OrdinalDelta0 (((c.constructionRank + 1) + 1) + 1)
        (GeneratedCode.eval c)ᶜ
      exact ih.compl.mono hle
  | iUnion c ih =>
      let r := GeneratedCode.constructionRank (.iUnion c)
      have hsigma : OrdinalSigma0 (r + 1) (⋃ n, GeneratedCode.eval (c n)) := by
        apply OrdinalSigma0.iUnion
        intro n
        apply (ih n).1.mono
        have hn : GeneratedCode.constructionRank (c n) + 1 ≤ r :=
          Order.add_one_le_iff.mpr (GeneratedCode.constructionRank_lt_iUnion c n)
        exact add_le_add_left hn 1
      have hdelta : OrdinalDelta0 ((r + 1) + 1) (⋃ n, GeneratedCode.eval (c n)) :=
        ⟨hsigma.mono (le_of_lt (lt_add_one _)), hsigma.toPi0_succ⟩
      change OrdinalDelta0 ((r + 1) + 1) (⋃ n, GeneratedCode.eval (c n))
      exact hdelta

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(c.constructionRank + 1) + 1, ?_, eval_mem_delta_bound c⟩
  exact (isSuccLimit_omega 1).succ_lt ((isSuccLimit_omega 1).succ_lt
    c.constructionRank_lt_omega_one)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ordinalPi0_of_ne_zero_one
statement:
theorem ordinalPi0_of_ne_zero_one {i : Ordinal.{0}} (hi0 : i ≠ 0) (hi1 : i ≠ 1)
    {s : Set X} :
    OrdinalPi0 i s ↔ ∃ f : ℕ → Set X, ∃ j : ℕ → Set.Iio i,
      (∀ n, OrdinalSigma0 (j n).1 (f n)) ∧ s = ⋂ n, f n
proof:
:= by
  change s ∈ (ordinalBorelClasses X i).2 ↔ ∃ f : ℕ → Set X, ∃ j : ℕ → Set.Iio i,
    (∀ n, f n ∈ (ordinalBorelClasses X (j n).1).1) ∧ s = ⋂ n, f n
  rw [ordinalBorelClasses.eq_1, if_neg hi0, if_neg hi1]
  rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ordinalPi0_of_isClopen
statement:
theorem ordinalPi0_of_isClopen {i : Ordinal.{0}} {s : Set X} (hi : 0 < i)
    (hsOpen : IsOpen s) (hsClosed : IsClosed s) : OrdinalPi0 i s
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi1 : i = 1
  · subst i
    exact ordinalPi0_one_iff.2 hsClosed
  · have h1i : (1 : Ordinal) < i :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hi)) (Ne.symm hi1)
    refine (ordinalPi0_of_ne_zero_one (ne_of_gt hi) hi1).2
      ⟨fun _ => s, fun _ => ⟨1, h1i⟩, fun _ => ordinalSigma0_one_iff.2 hsOpen, ?_⟩
    ext x
    simp

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ordinalSigma0_two_iff_eq_iUnion_isClosed
statement:
theorem ordinalSigma0_two_iff_eq_iUnion_isClosed {s : Set X} :
    OrdinalSigma0 2 s ↔ ∃ f : ℕ → Set X, (∀ n, IsClosed (f n)) ∧ s = ⋃ n, f n
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordinalSigma0_of_ne_zero_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, j, hf, hsf⟩
    refine ⟨f, ?_, hsf⟩
    intro n
    have hjlt : (j n).1 < (1 : Ordinal) + 1 := by
      rw [one_add_one_eq_two]
      exact (j n).property
    have hjle : (j n).1 ≤ (1 : Ordinal) := Order.lt_add_one_iff.mp hjlt
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hjle with h1 | h0
    · simpa [h1] using hf n
    · have hj0 : (j n).1 = 0 := Order.lt_one_iff.mp h0
      exact (ordinalPi0_zero (f n) (by simpa [hj0] using hf n)).elim
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, hsf⟩
    refine ⟨f, fun _ => ⟨1, by norm_num⟩, ?_, hsf⟩
    intro n
    simpa using hf n

proof:
:=
  ordinalSigma0_two_iff_eq_iUnion_isClosed.trans sigma0_two_iff_eq_iUnion_isClosed.symm

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.OrdinalSigma0.measurableSet
statement:
theorem OrdinalSigma0.measurableSet {i : Ordinal.{0}} {s : Set X}
    (hs : OrdinalSigma0 i s) : @MeasurableSet X (borel X) s
proof:
:= by
  induction i using WellFoundedLT.induction generalizing s with
  | ind i ih =>
      by_cases hi0 : i = 0
      · subst i
        exact (ordinalSigma0_zero s hs).elim
      by_cases hi1 : i = 1
      · subst i
        exact MeasurableSpace.GenerateMeasurable.basic s (ordinalSigma0_one_iff.1 hs)
      obtain ⟨f, j, hf, rfl⟩ := (ordinalSigma0_of_ne_zero_one hi0 hi1).1 hs
      exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n => by
        have hc : OrdinalSigma0 (j n).1 (f n)ᶜ :=
          (ordinalSigma0_compl_iff_pi0 (j n).1 (f n)).2 (hf n)
        simpa using (ih (j n).1 (j n).2 hc).compl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.OrdinalSigma0.union
statement:
theorem OrdinalSigma0.union {i : Ordinal.{0}} {s t : Set X}
    (hs : OrdinalSigma0 i s) (ht : OrdinalSigma0 i t) : OrdinalSigma0 i (s ∪ t)
proof:
:= by
  have h : OrdinalSigma0 i (⋃ n : ℕ, if n = 0 then s else t) :=
    OrdinalSigma0.iUnion fun n => by
      split_ifs
      · exact hs
      · exact ht
  convert h using 1
  ext x
  simp only [mem_union, mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro (hx | hx)
    · exact ⟨0, by simpa⟩
    · exact ⟨1, by simpa⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    by_cases h0 : n = 0
    · exact Or.inl (by simpa [h0] using hn)
    · exact Or.inr (by simpa [h0] using hn)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.OrdinalPi0.inter
statement:
theorem OrdinalPi0.inter {i : Ordinal.{0}} {s t : Set X}
    (hs : OrdinalPi0 i s) (ht : OrdinalPi0 i t) : OrdinalPi0 i (s ∩ t)
proof:
:= by
  have h : OrdinalPi0 i (⋂ n : ℕ, if n = 0 then s else t) :=
    OrdinalPi0.iInter fun n => by
      split_ifs
      · exact hs
      · exact ht
  convert h using 1
  ext x
  simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_iInter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hsx, htx⟩ n
    by_cases h0 : n = 0
    · simpa [h0]
    · simpa [h0]
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨by simpa using hx 0, by simpa using hx 1⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.OrdinalDelta0.mono
statement:
theorem OrdinalDelta0.mono [PerfectlyNormalSpace X] {i k : Ordinal.{0}} (hik : i ≤ k)
    {s : Set X} (hs : OrdinalDelta0 i s) : OrdinalDelta0 k s
proof:
:=
  ⟨hs.1.mono hik, hs.2.mono hik⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.OrdinalSigma0.inter
statement:
theorem OrdinalSigma0.inter [PerfectlyNormalSpace X] {i : Ordinal.{0}} {s t : Set X}
    (hs : OrdinalSigma0 i s) (ht : OrdinalSigma0 i t) : OrdinalSigma0 i (s ∩ t)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    exact (ordinalSigma0_zero s hs).elim
  by_cases hi1 : i = 1
  · subst i
    exact ordinalSigma0_one_iff.2 ((ordinalSigma0_one_iff.1 hs).inter
      (ordinalSigma0_one_iff.1 ht))
  obtain ⟨f, j, hf, rfl⟩ := (ordinalSigma0_of_ne_zero_one hi0 hi1).1 hs
  obtain ⟨g, k, hg, rfl⟩ := (ordinalSigma0_of_ne_zero_one hi0 hi1).1 ht
  refine (ordinalSigma0_of_ne_zero_one hi0 hi1).2
    ⟨fun n => f n.unpair.1 ∩ g n.unpair.2,
      fun n => ⟨max (j n.unpair.1).1 (k n.unpair.2).1,
        by
          change max (j n.unpair.1).1 (k n.unpair.2).1 < i
          exact max_lt (j n.unpair.1).2 (k n.unpair.2).2⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n
    exact ((hf n.unpair.1).mono (le_max_left _ _)).inter
      ((hg n.unpair.2).mono (le_max_right _ _))
  · symm
    change (⋃ n : ℕ, f (Nat.unpair n).1 ∩ g (Nat.unpair n).2) = _
    rw [Set.iUnion_unpair (fun a b => f a ∩ g b)]
    ext x
    simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_inter_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, b, hfa, hgb⟩
      exact ⟨⟨a, hfa⟩, ⟨b, hgb⟩⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨a, hfa⟩, ⟨b, hgb⟩⟩
      exact ⟨a, b, hfa, hgb⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.OrdinalDelta0.inter
statement:
theorem OrdinalDelta0.inter [PerfectlyNormalSpace X] {i : Ordinal.{0}} {s t : Set X}
    (hs : OrdinalDelta0 i s) (ht : OrdinalDelta0 i t) : OrdinalDelta0 i (s ∩ t)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hs.1.inter ht.1, hs.2.inter ht.2⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isLeast_borelPiRank

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ordinalSigma0_iff_borelSigmaRank_le
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hi
    exact (isLeast_borelSigmaRank hs).2 hi
  · intro hi

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.borelSigmaRank_lt_omega_one
statement:
theorem borelSigmaRank_lt_omega_one {s : Set X}
    (hs : @MeasurableSet X (borel X) s) : borelSigmaRank s hs < ω₁
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, his⟩ := borelMeasurableSet_exists_countable_ordinalDelta0 hs
  exact ((ordinalSigma0_iff_borelSigmaRank_le hs i).1 his.1).trans_lt hi

theorem borelDeltaRank_congr {s t : Set X} (hst : s = t)
    (hs : @MeasurableSet X (borel X) s) (ht : @MeasurableSet X (borel X) t) :

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.borelSigmaRank_compl
statement:
theorem borelSigmaRank_compl {s : Set X} (hs : @MeasurableSet X (borel X) s) :
    borelSigmaRank sᶜ hs.compl = borelPiRank s hs
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (ordinalSigma0_iff_borelSigmaRank_le hs.compl _).1
      (ordinalPi0_borelPiRank hs).compl
  · have hpi : OrdinalPi0 (borelSigmaRank sᶜ hs.compl) s := by
      simpa using (ordinalSigma0_borelSigmaRank hs.compl).compl
    exact (ordinalPi0_iff_borelPiRank_le hs _).1 hpi

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.borelSigmaRank_le_borelDeltaRank
proof:
:=
  (ordinalSigma0_iff_borelSigmaRank_le hs _).1 (ordinalDelta0_borelDeltaRank hs).1

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.borelPiRank_le_borelDeltaRank
proof:

  (ordinalPi0_iff_borelPiRank_le hs _).1 (ordinalDelta0_borelDeltaRank hs).2

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.one_le_borelPiRank
statement:
private theorem one_le_borelPiRank {s : Set X}
    (hs : @MeasurableSet X (borel X) s) : 1 ≤ borelPiRank s hs
proof:
:= by
  exact Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr fun hzero =>
    ordinalPi0_zero s (hzero ▸ ordinalPi0_borelPiRank hs)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.one_le_borelDeltaRank
statement:
private theorem one_le_borelDeltaRank {s : Set X}
    (hs : @MeasurableSet X (borel X) s) : 1 ≤ borelDeltaRank s hs
proof:
:= by
  exact Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr fun hzero =>
    ordinalSigma0_zero s (hzero ▸ (ordinalDelta0_borelDeltaRank hs).1)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.borelDeltaRank_eq_one_of_isClopen
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm ((ordinalDelta0_iff_borelDeltaRank_le hm 1).1
    ⟨ordinalSigma0_one_iff.2 hsOpen, ordinalPi0_one_iff.2 hsClosed⟩)
    (one_le_borelDeltaRank hm)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.borelSigmaRank_eq_of_ordinalSigma0_not_ordinalPi0
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (ordinalSigma0_iff_borelSigmaRank_le hm i).1 hs
  · by_contra hle
    have hlt : borelSigmaRank s hm < i := lt_of_not_ge hle
    apply hpi
    exact (ordinalSigma0_borelSigmaRank hm).toPi0_succ.mono
      (Order.add_one_le_iff.mpr hlt)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.GeneratedCode.eval_basic
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_basic (i : ι) : eval (.basic i : GeneratedCode g) = g i
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.GeneratedCode.eval_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_empty : eval (.empty : GeneratedCode g) = ∅
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.GeneratedCode.eval_union
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_union (c d : GeneratedCode g) : eval (union c d) = eval c ∪ eval d
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [union, eval_iUnion, mem_iUnion, mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    by_cases h : n = 0
    · left
      simpa [h] using hn
    · right
      simpa [h] using hn
  · rintro (hx | hx)
    · exact ⟨0, by simpa using hx⟩
    · exact ⟨1, by simpa using hx⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.GeneratedCode.eval_inter

proof:

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.GeneratedCode.equiv_iff
statement: theorem equiv_iff (c d : GeneratedCode g) : c ≈ d ↔ c.eval = d.eval
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.GeneratedCode.generateMeasurable_eval
statement:
theorem generateMeasurable_eval (c : GeneratedCode g) :
    GenerateMeasurable (range g) c.eval
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | basic i => exact .basic _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  | empty => exact .empty
  | compl c ih => exact .compl _ ih
  | iUnion c ih => exact .iUnion _ ih

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.sigma0_succ_succ
statement:
theorem sigma0_succ_succ {n : ℕ} {s : Set X} :
    Sigma0 (n + 2) s ↔ ∃ f : ℕ → Set X, (∀ i, Pi0 (n + 1) (f i)) ∧ s = ⋃ i, f i
proof:
:= by

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.pi0_succ_succ
statement:
theorem pi0_succ_succ {n : ℕ} {s : Set X} :
    Pi0 (n + 2) s ↔ ∃ f : ℕ → Set X, (∀ i, Sigma0 (n + 1) (f i)) ∧ s = ⋂ i, f i

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Sigma0.compl
statement: theorem Sigma0.compl {n : ℕ} {s : Set X} (hs : Sigma0 n s) : Pi0 n sᶜ

  (pi0_compl_iff_sigma0 n s).2 hs

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Pi0.compl
statement: theorem Pi0.compl {n : ℕ} {s : Set X} (hs : Pi0 n s) : Sigma0 n sᶜ
proof:

  (sigma0_compl_iff_pi0 n s).2 hs

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.pi0_one_of_isClosed
statement: theorem pi0_one_of_isClosed {s : Set X} (hs : IsClosed s) : Pi0 1 s
proof:
:=
  pi0_one_iff.2 hs

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.sigma0_two_of_isClosed
statement: theorem sigma0_two_of_isClosed {s : Set X} (hs : IsClosed s) : Sigma0 2 s
proof:
:= by
  refine sigma0_succ_succ.2 ⟨fun _ => s, fun _ => pi0_one_of_isClosed hs, ?_⟩
  ext x
  simp

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.pi0_two_iff_isGδ
statement: theorem pi0_two_iff_isGδ {s : Set X} : Pi0 2 s ↔ IsGδ s

:=
  pi0_succ_succ.trans isGδ_iff_eq_iInter_nat.symm

statement: theorem sigma0_two_iff_isGδ_compl {s : Set X} : Sigma0 2 s ↔ IsGδ sᶜ
