name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Pi0.measurableSet
statement:
theorem Pi0.measurableSet {n : ℕ} {s : Set X} (hs : Pi0 n s) :
    @MeasurableSet X (borel X) s
proof:
:= by
  simpa using hs.compl.measurableSet.compl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Delta0.measurableSet
statement:
theorem Delta0.measurableSet {n : ℕ} {s : Set X} (hs : Delta0 n s) :
    @MeasurableSet X (borel X) s
proof:
:=
  hs.1.measurableSet

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Delta0.preimage
statement:
theorem Delta0.preimage {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace Y] {n : ℕ} {s : Set Y}
    (hs : Delta0 n s) {f : X → Y} (hf : Continuous f) : Delta0 n (f ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hs.1.preimage hf, hs.2.preimage hf⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Sigma0.iUnion
statement:
theorem Sigma0.iUnion {n : ℕ} {s : ℕ → Set X} (hs : ∀ i, Sigma0 n (s i)) :
    Sigma0 n (⋃ i, s i)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => exact (sigma0_zero (s 0) (hs 0)).elim
  | one => exact sigma0_one_iff.2 (isOpen_iUnion fun i => sigma0_one_iff.1 (hs i))
  | more n _ _ =>
      choose f hf hsf using fun i => sigma0_succ_succ.1 (hs i)
      refine sigma0_succ_succ.2
        ⟨fun k => f k.unpair.1 k.unpair.2, fun k => hf k.unpair.1 k.unpair.2, ?_⟩
      rw [Set.iUnion_unpair]
      simp_rw [hsf]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Pi0.inter
statement:
theorem Pi0.inter {n : ℕ} {s t : Set X} (hs : Pi0 n s) (ht : Pi0 n t) :
    Pi0 n (s ∩ t)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Pi0 n (⋂ i : ℕ, if i = 0 then s else t) := Pi0.iInter fun i => by
    split_ifs
    · exact hs
    · exact ht
  convert h using 1
  ext x
  simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_iInter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hsx, htx⟩ i
    by_cases h0 : i = 0
    · simpa [h0]
    · simpa [h0]
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨by simpa using hx 0, by simpa using hx 1⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Sigma0.inter
statement:
theorem Sigma0.inter {n : ℕ} {s t : Set X} (hs : Sigma0 n s) (ht : Sigma0 n t) :
    Sigma0 n (s ∩ t)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction generalizing s t with
  | zero => exact (sigma0_zero s hs).elim
  | one => exact sigma0_one_iff.2 ((sigma0_one_iff.1 hs).inter (sigma0_one_iff.1 ht))
  | more n _ _ =>
      obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := sigma0_succ_succ.1 hs
      obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := sigma0_succ_succ.1 ht
      refine sigma0_succ_succ.2
        ⟨fun k => f k.unpair.1 ∩ g k.unpair.2,
          fun k => (hf k.unpair.1).inter (hg k.unpair.2), ?_⟩
      symm
      change (⋃ k : ℕ, f (Nat.unpair k).1 ∩ g (Nat.unpair k).2) = _
      rw [Set.iUnion_unpair (fun i j => f i ∩ g j)]
      ext x
      simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_inter_iff]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨i, j, hfi, hgj⟩
        exact ⟨⟨i, hfi⟩, ⟨j, hgj⟩⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨i, hfi⟩, ⟨j, hgj⟩⟩
        exact ⟨i, j, hfi, hgj⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Pi0.union
statement:
theorem Pi0.union {n : ℕ} {s t : Set X} (hs : Pi0 n s) (ht : Pi0 n t) :
    Pi0 n (s ∪ t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.union_eq_compl_compl_inter_compl]
  exact (hs.compl.inter ht.compl).compl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Delta0.union
statement:
theorem Delta0.union {n : ℕ} {s t : Set X} (hs : Delta0 n s) (ht : Delta0 n t) :
    Delta0 n (s ∪ t)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hs.1.union ht.1, hs.2.union ht.2⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Delta0.inter
statement:
theorem Delta0.inter {n : ℕ} {s t : Set X} (hs : Delta0 n s) (ht : Delta0 n t) :
    Delta0 n (s ∩ t)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hs.1.inter ht.1, hs.2.inter ht.2⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.sigma0_empty_univ
statement:
private theorem sigma0_empty_univ (n : ℕ) :
    Sigma0 (n + 1) (∅ : Set X) ∧ Sigma0 (n + 1) (Set.univ : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      constructor
      · refine sigma0_succ_succ.2 ⟨fun _ => ∅, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro i
          simpa using ih.2.compl
        · ext x
          simp
      · refine sigma0_succ_succ.2 ⟨fun _ => Set.univ, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro i
          simpa using ih.1.compl
        · ext x
          simp

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.sigma0_empty
statement: theorem sigma0_empty {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : Sigma0 n (∅ : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp at hn
  | succ n => simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using (sigma0_empty_univ (X := X) n).1

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.sigma0_univ
statement: theorem sigma0_univ {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : Sigma0 n (Set.univ : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp at hn
  | succ n => simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using (sigma0_empty_univ (X := X) n).2

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.pi0_empty
statement: theorem pi0_empty {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : Pi0 n (∅ : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using (sigma0_univ (X := X) hn).compl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.pi0_univ
statement: theorem pi0_univ {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : Pi0 n (Set.univ : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using (sigma0_empty (X := X) hn).compl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.delta0_empty
statement: theorem delta0_empty {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : Delta0 n (∅ : Set X)
proof:
:=
  ⟨sigma0_empty hn, pi0_empty hn⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.delta0_univ
statement: theorem delta0_univ {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : Delta0 n (Set.univ : Set X)
proof:
:=
  ⟨sigma0_univ hn, pi0_univ hn⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Sigma0.iUnion_finset
statement:
theorem Sigma0.iUnion_finset {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (I : Finset ι)
    {s : ι → Set X} (hs : ∀ i ∈ I, Sigma0 n (s i)) : Sigma0 n (⋃ i ∈ I, s i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction I using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using sigma0_empty (X := X) hn
  | @insert a I ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.set_biUnion_insert]
      exact (hs a (Finset.mem_insert_self a I)).union
        (ih fun i hi => hs i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Sigma0.iInter_finset
statement:
theorem Sigma0.iInter_finset {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (I : Finset ι)
    {s : ι → Set X} (hs : ∀ i ∈ I, Sigma0 n (s i)) : Sigma0 n (⋂ i ∈ I, s i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction I using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using sigma0_univ (X := X) hn
  | @insert a I ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.set_biInter_insert]
      exact (hs a (Finset.mem_insert_self a I)).inter
        (ih fun i hi => hs i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Pi0.iUnion_finset
statement:
theorem Pi0.iUnion_finset {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (I : Finset ι)
    {s : ι → Set X} (hs : ∀ i ∈ I, Pi0 n (s i)) : Pi0 n (⋃ i ∈ I, s i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction I using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using pi0_empty (X := X) hn
  | @insert a I ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.set_biUnion_insert]
      exact (hs a (Finset.mem_insert_self a I)).union
        (ih fun i hi => hs i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Pi0.iInter_finset
statement:
theorem Pi0.iInter_finset {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (I : Finset ι)
    {s : ι → Set X} (hs : ∀ i ∈ I, Pi0 n (s i)) : Pi0 n (⋂ i ∈ I, s i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction I using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using pi0_univ (X := X) hn
  | @insert a I ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.set_biInter_insert]
      exact (hs a (Finset.mem_insert_self a I)).inter
        (ih fun i hi => hs i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Delta0.iUnion_finset
statement:
theorem Delta0.iUnion_finset {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (I : Finset ι)
    {s : ι → Set X} (hs : ∀ i ∈ I, Delta0 n (s i)) : Delta0 n (⋃ i ∈ I, s i)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Sigma0.iUnion_finset hn I fun i hi => (hs i hi).1,
    Pi0.iUnion_finset hn I fun i hi => (hs i hi).2⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Delta0.iInter_finset
statement:
theorem Delta0.iInter_finset {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (I : Finset ι)
    {s : ι → Set X} (hs : ∀ i ∈ I, Delta0 n (s i)) : Delta0 n (⋂ i ∈ I, s i)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Sigma0.iInter_finset hn I fun i hi => (hs i hi).1,
    Pi0.iInter_finset hn I fun i hi => (hs i hi).2⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Sigma0.mono_succ
statement:
theorem Sigma0.mono_succ [PerfectlyNormalSpace X] {n : ℕ} {s : Set X}
    (hs : Sigma0 (n + 1) s) : Sigma0 (n + 2) s
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero =>
      exact sigma0_two_iff_isGδ_compl.2
        (isClosed_compl_iff.mpr (sigma0_one_iff.1 hs)).isGδ
  | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := sigma0_succ_succ.1 hs
      refine sigma0_succ_succ.2 ⟨f, ?_, rfl⟩
      intro i
      simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using (ih (hf i).compl).compl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Pi0.mono_succ
statement:
theorem Pi0.mono_succ [PerfectlyNormalSpace X] {n : ℕ} {s : Set X}
    (hs : Pi0 (n + 1) s) : Pi0 (n + 2) s
proof:
:= by
  simpa using hs.compl.mono_succ.compl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Delta0.mono_succ
statement:
theorem Delta0.mono_succ [PerfectlyNormalSpace X] {n : ℕ} {s : Set X}
    (hs : Delta0 (n + 1) s) : Delta0 (n + 2) s
proof:
:=
  ⟨hs.1.mono_succ, hs.2.mono_succ⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Sigma0.mono
statement:
theorem Sigma0.mono [PerfectlyNormalSpace X] {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) {s : Set X}
    (hs : Sigma0 m s) : Sigma0 n s
proof:
:= by
  induction n, hmn using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact hs
  | succ n _ ih =>
      cases n with
      | zero => exact (sigma0_zero s ih).elim
      | succ n => simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using ih.mono_succ

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Pi0.mono
statement:
theorem Pi0.mono [PerfectlyNormalSpace X] {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) {s : Set X}
    (hs : Pi0 m s) : Pi0 n s
proof:
:= by
  simpa using hs.compl.mono hmn |>.compl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Delta0.mono
statement:
theorem Delta0.mono [PerfectlyNormalSpace X] {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) {s : Set X}
    (hs : Delta0 m s) : Delta0 n s
proof:
:=
  ⟨hs.1.mono hmn, hs.2.mono hmn⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Sigma0.exists_borelCode
statement:
theorem Sigma0.exists_borelCode {n : ℕ} {s : Set X} (hs : Sigma0 n s) :
    ∃ c : BorelCode X, c.eval = s
proof:
:=
  BorelCode.borelMeasurableSet_iff_exists_code.1 hs.measurableSet

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Pi0.exists_borelCode
statement:
theorem Pi0.exists_borelCode {n : ℕ} {s : Set X} (hs : Pi0 n s) :
    ∃ c : BorelCode X, c.eval = s
proof:
:=
  BorelCode.borelMeasurableSet_iff_exists_code.1 hs.measurableSet

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Delta0.exists_borelCode
statement:
theorem Delta0.exists_borelCode {n : ℕ} {s : Set X} (hs : Delta0 n s) :
    ∃ c : BorelCode X, c.eval = s
proof:
:=
  hs.1.exists_borelCode

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.GeneratedCode.constructionRank_basic
statement:
@[simp] theorem constructionRank_basic (i : ι) :
    constructionRank (.basic i : GeneratedCode g) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.GeneratedCode.constructionRank_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem constructionRank_empty :
    constructionRank (.empty : GeneratedCode g) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.GeneratedCode.constructionRank_compl
statement:
@[simp] theorem constructionRank_compl (c : GeneratedCode g) :
    constructionRank (.compl c) = constructionRank c + 1
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.GeneratedCode.constructionRank_iUnion
statement:
@[simp] theorem constructionRank_iUnion (c : ℕ → GeneratedCode g) :
    constructionRank (.iUnion c) = ⨆ n, constructionRank (c n) + 1
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.GeneratedCode.constructionRank_lt_iUnion
statement:
theorem constructionRank_lt_iUnion (c : ℕ → GeneratedCode g) (n : ℕ) :
    constructionRank (c n) < constructionRank (.iUnion c)
proof:
:=
  Ordinal.lt_iSup_add_one (fun n => constructionRank (c n)) n

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.GeneratedCode.constructionRank_lt_omega_one
statement: theorem constructionRank_lt_omega_one (c : GeneratedCode g) : constructionRank c < ω₁
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | basic i => exact omega_pos 1
  | empty => exact omega_pos 1
  | compl c ih => exact (isSuccLimit_omega 1).succ_lt ih
  | iUnion c ih =>
      apply Ordinal.iSup_lt_omega_one
      intro n
      exact (isSuccLimit_omega 1).succ_lt (ih n)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.GeneratedCode.eval_mem_generateMeasurableRec
statement:
theorem eval_mem_generateMeasurableRec (c : GeneratedCode g) :
    c.eval ∈ generateMeasurableRec (range g) c.constructionRank
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | basic i => exact self_subset_generateMeasurableRec (range g) 0 ⟨i, rfl⟩
  | empty => exact empty_mem_generateMeasurableRec (range g) 0
  | compl c ih => exact compl_mem_generateMeasurableRec (lt_add_one _) ih
  | iUnion c ih =>
      exact iUnion_mem_generateMeasurableRec fun n =>
        ⟨constructionRank (c n), constructionRank_lt_iUnion c n, ih n⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.range_openGenerator
statement:
@[simp] theorem range_openGenerator (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] :
    range (openGenerator X) = {s : Set X | IsOpen s}
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  simp [openGenerator]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelCode.eval_basic
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_basic (s : Set X) (hs : IsOpen s) : eval (basic s hs) = s
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelCode.eval_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_empty : eval (empty : BorelCode X) = ∅
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelCode.eval_compl
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_compl (c : BorelCode X) : eval (compl c) = (eval c)ᶜ
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelCode.eval_iUnion
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_iUnion (c : ℕ → BorelCode X) : eval (iUnion c) = ⋃ n, eval (c n)
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelCode.eval_union
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_union (c d : BorelCode X) : eval (union c d) = eval c ∪ eval d
proof:
:= by
  change GeneratedCode.eval (GeneratedCode.union c d) =
    GeneratedCode.eval c ∪ GeneratedCode.eval d
  exact GeneratedCode.eval_union c d

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelCode.eval_inter
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_inter (c d : BorelCode X) : eval (inter c d) = eval c ∩ eval d
proof:
:= by
  change GeneratedCode.eval (GeneratedCode.inter c d) =
    GeneratedCode.eval c ∩ GeneratedCode.eval d
  exact GeneratedCode.eval_inter c d

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelCode.eval_diff
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_diff (c d : BorelCode X) : eval (diff c d) = eval c \ eval d
proof:
:= by
  change GeneratedCode.eval (GeneratedCode.diff c d) =
    GeneratedCode.eval c \ GeneratedCode.eval d
  exact GeneratedCode.eval_diff c d

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelCode.eval_iInter
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_iInter (c : ℕ → BorelCode X) : eval (iInter c) = ⋂ n, eval (c n)
proof:
:= by
  change GeneratedCode.eval (GeneratedCode.iInter c) = ⋂ n, GeneratedCode.eval (c n)
  exact GeneratedCode.eval_iInter c

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelCode.equiv_iff
statement: theorem equiv_iff (c d : BorelCode X) : c ≈ d ↔ eval c = eval d
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelCode.eval_comap
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_comap {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : X → Y) (hf : Continuous f)
    (c : BorelCode Y) : eval (comap f hf c) = f ⁻¹' eval c
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | basic U => rfl
  | empty => rfl
  | compl c ih =>
      change (GeneratedCode.eval (comap f hf c))ᶜ = f ⁻¹' (GeneratedCode.eval c)ᶜ
      rw [preimage_compl]
      exact congrArg (fun s : Set X => sᶜ) ih
  | iUnion c ih =>
      change (⋃ n, GeneratedCode.eval (comap f hf (c n))) =
        f ⁻¹' ⋃ n, GeneratedCode.eval (c n)
      rw [preimage_iUnion]
      exact iUnion_congr ih

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelCode.measurableSet_eval
statement: theorem measurableSet_eval (c : BorelCode X) : @MeasurableSet X (borel X) c.eval
proof:
:= by
  change GenerateMeasurable {s : Set X | IsOpen s} c.eval
  rw [← range_openGenerator X]
  exact GeneratedCode.generateMeasurable_eval c

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelCode.borelMeasurableSet_iff_exists_code
statement:
theorem borelMeasurableSet_iff_exists_code {s : Set X} :
    @MeasurableSet X (borel X) s ↔ ∃ c : BorelCode X, c.eval = s
proof:
:= by
  change GenerateMeasurable {s : Set X | IsOpen s} s ↔ _
  rw [← range_openGenerator X]
  exact GeneratedCode.generateMeasurable_iff_exists_code

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelCode.measurableSet_iff_exists_code
statement:
theorem measurableSet_iff_exists_code [m : MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] {s : Set X} :
    MeasurableSet s ↔ ∃ c : BorelCode X, c.eval = s
proof:
:= by
  have h : m = borel X := BorelSpace.measurable_eq
  rw [h]
  exact borelMeasurableSet_iff_exists_code

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.borelConstructionRanks_nonempty
statement:
private theorem borelConstructionRanks_nonempty {s : Set X}
    (hs : @MeasurableSet X (borel X) s) : (borelConstructionRanks s).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := BorelCode.borelMeasurableSet_iff_exists_code.1 hs
  exact ⟨c.constructionRank, c, hc, rfl⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isLeast_borelRank
statement:
theorem isLeast_borelRank {s : Set X} (hs : @MeasurableSet X (borel X) s) :
    IsLeast (borelConstructionRanks s) (borelRank s hs)
proof:
:= by
  exact isLeast_csInf (borelConstructionRanks_nonempty hs)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.borelRank_proof_irrel
statement:
theorem borelRank_proof_irrel {s : Set X} (hs ht : @MeasurableSet X (borel X) s) :
    borelRank s hs = borelRank s ht
proof: := rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.borelRank_le_constructionRank
statement:
theorem borelRank_le_constructionRank {s : Set X} (hs : @MeasurableSet X (borel X) s)
    (c : BorelCode X) (hc : c.eval = s) : borelRank s hs ≤ c.constructionRank
proof:
:=
  (isLeast_borelRank hs).2 ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_code_constructionRank_eq_borelRank
proof:
:=
  (isLeast_borelRank hs).1

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.borelRank_lt_omega_one
statement:
theorem borelRank_lt_omega_one {s : Set X} (hs : @MeasurableSet X (borel X) s) :
    borelRank s hs < ω₁
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, _, hc⟩ := exists_code_constructionRank_eq_borelRank hs
  rw [← hc]
  exact c.constructionRank_lt_omega_one

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_generateMeasurableRec_borelRank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hr⟩ := exists_code_constructionRank_eq_borelRank hs
  rw [← range_openGenerator X, ← hr, ← hc]
  exact c.eval_mem_generateMeasurableRec

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.borelRank_eq_zero_of_isOpen
statement:
theorem borelRank_eq_zero_of_isOpen {s : Set X} (hs : IsOpen s) :
    borelRank s (GenerateMeasurable.basic s hs) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact borelRank_le_constructionRank _ (BorelCode.basic s hs) rfl
  · exact bot_le

name: MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.horizontalSection
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.horizontalSection
    [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y]
    {R : Set (X × Y)} (hR : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet R) (y : Y) :
    MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (DescriptiveSetTheory.horizontalSection R y)
proof:
:=
  hR.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_finiteLeastCell_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_finiteLeastCell_iff [Fintype Y] [LinearOrder Y]
    {R : Set (X × Y)} {x : X} {y : Y} :
    x ∈ finiteLeastCell R y ↔
      ∃ hx : x ∈ relationDomain R, finiteLeastSelector R ⟨x, hx⟩ = y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    let hx : x ∈ relationDomain R := ⟨y, h.1⟩
    exact ⟨hx, (finiteLeastSelector_eq_iff R ⟨x, hx⟩ y).mpr h⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hxy⟩
    exact (finiteLeastSelector_eq_iff R ⟨x, hx⟩ y).mp hxy

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.baireMeasurableSet_finiteLeastCell
statement:
theorem baireMeasurableSet_finiteLeastCell
    [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y]
    [Finite Y] [LinearOrder Y]
    {R : Set (X × Y)} (hR : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet R) (y : Y) :
    BaireMeasurableSet (finiteLeastCell R y)
proof:
:= by
  have hsection (z : Y) :
      BaireMeasurableSet (DescriptiveSetTheory.horizontalSection R z) :=
    (MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.horizontalSection hR z).baireMeasurableSet
  have hAll : BaireMeasurableSet {x : X | ∀ z, (x, z) ∈ R → y ≤ z} := by
    have hEq : {x : X | ∀ z, (x, z) ∈ R → y ≤ z} =
        ⋂ z, {x : X | (x, z) ∈ R → y ≤ z} := by
      ext x
      simp
    rw [hEq]
    apply BaireMeasurableSet.iInter
    intro z
    by_cases hyz : y ≤ z
    · convert isOpen_univ.baireMeasurableSet using 1
      ext x
      simp [hyz]
    · convert (hsection z).compl using 1
      ext x
      simp [hyz]
  exact (hsection y).inter hAll

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.baireMeasurableSet_relationDomain_of_analytic_countable
statement:
theorem baireMeasurableSet_relationDomain_of_analytic_countable
    [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y]
    [Countable Y]
    {R : Set (X × Y)} (hR : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet R) :
    BaireMeasurableSet (relationDomain R)
proof:
:= by
  have hEq : relationDomain R =
      ⋃ y, DescriptiveSetTheory.horizontalSection R y := by
    ext x
    simp [relationDomain]
  rw [hEq]
  exact BaireMeasurableSet.iUnion fun y =>
    (MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.horizontalSection hR y).baireMeasurableSet

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ambientPreimage_finiteLeastSelector
statement:
theorem ambientPreimage_finiteLeastSelector [Fintype Y] [LinearOrder Y]
    (R : Set (X × Y)) (t : Set Y) :
    {x | ∃ hx : x ∈ relationDomain R, finiteLeastSelector R ⟨x, hx⟩ ∈ t} =
      ⋃ y, ⋃ (_ : y ∈ t), finiteLeastCell R y
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hxt⟩
    let y := finiteLeastSelector R ⟨x, hx⟩
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨y, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hxt, ?_⟩⟩
    exact mem_finiteLeastCell_iff.mpr ⟨hx, rfl⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    obtain ⟨hyt, hcell⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy
    obtain ⟨hdom, hselector⟩ := mem_finiteLeastCell_iff.mp hcell
    exact ⟨hdom, hselector.symm ▸ hyt⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.hasBaireMeasurableAmbientPreimages_finiteLeastSelector
statement:
theorem hasBaireMeasurableAmbientPreimages_finiteLeastSelector
    [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y]
    [Fintype Y] [LinearOrder Y]
    {R : Set (X × Y)} (hR : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet R) :
    HasBaireMeasurableAmbientPreimages (relationDomain R) (finiteLeastSelector R)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  rw [ambientPreimage_finiteLeastSelector]
  exact BaireMeasurableSet.iUnion fun y => BaireMeasurableSet.iUnion fun _ =>
    baireMeasurableSet_finiteLeastCell hR y

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.analytic_finite_uniformization
statement:
theorem analytic_finite_uniformization
    [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y]
    [Fintype Y] [LinearOrder Y]
    {R : Set (X × Y)} (hR : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet R) :
    Uniformizes R (partialGraph (relationDomain R) (finiteLeastSelector R)) ∧
      HasBaireMeasurableAmbientPreimages (relationDomain R) (finiteLeastSelector R)
proof:
:=
  ⟨uniformizes_partialGraph_finiteLeastSelector R,
    hasBaireMeasurableAmbientPreimages_finiteLeastSelector hR⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_finiteTargetPiece_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_finiteTargetPiece_iff {R : Set (X × Y)} {x : X} {y z : Y} :
    (x, z) ∈ finiteTargetPiece R y ↔ (x, y) ∈ R ∧ y = z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hvalue⟩
    exact ⟨hx, hvalue⟩
  · rintro ⟨hxy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hxy, rfl⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.relationDomain_finiteTargetPiece
statement:
@[simp] theorem relationDomain_finiteTargetPiece (R : Set (X × Y)) (y : Y) :
    relationDomain (finiteTargetPiece R y) = finiteTargetPieceDomain R y
proof:
:=
  relationDomain_partialGraph _ _

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.relationSingleValued_finiteTargetPiece
statement:
theorem relationSingleValued_finiteTargetPiece (R : Set (X × Y)) (y : Y) :
    RelationSingleValued (finiteTargetPiece R y)
proof:
:=
  relationSingleValued_partialGraph _ _

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.finiteTargetPiece_subset
statement:
theorem finiteTargetPiece_subset (R : Set (X × Y)) (y : Y) :
    finiteTargetPiece R y ⊆ R
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, z⟩ hz
  obtain ⟨hxy, hyz⟩ := mem_finiteTargetPiece_iff.mp hz
  exact hyz ▸ hxy

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.disjoint_finiteTargetPiece
statement:
theorem disjoint_finiteTargetPiece (R : Set (X × Y)) {y z : Y} (hyz : y ≠ z) :
    Disjoint (finiteTargetPiece R y) (finiteTargetPiece R z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro p hpy hpz
  have hyp := (mem_finiteTargetPiece_iff.mp hpy).2
  have hzp := (mem_finiteTargetPiece_iff.mp hpz).2
  exact hyz (hyp.trans hzp.symm)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.iUnion_finiteTargetPiece
statement:
theorem iUnion_finiteTargetPiece (R : Set (X × Y)) :
    ⋃ y, finiteTargetPiece R y = R
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  rcases p with ⟨x, y⟩
  constructor
  · intro hp
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp
    exact finiteTargetPiece_subset R z hz
  · intro hxy
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨y, mem_finiteTargetPiece_iff.mpr ⟨hxy, rfl⟩⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.MeasurableSet.measurableSet_finiteTargetPieceDomain
statement:
theorem MeasurableSet.measurableSet_finiteTargetPieceDomain
    [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {R : Set (X × Y)} (hR : MeasurableSet R) (y : Y) :
    MeasurableSet (finiteTargetPieceDomain R y)
proof:
:=
  DescriptiveSetTheory.MeasurableSet.horizontalSection hR y

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurable_finiteTargetPieceSelector
statement:
theorem measurable_finiteTargetPieceSelector
    [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    (R : Set (X × Y)) (y : Y) :
    Measurable (finiteTargetPieceSelector R y)
proof:
:=
  measurable_const

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.MeasurableSet.measurableSet_finiteTargetPiece
statement:
theorem MeasurableSet.measurableSet_finiteTargetPiece
    [MeasurableSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace Y]
    {R : Set (X × Y)} (hR : MeasurableSet R) (y : Y) :
    MeasurableSet (finiteTargetPiece R y)
proof:
:=
  measurableSet_partialGraph
    (DescriptiveSetTheory.MeasurableSet.measurableSet_finiteTargetPieceDomain hR y)
    (measurable_finiteTargetPieceSelector R y)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.MeasurableSet.exists_standardBorelCode_finiteTargetPiece
statement:
theorem MeasurableSet.exists_standardBorelCode_finiteTargetPiece
    [MeasurableSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace Y]
    {R : Set (X × Y)} (hR : MeasurableSet R) (y : Y) :
    ∃ c : StandardBorelCode (X × Y), c.eval = finiteTargetPiece R y
proof:
:=
  StandardBorelCode.exists_code
    (DescriptiveSetTheory.MeasurableSet.measurableSet_finiteTargetPiece hR y)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.MeasurableSet.hasFiniteBorelPartialFunctionDecomposition_of_finiteTarget
statement:
theorem MeasurableSet.hasFiniteBorelPartialFunctionDecomposition_of_finiteTarget
    [MeasurableSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Finite Y]
    {R : Set (X × Y)} (hR : MeasurableSet R) :
    HasFiniteBorelPartialFunctionDecomposition R
proof:
:= by
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite Y
  refine ⟨Y, inferInstance, finiteTargetPieceDomain R, finiteTargetPieceSelector R, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨fun y =>
    DescriptiveSetTheory.MeasurableSet.measurableSet_finiteTargetPieceDomain hR y,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, iUnion_finiteTargetPiece R⟩
  · exact fun y => measurable_finiteTargetPieceSelector R y
  · exact fun y =>
      DescriptiveSetTheory.MeasurableSet.measurableSet_finiteTargetPiece hR y
  · intro y z hyz
    exact disjoint_finiteTargetPiece R hyz

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_relationRestrict
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_relationRestrict {R : Set (X × Y)} {s : Set X} {p : X × Y} :
    p ∈ relationRestrict R s ↔ p ∈ R ∧ p.1 ∈ s
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_partialGraph
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_partialGraph {s : Set X} {f : s → Y} {x : X} {y : Y} :
    (x, y) ∈ partialGraph s f ↔ ∃ hx : x ∈ s, f ⟨x, hx⟩ = y
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.relationDomain_relationRestrict
statement:
@[simp] theorem relationDomain_relationRestrict (R : Set (X × Y)) (s : Set X) :
    relationDomain (relationRestrict R s) = relationDomain R ∩ s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_relationDomain, mem_relationRestrict, mem_inter_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hxy, hx⟩
    exact ⟨⟨y, hxy⟩, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨y, hxy⟩, hx⟩
    exact ⟨y, hxy, hx⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.relationDomain_partialGraph
statement:
@[simp] theorem relationDomain_partialGraph (s : Set X) (f : s → Y) :
    relationDomain (partialGraph s f) = s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hx, _⟩
    exact hx
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨f ⟨x, hx⟩, hx, rfl⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.relationSingleValued_partialGraph
statement:
theorem relationSingleValued_partialGraph (s : Set X) (f : s → Y) :
    RelationSingleValued (partialGraph s f)
proof:
:= by
  rintro x y z ⟨hy, hfy⟩ ⟨hz, hfz⟩
  calc
    y = f ⟨x, hy⟩ := hfy.symm
    _ = f ⟨x, hz⟩ := by congr
    _ = z := hfz

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.uniformizes_partialGraph_iff
statement:
theorem uniformizes_partialGraph_iff {R : Set (X × Y)} {s : Set X} {f : s → Y} :
    Uniformizes R (partialGraph s f) ↔
      s = relationDomain R ∧ ∀ x : s, (x.1, f x) ∈ R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨(relationDomain_partialGraph s f).symm.trans h.2.1, ?_⟩
    intro x
    exact h.1 ⟨x.property, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hs, hf⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, relationSingleValued_partialGraph s f⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, y⟩ ⟨hx, hxy⟩
      simpa [hxy] using hf ⟨x, hx⟩
    · calc
        relationDomain (partialGraph s f) = s := relationDomain_partialGraph s f
        _ = relationDomain R := hs

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.uniformizes_iff_verticalSection
statement:
theorem uniformizes_iff_verticalSection {R G : Set (X × Y)} :
    Uniformizes R G ↔
      G ⊆ R ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ relationDomain R ↔ ∃! y, y ∈ verticalSection G x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hsub, hdom, hfun⟩
    refine ⟨hsub, fun x => ?_⟩
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rw [← hdom] at hx
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx
      refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
      intro z hz
      exact hfun hz hy
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, _⟩
      rw [← hdom]
      exact ⟨y, hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨hsub, hsections⟩
    refine ⟨hsub, ?_, ?_⟩
    · ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
        exact ⟨y, hsub hy⟩
      · intro hx
        obtain ⟨y, hy, _⟩ := (hsections x).mp hx
        exact ⟨y, hy⟩
    · intro x y z hy hz
      obtain ⟨w, hw, huw⟩ := (hsections x).mp ⟨y, hsub hy⟩
      exact (huw y hy).trans (huw z hz).symm

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Uniformizes.restrict
statement:
theorem Uniformizes.restrict {R G : Set (X × Y)} (h : Uniformizes R G) (s : Set X) :
    Uniformizes (relationRestrict R s) (relationRestrict G s)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨h.1 hp.1, hp.2⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [h.2.1]
  · intro x y z hy hz
    exact h.2.2 hy.1 hz.1

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Uniformizes.comp
statement:
theorem Uniformizes.comp {R G : Set (X × Y)} {S H : Set (Y × Z)}
    (hG : Uniformizes R G) (hH : Uniformizes S H)
    (hrange : relationRange R ⊆ relationDomain S) :
    Uniformizes (relationComp R S) (relationComp G H)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, z⟩ ⟨y, hxy, hyz⟩
    exact ⟨y, hG.1 hxy, hH.1 hyz⟩
  · ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, y, hxy, hyz⟩
      exact ⟨z, y, hG.1 hxy, hH.1 hyz⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, y, hxy, hyz⟩
      have hxR : x ∈ relationDomain R := ⟨y, hxy⟩
      rw [← hG.2.1] at hxR
      obtain ⟨y', hxy'⟩ := hxR
      have hy'S : y' ∈ relationDomain S := hrange ⟨x, hG.1 hxy'⟩
      rw [← hH.2.1] at hy'S
      obtain ⟨z', hy'z'⟩ := hy'S
      exact ⟨z', y', hxy', hy'z'⟩
  · rintro x z z' ⟨y, hxy, hyz⟩ ⟨y', hxy', hy'z'⟩
    have hyy' := hG.2.2 hxy hxy'
    subst y'
    exact hH.2.2 hyz hy'z'

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.choiceSelector_mem
statement:
theorem choiceSelector_mem (R : Set (X × Y)) (x : relationDomain R) :
    (x.1, choiceSelector R x) ∈ R
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec x.property

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.uniformizes_partialGraph_choiceSelector
statement:
theorem uniformizes_partialGraph_choiceSelector (R : Set (X × Y)) :
    Uniformizes R (partialGraph (relationDomain R) (choiceSelector R))
proof:
:=
  uniformizes_partialGraph_iff.mpr ⟨rfl, choiceSelector_mem R⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_sectionHit
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_sectionHit {R : Set (X × Y)} {t : Set Y} {x : X} :
    x ∈ sectionHit R t ↔ (verticalSection R x ∩ t).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hR, -, ht⟩
    exact ⟨y, hR, ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hR, ht⟩
    exact ⟨y, hR, mem_univ y, ht⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.relationDomain_eq_fst_image
statement:
theorem relationDomain_eq_fst_image (R : Set (X × Y)) :
    relationDomain R = Prod.fst '' R
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hxy⟩
    exact ⟨(x, y), hxy, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨p.2, hp⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsClosed.isClosed_relationDomain_of_compactCodomain
statement:
theorem IsClosed.isClosed_relationDomain_of_compactCodomain
    [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y]
    {R : Set (X × Y)} (hR : IsClosed R) : IsClosed (relationDomain R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [relationDomain_eq_fst_image]
  exact isClosedMap_fst_of_compactSpace R hR

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsClosed.isClosed_sectionHit_of_compactCodomain
statement:
theorem IsClosed.isClosed_sectionHit_of_compactCodomain
    [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y]
    {R : Set (X × Y)} (hR : IsClosed R) {t : Set Y} (ht : IsClosed t) :
    IsClosed (sectionHit R t)
proof:
:= by
  apply DescriptiveSetTheory.IsClosed.isClosed_relationDomain_of_compactCodomain
  exact hR.inter (isClosed_univ.prod ht)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsClosed.measurableSet_relationDomain_of_compactCodomain
statement:
theorem IsClosed.measurableSet_relationDomain_of_compactCodomain
    [TopologicalSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [TopologicalSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y]
    {R : Set (X × Y)} (hR : IsClosed R) : MeasurableSet (relationDomain R)
proof:
:=
  (DescriptiveSetTheory.IsClosed.isClosed_relationDomain_of_compactCodomain hR).measurableSet

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsClosed.exists_standardBorelCode_relationDomain_of_compactCodomain
statement:
theorem IsClosed.exists_standardBorelCode_relationDomain_of_compactCodomain
    [TopologicalSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X]
    [TopologicalSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y]
    {R : Set (X × Y)} (hR : IsClosed R) :
    ∃ c : StandardBorelCode X, c.eval = relationDomain R
proof:
:=
  StandardBorelCode.exists_code
    (DescriptiveSetTheory.IsClosed.measurableSet_relationDomain_of_compactCodomain hR)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isClosed_cantorCylinder
statement:
theorem isClosed_cantorCylinder (p : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ) :
    IsClosed (PiNat.cylinder p n)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_cantorSectionHit
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_cantorSectionHit {R : Set (X × (ℕ → Bool))}
    {p : ℕ → Bool} {n : ℕ} {x : X} :
    x ∈ cantorSectionHit R p n ↔
      (verticalSection R x ∩ PiNat.cylinder p n).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  mem_sectionHit

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsClosed.isClosed_cantorSectionHit
statement:
theorem IsClosed.isClosed_cantorSectionHit [TopologicalSpace X]
    {R : Set (X × (ℕ → Bool))} (hR : IsClosed R) (p : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ) :
    IsClosed (cantorSectionHit R p n)
proof:
:=
  DescriptiveSetTheory.IsClosed.isClosed_sectionHit_of_compactCodomain hR
    (isClosed_cantorCylinder p n)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.cantorSectionHit_anti
statement:
theorem cantorSectionHit_anti (R : Set (X × (ℕ → Bool))) (p : ℕ → Bool)
    {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) : cantorSectionHit R p n ⊆ cantorSectionHit R p m
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_cantorSectionHit] at hx ⊢
  obtain ⟨y, hyR, hyc⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨y, hyR, PiNat.cylinder_anti p hmn hyc⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.cantorSectionHit_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem cantorSectionHit_zero (R : Set (X × (ℕ → Bool))) (p : ℕ → Bool) :
    cantorSectionHit R p 0 = relationDomain R
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [cantorSectionHit, sectionHit]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsClosed.mem_verticalSection_iff_forall_mem_cantorSectionHit
statement:
theorem IsClosed.mem_verticalSection_iff_forall_mem_cantorSectionHit
    [TopologicalSpace X] {R : Set (X × (ℕ → Bool))} (hR : IsClosed R)
    (x : X) (p : ℕ → Bool) :
    p ∈ DescriptiveSetTheory.verticalSection R x ↔
      ∀ n, x ∈ cantorSectionHit R p n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp n
    rw [mem_cantorSectionHit]
    exact ⟨p, hp, PiNat.self_mem_cylinder p n⟩
  · intro hp
    have hpClosure : p ∈ closure (DescriptiveSetTheory.verticalSection R x) := by
      refine (PiNat.isTopologicalBasis_cylinders fun _ : ℕ => Bool).mem_closure_iff.mpr ?_
      intro o ho hpo
      rcases ho with ⟨z, n, rfl⟩
      have hpn := hp n
      rw [mem_cantorSectionHit] at hpn
      obtain ⟨y, hyR, hyc⟩ := hpn
      refine ⟨y, ?_, hyR⟩
      rw [PiNat.mem_cylinder_iff] at hpo hyc ⊢
      intro i hi
      exact (hyc i hi).trans (hpo i hi)
    rw [(DescriptiveSetTheory.IsClosed.verticalSection hR x).closure_eq] at hpClosure
    exact hpClosure

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_finiteSection
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_finiteSection [Fintype Y] {R : Set (X × Y)} {x : X} {y : Y} :
    y ∈ finiteSection R x ↔ (x, y) ∈ R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [finiteSection]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.finiteSection_nonempty
statement:
theorem finiteSection_nonempty [Fintype Y] (R : Set (X × Y))
    (x : relationDomain R) : (finiteSection R x.1).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := x.property
  exact ⟨y, mem_finiteSection.mpr hy⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.finiteLeastSelector_mem
statement:
theorem finiteLeastSelector_mem [Fintype Y] [LinearOrder Y] (R : Set (X × Y))
    (x : relationDomain R) : (x.1, finiteLeastSelector R x) ∈ R
proof:
:= by
  exact mem_finiteSection.mp
    (Finset.min'_mem (finiteSection R x.1) (finiteSection_nonempty R x))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.finiteLeastSelector_eq_iff
statement:
theorem finiteLeastSelector_eq_iff [Fintype Y] [LinearOrder Y] (R : Set (X × Y))
    (x : relationDomain R) (y : Y) :
    finiteLeastSelector R x = y ↔
      (x.1, y) ∈ R ∧ ∀ z, (x.1, z) ∈ R → y ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (finiteSection R x.1).min' (finiteSection_nonempty R x) = y ↔ _
  rw [Finset.min'_eq_iff]
  simp only [mem_finiteSection]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.MeasurableSet.measurableSet_relationDomain_of_finite
statement:
theorem MeasurableSet.measurableSet_relationDomain_of_finite
    [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [Finite Y]
    {R : Set (X × Y)} (hR : MeasurableSet R) : MeasurableSet (relationDomain R)
proof:
:= by
  have hdomain : relationDomain R = ⋃ y, DescriptiveSetTheory.horizontalSection R y := by
    ext x
    simp [relationDomain]
  rw [hdomain]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun y =>
    DescriptiveSetTheory.MeasurableSet.horizontalSection hR y

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.MeasurableSet.measurable_finiteLeastSelector
statement:
theorem MeasurableSet.measurable_finiteLeastSelector
    [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [Fintype Y] [LinearOrder Y]
    {R : Set (X × Y)} (hR : MeasurableSet R) : Measurable (finiteLeastSelector R)
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_to_countable'
  intro y
  have hEq : finiteLeastSelector R ⁻¹' {y} =
      {x : relationDomain R |
        (x.1, y) ∈ R ∧ ∀ z, (x.1, z) ∈ R → y ≤ z} := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_preimage, mem_singleton_iff, mem_setOf_eq, finiteLeastSelector_eq_iff]
  rw [hEq]
  apply ((DescriptiveSetTheory.MeasurableSet.horizontalSection hR y).preimage
    measurable_subtype_coe).inter
  have hForall : {x : relationDomain R |
      ∀ z, (x.1, z) ∈ R → y ≤ z} =
      ⋂ z, {x : relationDomain R | (x.1, z) ∈ R → y ≤ z} := by
    ext x
    simp
  change MeasurableSet ({x : relationDomain R |
    ∀ z, (x.1, z) ∈ R → y ≤ z} : Set (relationDomain R))
  rw [hForall]
  apply MeasurableSet.iInter
  intro z
  by_cases hyz : y ≤ z
  · convert MeasurableSet.univ using 1
    ext x
    simp [hyz]
  · convert ((DescriptiveSetTheory.MeasurableSet.horizontalSection hR z).preimage
      measurable_subtype_coe).compl using 1
    ext x
    simp [hyz]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.uniformizes_partialGraph_finiteLeastSelector
statement:
theorem uniformizes_partialGraph_finiteLeastSelector [Fintype Y] [LinearOrder Y]
    (R : Set (X × Y)) :
    Uniformizes R (partialGraph (relationDomain R) (finiteLeastSelector R))
proof:
:=
  uniformizes_partialGraph_iff.mpr ⟨rfl, finiteLeastSelector_mem R⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.MeasurableSet.exists_standardBorelCode_partialGraph_finiteLeastSelector
statement:
theorem MeasurableSet.exists_standardBorelCode_partialGraph_finiteLeastSelector
    [MeasurableSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Fintype Y] [LinearOrder Y]
    {R : Set (X × Y)} (hR : MeasurableSet R) :
    ∃ c : StandardBorelCode (X × Y),
      c.eval = partialGraph (relationDomain R) (finiteLeastSelector R)
proof:
:=
  exists_standardBorelCode_partialGraph
    (DescriptiveSetTheory.MeasurableSet.measurableSet_relationDomain_of_finite hR)
    (DescriptiveSetTheory.MeasurableSet.measurable_finiteLeastSelector hR)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_graphFamilyDomain
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_graphFamilyDomain {s : ℕ → Set X} {x : X} :
    x ∈ graphFamilyDomain s ↔ ∃ n, x ∈ s n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.graphFamilyDomain_eq_iUnion
statement:
theorem graphFamilyDomain_eq_iUnion (s : ℕ → Set X) :
    graphFamilyDomain s = ⋃ n, s n
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurableSet_graphFamilyDomain
statement:
theorem measurableSet_graphFamilyDomain [MeasurableSpace X]
    {s : ℕ → Set X} (hs : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (s n)) :
    MeasurableSet (graphFamilyDomain s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphFamilyDomain_eq_iUnion]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion hs

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_firstGraphDomain
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_firstGraphDomain {s : ℕ → Set X} {n : ℕ} {x : X} :
    x ∈ firstGraphDomain s n ↔ x ∈ s n ∧ ∀ m < n, x ∉ s m
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurableSet_firstGraphDomain
statement:
theorem measurableSet_firstGraphDomain [MeasurableSpace X]
    {s : ℕ → Set X} (hs : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (s n)) (n : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet (firstGraphDomain s n)
proof:
:= by
  have hEq : firstGraphDomain s n = s n \ ⋃ m : Fin n, s m := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hxn, hmin⟩
      refine ⟨hxn, ?_⟩
      intro hxUnion
      obtain ⟨m, hxm⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxUnion
      exact hmin m m.isLt hxm
    · rintro ⟨hxn, hmin⟩
      refine ⟨hxn, fun m hm hxm => ?_⟩
      exact hmin (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, hxm⟩)
  rw [hEq]
  exact (hs n).diff (MeasurableSet.iUnion fun m => hs m)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.firstGraphIndex_mem
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstGraphIndex_mem (s : ℕ → Set X) (x : graphFamilyDomain s) :
    x.1 ∈ s (firstGraphIndex s x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Nat.find_spec x.property

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.firstGraphIndex_eq_iff
statement:
theorem firstGraphIndex_eq_iff (s : ℕ → Set X) (x : graphFamilyDomain s) (n : ℕ) :
    firstGraphIndex s x = n ↔ x.1 ∈ firstGraphDomain s n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold firstGraphIndex
  rw [Nat.find_eq_iff]
  rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.disjoint_firstGraphDomain
statement:
theorem disjoint_firstGraphDomain (s : ℕ → Set X) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≠ n) :
    Disjoint (firstGraphDomain s m) (firstGraphDomain s n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxm hxn
  by_cases hlt : m < n
  · exact hxn.2 m hlt hxm.1
  · have hlt' : n < m := by omega
    exact hxm.2 n hlt' hxn.1

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.iUnion_firstGraphDomain
statement:
theorem iUnion_firstGraphDomain (s : ℕ → Set X) :
    ⋃ n, firstGraphDomain s n = graphFamilyDomain s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨n, hxn⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact ⟨n, hxn.1⟩
  · intro hx
    let x' : graphFamilyDomain s := ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      ⟨firstGraphIndex s x', (firstGraphIndex_eq_iff s x' _).mp rfl⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurable_firstGraphIndex
statement:
theorem measurable_firstGraphIndex [MeasurableSpace X]
    {s : ℕ → Set X} (hs : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (s n)) :
    Measurable (firstGraphIndex s)
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_to_countable'
  intro n
  have hEq : firstGraphIndex s ⁻¹' {n} =
      Subtype.val ⁻¹' firstGraphDomain s n := by
    ext x
    simp [firstGraphIndex_eq_iff]
  rw [hEq]
  exact (measurableSet_firstGraphDomain hs n).preimage measurable_subtype_coe

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_graphFamilyRelation
proof:
:= by
  simp [graphFamilyRelation]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.relationDomain_graphFamilyRelation
statement:
@[simp] theorem relationDomain_graphFamilyRelation (s : ℕ → Set X) (f : ℕ → X → Y) :
    relationDomain (graphFamilyRelation s f) = graphFamilyDomain s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [relationDomain]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.graphFamilySelector_mem
statement:
theorem graphFamilySelector_mem (s : ℕ → Set X) (f : ℕ → X → Y)
    (x : graphFamilyDomain s) :
    (x.1, graphFamilySelector s f x) ∈ graphFamilyRelation s f
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_graphFamilyRelation]
  exact ⟨firstGraphIndex s x, firstGraphIndex_mem s x, rfl⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.graphFamilySelector_preimage
statement:
theorem graphFamilySelector_preimage (s : ℕ → Set X) (f : ℕ → X → Y)
    (t : Set Y) :
    graphFamilySelector s f ⁻¹' t =
      ⋃ n, (Subtype.val ⁻¹' firstGraphDomain s n) ∩ (fun x => f n x.1) ⁻¹' t
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    refine mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨firstGraphIndex s x, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨(firstGraphIndex_eq_iff s x _).mp rfl, hx⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hfn⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
    have hindex : firstGraphIndex s x = n :=
      (firstGraphIndex_eq_iff s x n).mpr hn
    simpa [graphFamilySelector, hindex] using hfn

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurable_graphFamilySelector
statement:
theorem measurable_graphFamilySelector [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {s : ℕ → Set X} {f : ℕ → X → Y}
    (hs : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (s n)) (hf : ∀ n, Measurable (f n)) :
    Measurable (graphFamilySelector s f)
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  rw [graphFamilySelector_preimage]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n =>
    ((measurableSet_firstGraphDomain hs n).preimage measurable_subtype_coe).inter
      ((hf n).comp measurable_subtype_coe ht)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.uniformizes_partialGraph_graphFamilySelector
statement:
theorem uniformizes_partialGraph_graphFamilySelector
    (s : ℕ → Set X) (f : ℕ → X → Y) :
    Uniformizes (graphFamilyRelation s f)
      (partialGraph (graphFamilyDomain s) (graphFamilySelector s f))
proof:
:= by
  rw [uniformizes_partialGraph_iff]
  exact ⟨(relationDomain_graphFamilyRelation s f).symm, graphFamilySelector_mem s f⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurableSet_graphFamilyRelation
statement:
theorem measurableSet_graphFamilyRelation
    [MeasurableSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace Y]
    {s : ℕ → Set X} {f : ℕ → X → Y}
    (hs : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (s n)) (hf : ∀ n, Measurable (f n)) :
    MeasurableSet (graphFamilyRelation s f)
proof:
:= by
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n => measurableSet_graphOn (hs n) (hf n)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_standardBorelCode_partialGraph_graphFamilySelector
statement:
theorem exists_standardBorelCode_partialGraph_graphFamilySelector
    [MeasurableSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace Y]
    {s : ℕ → Set X} {f : ℕ → X → Y}
    (hs : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (s n)) (hf : ∀ n, Measurable (f n)) :
    ∃ c : StandardBorelCode (X × Y),
      c.eval = partialGraph (graphFamilyDomain s) (graphFamilySelector s f)
proof:
:=
  exists_standardBorelCode_partialGraph (measurableSet_graphFamilyDomain hs)
    (measurable_graphFamilySelector hs hf)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.pointwiseSectionEnumeration_spec
statement:
theorem pointwiseSectionEnumeration_spec (R : Set (X × Y))
    (hR : HasCountableVerticalSections R) :
    IsPointwiseSectionEnumeration R (pointwiseSectionEnumeration R hR)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  constructor
  · intro hxy
    let y' : verticalSection R x := ⟨y, hxy⟩
    refine ⟨@Encodable.encode _ (hR x).toEncodable y', ?_⟩
    simp [pointwiseSectionEnumeration, y']
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    unfold pointwiseSectionEnumeration at hn
    generalize hdecode : @Encodable.decode (verticalSection R x) (hR x).toEncodable n = o at hn
    cases o with
    | none => simp at hn
    | some y' =>
        simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hn
        exact hn ▸ y'.property

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsPointwiseSectionEnumeration.hasCountableVerticalSections
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have hEq : verticalSection R x = ⋃ n, {y | e x n = some y} := by
    ext y
    simpa using he x y
  rw [hEq]
  exact Set.countable_iUnion fun n => Set.Subsingleton.countable fun y hy z hz =>
    Option.some.inj (hy.symm.trans hz)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.hasCountableVerticalSections_iff_hasPointwiseSectionEnumeration
statement:
theorem hasCountableVerticalSections_iff_hasPointwiseSectionEnumeration
    (R : Set (X × Y)) :
    HasCountableVerticalSections R ↔ HasPointwiseSectionEnumeration R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hR
    exact ⟨pointwiseSectionEnumeration R hR, pointwiseSectionEnumeration_spec R hR⟩
  · rintro ⟨e, he⟩
    exact he.hasCountableVerticalSections

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_sectionCandidateGraph
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.relationSingleValued_sectionCandidateGraph
statement:
theorem relationSingleValued_sectionCandidateGraph (e : X → ℕ → Option Y) (n : ℕ) :
    RelationSingleValued (sectionCandidateGraph e n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y z hy hz
  exact Option.some.inj (hy.symm.trans hz)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_sectionEnumerationRelation
proof:
:= by
  simp [sectionEnumerationRelation]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsPointwiseSectionEnumeration.sectionEnumerationRelation_eq
statement:
theorem IsPointwiseSectionEnumeration.sectionEnumerationRelation_eq
    {R : Set (X × Y)} {e : X → ℕ → Option Y}
    (he : IsPointwiseSectionEnumeration R e) :
    sectionEnumerationRelation e = R
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  rcases p with ⟨x, y⟩
  rw [mem_sectionEnumerationRelation]
  exact (he x y).symm

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.partialGraph_choiceSelector_eq_of_relationSingleValued
statement:
private theorem partialGraph_choiceSelector_eq_of_relationSingleValued
    {G : Set (X × Y)} (hG : RelationSingleValued G) :
    partialGraph (relationDomain G) (choiceSelector G) = G
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm (uniformizes_partialGraph_choiceSelector G).1
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩ hxy
  let hx : x ∈ relationDomain G := ⟨y, hxy⟩
  have hchosen : (x, choiceSelector G ⟨x, hx⟩) ∈ G :=
    choiceSelector_mem G ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact ⟨hx, hG hchosen hxy⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.sectionCandidateGraph_eq_partialGraph_choiceSelector
statement:
theorem sectionCandidateGraph_eq_partialGraph_choiceSelector
    (e : X → ℕ → Option Y) (n : ℕ) :
    sectionCandidateGraph e n =
      partialGraph (relationDomain (sectionCandidateGraph e n))
        (choiceSelector (sectionCandidateGraph e n))
proof:
:= by
  symm
  exact partialGraph_choiceSelector_eq_of_relationSingleValued
    (relationSingleValued_sectionCandidateGraph e n)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_firstSectionCandidateGraph
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_firstSectionCandidateGraph {e : X → ℕ → Option Y} {n : ℕ}
    {x : X} {y : Y} :
    (x, y) ∈ firstSectionCandidateGraph e n ↔
      e x n = some y ∧ ∀ m < n, e x m ≠ some y
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.disjoint_firstSectionCandidateGraph
statement:
theorem disjoint_firstSectionCandidateGraph (e : X → ℕ → Option Y)
    {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≠ n) :
    Disjoint (firstSectionCandidateGraph e m) (firstSectionCandidateGraph e n)
proof:
:=
  disjoint_firstGraphDomain (sectionCandidateGraph e) hmn

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.relationSingleValued_firstSectionCandidateGraph
statement:
theorem relationSingleValued_firstSectionCandidateGraph
    (e : X → ℕ → Option Y) (n : ℕ) :
    RelationSingleValued (firstSectionCandidateGraph e n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y z hy hz
  exact relationSingleValued_sectionCandidateGraph e n hy.1 hz.1

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.iUnion_firstSectionCandidateGraph
statement:
theorem iUnion_firstSectionCandidateGraph (e : X → ℕ → Option Y) :
    ⋃ n, firstSectionCandidateGraph e n = sectionEnumerationRelation e
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ⋃ n, firstSectionCandidateGraph e n =
        graphFamilyDomain (sectionCandidateGraph e) :=
      iUnion_firstGraphDomain (sectionCandidateGraph e)
    _ = ⋃ n, sectionCandidateGraph e n := graphFamilyDomain_eq_iUnion _
    _ = sectionEnumerationRelation e := rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsPointwiseSectionEnumeration.iUnion_firstSectionCandidateGraph
statement:
theorem IsPointwiseSectionEnumeration.iUnion_firstSectionCandidateGraph
    {R : Set (X × Y)} {e : X → ℕ → Option Y}
    (he : IsPointwiseSectionEnumeration R e) :
    ⋃ n, firstSectionCandidateGraph e n = R
proof:
:=
  (DescriptiveSetTheory.iUnion_firstSectionCandidateGraph e).trans
    he.sectionEnumerationRelation_eq

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.firstSectionCandidateGraph_eq_partialGraph_choiceSelector
statement:
theorem firstSectionCandidateGraph_eq_partialGraph_choiceSelector
    (e : X → ℕ → Option Y) (n : ℕ) :
    firstSectionCandidateGraph e n =
      partialGraph (relationDomain (firstSectionCandidateGraph e n))
        (choiceSelector (firstSectionCandidateGraph e n))
proof:
:= by
  symm
  exact partialGraph_choiceSelector_eq_of_relationSingleValued
    (relationSingleValued_firstSectionCandidateGraph e n)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurableSet_firstSectionCandidateGraph
statement:
theorem measurableSet_firstSectionCandidateGraph
    [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {e : X → ℕ → Option Y} (he : HasMeasurableSectionCandidateGraphs e) (n : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet (firstSectionCandidateGraph e n)
proof:
:=
  measurableSet_firstGraphDomain he n

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_standardBorelCode_firstSectionCandidateGraph
statement:
theorem exists_standardBorelCode_firstSectionCandidateGraph
    [MeasurableSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace Y]
    {e : X → ℕ → Option Y} (he : HasMeasurableSectionCandidateGraphs e) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : StandardBorelCode (X × Y), c.eval = firstSectionCandidateGraph e n
proof:
:=
  StandardBorelCode.exists_code (measurableSet_firstSectionCandidateGraph he n)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurableSet_partialGraph
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty Y with
  | inl hY =>
      have hs0 : s = ∅ := by
        ext x
        constructor
        · intro hx
          exact isEmptyElim (f ⟨x, hx⟩)
        · simp
      subst s
      simp [partialGraph]
  | inr hY =>
      obtain ⟨g, hg, hgf⟩ :=
        (MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe hs).exists_measurable_extend hf fun _ => hY
      have hgraph : partialGraph s f = s.graphOn g := by
        ext p
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hp, hfp⟩
          apply Set.mem_graphOn.mpr
          refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
          have h := congrFun hgf ⟨p.1, hp⟩
          exact h.trans hfp
        · intro h
          obtain ⟨hp, hgp⟩ := Set.mem_graphOn.mp h
          refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
          have h := congrFun hgf ⟨p.1, hp⟩
          exact h.symm.trans hgp
      rw [hgraph]
      exact measurableSet_graphOn hs hg

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsBorelPartialMap.measurableSet_partialGraph
statement:
theorem IsBorelPartialMap.measurableSet_partialGraph [MeasurableSpace X]
    [StandardBorelSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace Y]
    {s : Set X} {f : s → Y} (h : IsBorelPartialMap s f) :
    MeasurableSet (partialGraph s f)
proof:
:=
  DescriptiveSetTheory.measurableSet_partialGraph h.1 h.2

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_standardBorelCode_partialGraph
statement:
theorem exists_standardBorelCode_partialGraph [MeasurableSpace X]
    [StandardBorelSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace Y]
    {s : Set X} {f : s → Y} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hf : Measurable f) :
    ∃ c : StandardBorelCode (X × Y), c.eval = partialGraph s f
proof:
:=
  StandardBorelCode.exists_code (measurableSet_partialGraph hs hf)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.verticalSection_partialGraph_of_mem
statement:
theorem verticalSection_partialGraph_of_mem {s : Set X} (f : s → Y) {x : X}
    (hx : x ∈ s) : verticalSection (partialGraph s f) x = {f ⟨x, hx⟩}
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx', hxy⟩
    rw [mem_singleton_iff]
    exact hxy.symm
  · intro hy
    have hy' : f ⟨x, hx⟩ = y := by
      rw [mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      exact hy.symm
    exact ⟨hx, hy'⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.verticalSection_partialGraph_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem verticalSection_partialGraph_of_not_mem {s : Set X} (f : s → Y) {x : X}
    (hx : x ∉ s) : verticalSection (partialGraph s f) x = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx', _⟩
    exact (hx hx').elim
  · simp

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurable_partialMapRestrict
statement:
theorem measurable_partialMapRestrict [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {s u : Set X} {f : s → Y} (hf : Measurable f) (hu : u ⊆ s) :
    Measurable (partialMapRestrict f hu)
proof:
:=
  hf.comp (Measurable.subtype_mk measurable_subtype_coe)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.partialGraph_partialMapRestrict
statement:
theorem partialGraph_partialMapRestrict {s u : Set X} (f : s → Y) (hu : u ⊆ s) :
    partialGraph u (partialMapRestrict f hu) = relationRestrict (partialGraph s f) u
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp, hfp⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hu hp, hfp⟩, hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨hp, hfp⟩, hpu⟩
    exact ⟨hpu, hfp⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_partialCompDomain
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_partialCompDomain {s : Set X} {f : s → Y} {t : Set Y} {x : X} :
    x ∈ partialCompDomain s f t ↔ ∃ hx : x ∈ s, f ⟨x, hx⟩ ∈ t
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.partialCompDomain_eq_subtype_image
statement:
theorem partialCompDomain_eq_subtype_image {s : Set X} (f : s → Y) (t : Set Y) :
    partialCompDomain s f t = Subtype.val '' (f ⁻¹' t)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hfx⟩
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hfx, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x.property, hx⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurableSet_partialCompDomain
statement:
theorem measurableSet_partialCompDomain [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {s : Set X} {f : s → Y} {t : Set Y} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (hf : Measurable f) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    MeasurableSet (partialCompDomain s f t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [partialCompDomain_eq_subtype_image]
  exact (MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe hs).measurableSet_image.2 (hf ht)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurable_partialMapComp
proof:
:= by
  let lift : partialCompDomain s f t → s := fun x =>
    ⟨x.1, Classical.choose x.2⟩
  have hlift : Measurable lift := Measurable.subtype_mk measurable_subtype_coe
  let toSecondDomain : partialCompDomain s f t → t := fun x =>
    ⟨f (lift x), Classical.choose_spec x.2⟩
  have htoSecondDomain : Measurable toSecondDomain :=
    Measurable.subtype_mk (hf.comp hlift)
  exact hg.comp htoSecondDomain

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.partialGraph_partialMapComp
statement:
theorem partialGraph_partialMapComp {s : Set X} (f : s → Y) {t : Set Y} (g : t → Z) :
    partialGraph (partialCompDomain s f t) (partialMapComp f g) =
      relationComp (partialGraph s f) (partialGraph t g)
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp, hcomp⟩
    let hx : p.1 ∈ s := Classical.choose hp
    let hfx : f ⟨p.1, hx⟩ ∈ t := Classical.choose_spec hp
    refine ⟨f ⟨p.1, hx⟩, ⟨hx, rfl⟩, hfx, ?_⟩
    exact hcomp
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hx, hfy⟩, hy, hgz⟩
    have hp : p.1 ∈ partialCompDomain s f t := ⟨hx, hfy ▸ hy⟩
    refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
    have hp' : ∃ hx' : p.1 ∈ s, f ⟨p.1, hx'⟩ ∈ t := hp
    let hx' : p.1 ∈ s := Classical.choose hp'
    let hfx' : f ⟨p.1, hx'⟩ ∈ t := Classical.choose_spec hp'
    change g ⟨f ⟨p.1, hx'⟩, hfx'⟩ = p.2
    have hsub : (⟨p.1, hx'⟩ : s) = ⟨p.1, hx⟩ := by
      exact Subtype.ext rfl
    have hin : (⟨f ⟨p.1, hx'⟩, hfx'⟩ : t) = ⟨y, hy⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simpa [hsub] using hfy
    exact (congrArg g hin).trans hgz

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurableSet_projectiveTagged
proof:
:= by
  rw [show projectiveTagged s = ⋃ i, {p : ProjectiveWitness | p 0 = i} ×ˢ s i by
    ext q
    simp [projectiveTagged]]
  apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
  intro i
  have hp : MeasurableSet {p : ProjectiveWitness | p 0 = i} := by
    change MeasurableSet ((fun p : ProjectiveWitness => p 0) ⁻¹' {i})
    exact MeasurableSet.preimage (measurableSet_singleton i) (measurable_pi_apply 0)
  exact hp.prod (hs i)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.continuous_taggedWitnessMap
statement:
private theorem continuous_taggedWitnessMap {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] :
    Continuous (taggedWitnessMap (X := X))
proof:
:=
  (continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd).prodMk
    (continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.projectiveSigma_tagged
statement:
private theorem projectiveSigma_tagged {X : Type u}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    {n : ℕ} {s : ℕ → Set X} (hs : ∀ i, ProjectiveSigma n (s i)) :
    ProjectiveSigma n (projectiveTagged s)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing X with
  | zero =>
      exact measurableSet_projectiveTagged hs
  | succ n ih =>
      choose R hR hproj using fun i => projectiveSigma_succ.mp (hs i)
      have htaggedPi : ProjectivePi n (projectiveTagged R) := by
        rw [ProjectivePi]
        rw [show (projectiveTagged R)ᶜ = projectiveTagged (fun i => (R i)ᶜ) by
          ext q
          rfl]
        exact ih fun i => hR i
      refine projectiveSigma_succ.mpr
        ⟨taggedWitnessMap ⁻¹' projectiveTagged R,
          htaggedPi.preimage continuous_taggedWitnessMap, ?_⟩
      ext q
      change (∃ p, (p, q.2) ∈ R (q.1 0)) ↔ q.2 ∈ s (q.1 0)
      rw [← hproj (q.1 0)]
      rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.projectiveProjection_projectiveTagged
statement:
private theorem projectiveProjection_projectiveTagged {X : Type u} (s : ℕ → Set X) :
    projectiveProjection (projectiveTagged s) = ⋃ i, s i
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨p 0, hp⟩
  · intro hx
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨fun _ => i, hi⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ProjectiveSigma.iUnion
statement:
theorem ProjectiveSigma.iUnion {X : Type u}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    {n : ℕ} {s : ℕ → Set X} (hs : ∀ i, ProjectiveSigma n (s i)) :
    ProjectiveSigma n (⋃ i, s i)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact MeasurableSet.iUnion hs
  | succ n =>
      rw [← projectiveProjection_projectiveTagged]
      exact (projectiveSigma_tagged hs).projectiveProjection

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ProjectivePi.iInter
statement:
theorem ProjectivePi.iInter {X : Type u}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    {n : ℕ} {s : ℕ → Set X} (hs : ∀ i, ProjectivePi n (s i)) :
    ProjectivePi n (⋂ i, s i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ProjectivePi]
  simpa only [compl_iInter] using
    (ProjectiveSigma.iUnion fun i => (show ProjectiveSigma n (s i)ᶜ from hs i))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ProjectiveSigma.union
statement:
theorem ProjectiveSigma.union {X : Type u}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    {n : ℕ} {s t : Set X} (hs : ProjectiveSigma n s) (ht : ProjectiveSigma n t) :
    ProjectiveSigma n (s ∪ t)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → Set X := fun i => if i = 0 then s else t
  have hf : ∀ i, ProjectiveSigma n (f i) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · simpa [f, hi] using hs
    · simpa [f, hi] using ht
  have heq : (⋃ i, f i) = s ∪ t := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨i, hi⟩
      by_cases h0 : i = 0
      · exact Or.inl (by simpa [f, h0] using hi)
      · exact Or.inr (by simpa [f, h0] using hi)
    · rintro (hx | hx)
      · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, by simpa [f] using hx⟩
      · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨1, by simpa [f] using hx⟩
  rw [← heq]
  exact ProjectiveSigma.iUnion hf

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ProjectivePi.inter
statement:
theorem ProjectivePi.inter {X : Type u}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    {n : ℕ} {s t : Set X} (hs : ProjectivePi n s) (ht : ProjectivePi n t) :
    ProjectivePi n (s ∩ t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ProjectivePi]
  simpa only [compl_inter] using
    (show ProjectiveSigma n sᶜ from hs).union (show ProjectiveSigma n tᶜ from ht)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.continuous_leftPackedWitnessMap
statement:
private theorem continuous_leftPackedWitnessMap {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] :
    Continuous (leftPackedWitnessMap (X := X))
proof:
:=
  (continuous_unpackBairePair.comp continuous_fst).fst.prodMk continuous_snd

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.continuous_rightPackedWitnessMap
statement:
private theorem continuous_rightPackedWitnessMap {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] :
    Continuous (rightPackedWitnessMap (X := X))
proof:
:=
  (continuous_unpackBairePair.comp continuous_fst).snd.prodMk continuous_snd

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.projectiveProjection_packedInter
statement:
private theorem projectiveProjection_packedInter {X : Type u}
    (R S : Set (ProjectiveWitness × X)) :
    projectiveProjection
        (leftPackedWitnessMap ⁻¹' R ∩ rightPackedWitnessMap ⁻¹' S) =
      projectiveProjection R ∩ projectiveProjection S
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, hs⟩
    exact ⟨⟨(unpackBairePair r).1, hr⟩, ⟨(unpackBairePair r).2, hs⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, ⟨q, hq⟩⟩
    refine ⟨packBairePair (p, q), ?_⟩
    simpa [leftPackedWitnessMap, rightPackedWitnessMap] using And.intro hp hq

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ProjectiveSigma.inter
statement:
theorem ProjectiveSigma.inter {X : Type u}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    {n : ℕ} {s t : Set X} (hs : ProjectiveSigma n s) (ht : ProjectiveSigma n t) :
    ProjectiveSigma n (s ∩ t)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact MeasurableSet.inter hs ht
  | succ n =>
      rcases projectiveSigma_succ.mp hs with ⟨R, hR, hprojR⟩
      rcases projectiveSigma_succ.mp ht with ⟨S, hS, hprojS⟩
      refine projectiveSigma_succ.mpr
        ⟨leftPackedWitnessMap ⁻¹' R ∩ rightPackedWitnessMap ⁻¹' S,
          (hR.preimage continuous_leftPackedWitnessMap).inter
            (hS.preimage continuous_rightPackedWitnessMap), ?_⟩
      rw [projectiveProjection_packedInter, hprojR, hprojS]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ProjectivePi.union
statement:
theorem ProjectivePi.union {X : Type u}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    {n : ℕ} {s t : Set X} (hs : ProjectivePi n s) (ht : ProjectivePi n t) :
    ProjectivePi n (s ∪ t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ProjectivePi]
  simpa only [compl_union] using
    (show ProjectiveSigma n sᶜ from hs).inter (show ProjectiveSigma n tᶜ from ht)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ProjectiveDelta.union
statement:
theorem ProjectiveDelta.union {X : Type u}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    {n : ℕ} {s t : Set X} (hs : ProjectiveDelta n s) (ht : ProjectiveDelta n t) :
    ProjectiveDelta n (s ∪ t)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hs.1.union ht.1, hs.2.union ht.2⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ProjectiveDelta.inter
statement:
theorem ProjectiveDelta.inter {X : Type u}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    {n : ℕ} {s t : Set X} (hs : ProjectiveDelta n s) (ht : ProjectiveDelta n t) :
    ProjectiveDelta n (s ∩ t)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hs.1.inter ht.1, hs.2.inter ht.2⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.projectiveProjection_dummyRelation
statement:
private theorem projectiveProjection_dummyRelation {X : Type u} (s : Set X) :
    projectiveProjection (projectiveDummyRelation s) = s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [projectiveDummyRelation]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ProjectiveSigma.mono_succ
statement:
theorem ProjectiveSigma.mono_succ {X : Type u}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    {n : ℕ} {s : Set X} (hs : ProjectiveSigma n s) :
    ProjectiveSigma (n + 1) s
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing X with
  | zero =>
      refine projectiveSigma_succ.mpr
        ⟨projectiveDummyRelation s, projectivePi_zero.mpr ?_,
          projectiveProjection_dummyRelation s⟩
      exact MeasurableSet.univ.prod hs

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ProjectiveNormalForm.projective_normalForm_iff
statement:
private theorem projective_normalForm_iff (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X]
        [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (s : Set X),
      ProjectiveSigma n s ↔
        ∃ B : Set (ProjectiveNormalForm.Ambient n X),
          ProjectiveNormalForm.IsBorel n B ∧ ProjectiveNormalForm.sigma n B = s) ∧
    (∀ {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X]
        [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (s : Set X),
      ProjectivePi n s ↔
        ∃ B : Set (ProjectiveNormalForm.Ambient n X),
          ProjectiveNormalForm.IsBorel n B ∧ ProjectiveNormalForm.pi n B = s)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      constructor
      · intro X _ _ _ _ s
        simp [ProjectiveSigma, ProjectiveNormalForm.Ambient,
          ProjectiveNormalForm.IsBorel, ProjectiveNormalForm.sigma]
      · intro X _ _ _ _ s
        simp [ProjectivePi, ProjectiveSigma, ProjectiveNormalForm.Ambient,
          ProjectiveNormalForm.IsBorel, ProjectiveNormalForm.pi]
  | succ n ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨ihSigma, ihPi⟩
      constructor
      · intro X _ _ _ _ s
        rw [projectiveSigma_succ]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨R, hR, hproj⟩
          rcases (ihPi R).mp hR with ⟨B, hB, hpi⟩
          exact ⟨B, hB, by
            simp only [ProjectiveNormalForm.sigma]
            rw [hpi, hproj]⟩
        · rintro ⟨B, hB, hs⟩
          refine ⟨ProjectiveNormalForm.pi n B, (ihPi _).mpr ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
          simpa only [ProjectiveNormalForm.sigma] using hs
      · intro X _ _ _ _ s
        rw [projectivePi_succ]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨R, hR, huniv⟩
          rcases (ihSigma R).mp hR with ⟨B, hB, hsigma⟩
          exact ⟨B, hB, by
            simp only [ProjectiveNormalForm.pi]
            rw [hsigma, huniv]⟩
        · rintro ⟨B, hB, hs⟩
          refine ⟨ProjectiveNormalForm.sigma n B, (ihSigma _).mpr ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
          simpa only [ProjectiveNormalForm.pi] using hs

    [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    {n : ℕ} {R : Set (ProjectiveWitness × X)} (hR : ProjectiveSigma (n + 1) R) :
    ProjectiveSigma (n + 1) (projectiveProjection R)
proof:
:= by
  rcases projectiveSigma_succ.mp hR with ⟨S, hS, hproj⟩
  refine projectiveSigma_succ.mpr
    ⟨unpackProjectiveWitnessMap ⁻¹' S,
      hS.preimage continuous_unpackProjectiveWitnessMap, ?_⟩
  rw [projectiveProjection_preimage_unpackProjectiveWitnessMap, hproj]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.projectiveSigma_one_iff_analyticSet
statement:
theorem projectiveSigma_one_iff_analyticSet {s : Set X} :
    ProjectiveSigma 1 s ↔ MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [projectiveSigma_succ]
    rintro ⟨R, hR, rfl⟩
    rw [projectiveProjection_eq_image_snd]
    exact (projectivePi_zero.mp hR).analyticSet.image_of_continuous continuous_snd
  · intro hs
    rw [MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet] at hs
    rcases hs with rfl | ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    · rw [projectiveSigma_succ]
      exact ⟨∅, projectivePi_zero.mpr MeasurableSet.empty, by ext; simp⟩
    · let R : Set (ProjectiveWitness × X) := {q | f q.1 = q.2}
      have hR : IsClosed R := isClosed_eq (hf.comp continuous_fst) continuous_snd
      rw [projectiveSigma_succ]
      refine ⟨R, projectivePi_zero.mpr hR.measurableSet, ?_⟩
      ext x
      simp [R, projectiveProjection, eq_comm]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ProjectiveSigma.prod
statement:
theorem ProjectiveSigma.prod {X : Type u} {Y : Type v}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [TopologicalSpace Y] [PolishSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
    {n : ℕ} {s : Set X} {t : Set Y} (hs : ProjectiveSigma n s)
    (ht : ProjectiveSigma n t) : ProjectiveSigma n (s ×ˢ t)
proof:
:= by
  have hs' := hs.preimage (continuous_fst : Continuous (Prod.fst : X × Y → X))
  have ht' := ht.preimage (continuous_snd : Continuous (Prod.snd : X × Y → Y))
  rw [show s ×ˢ t = Prod.fst ⁻¹' s ∩ Prod.snd ⁻¹' t by ext; rfl]
  exact hs'.inter ht'

statement:
theorem mem_leAnalytic_iff {x y : ℕ → ℕ} (hy : y ∈ A) :
    (x, y) ∈ P.leAnalytic ↔
      ∃ hx : x ∈ A, P.rank x hx ≤ P.rank y hy
proof:
:= by
  change (P.treeCode x, P.treeCode y) ∈ treeRankLeAnalytic ↔ _
  rw [mem_treeRankLeAnalytic_iff_of_isWellFounded (P.wellFounded hy)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxf, hle⟩
    let hx : x ∈ A := (P.mem_iff x).2 hxf
    exact ⟨hx, by simpa [rank] using hle⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hle⟩
    exact ⟨P.wellFounded hx, by simpa [rank] using hle⟩

  rw [mem_treeRankLeCoanalytic_iff_of_isWellFounded (P.wellFounded hy)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxf, hle⟩
    let hx : x ∈ A := (P.mem_iff x).2 hxf
    exact ⟨hx, by simpa [rank] using hle⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hle⟩
    exact ⟨P.wellFounded hx, by simpa [rank] using hle⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.mem_ltAnalytic_iff
statement:
theorem mem_ltAnalytic_iff {x y : ℕ → ℕ} (hy : y ∈ A) :
    (x, y) ∈ P.ltAnalytic ↔
      ∃ hx : x ∈ A, P.rank x hx < P.rank y hy
proof:
:= by
  change (P.treeCode x, P.treeCode y) ∈ treeRankLtAnalytic ↔ _
  rw [mem_treeRankLtAnalytic_iff_of_isWellFounded (P.wellFounded hy)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxf, hlt⟩
    let hx : x ∈ A := (P.mem_iff x).2 hxf
    exact ⟨hx, by simpa [rank] using hlt⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hlt⟩
    exact ⟨P.wellFounded hx, by simpa [rank] using hlt⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.mem_ltCoanalytic_iff
statement:
theorem mem_ltCoanalytic_iff {x y : ℕ → ℕ} (hy : y ∈ A) :
    (x, y) ∈ P.ltCoanalytic ↔
      ∃ hx : x ∈ A, P.rank x hx < P.rank y hy
proof:
:= by
  change (P.treeCode x, P.treeCode y) ∈ treeRankLtCoanalytic ↔ _
  rw [mem_treeRankLtCoanalytic_iff_of_isWellFounded (P.wellFounded hy)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxf, hlt⟩
    let hx : x ∈ A := (P.mem_iff x).2 hxf
    exact ⟨hx, by simpa [rank] using hlt⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hlt⟩
    exact ⟨P.wellFounded hx, by simpa [rank] using hlt⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.le_polarities_agree

theorem le_polarities_agree {x y : ℕ → ℕ} (hy : y ∈ A) :

proof:

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.lt_polarities_agree

theorem lt_polarities_agree {x y : ℕ → ℕ} (hy : y ∈ A) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [P.mem_ltAnalytic_iff hy, P.mem_ltCoanalytic_iff hy]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.comparison_isCoanalyticNorm
statement:
theorem comparison_isCoanalyticNorm :
    MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet P.leAnalytic ∧
      IsCoanalytic P.leCoanalytic ∧
        MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet P.ltAnalytic ∧
          IsCoanalytic P.ltCoanalytic ∧
            ∀ (y : ℕ → ℕ), ∀ hy : y ∈ A,
              (∀ x, ((∃ hx : x ∈ A, P.rank x hx ≤ P.rank y hy) ↔
                (x, y) ∈ P.leAnalytic)) ∧
              (∀ x, ((∃ hx : x ∈ A, P.rank x hx ≤ P.rank y hy) ↔
                (x, y) ∈ P.leCoanalytic)) ∧
              (∀ x, ((∃ hx : x ∈ A, P.rank x hx < P.rank y hy) ↔
                (x, y) ∈ P.ltAnalytic)) ∧
              (∀ x, ((∃ hx : x ∈ A, P.rank x hx < P.rank y hy) ↔
                (x, y) ∈ P.ltCoanalytic))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨P.analyticSet_leAnalytic, P.isCoanalytic_leCoanalytic,
    P.analyticSet_ltAnalytic, P.isCoanalytic_ltCoanalytic, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  exact ⟨fun x => (P.mem_leAnalytic_iff hy).symm,
    fun x => (P.mem_leCoanalytic_iff hy).symm,
    fun x => (P.mem_ltAnalytic_iff hy).symm,
    fun x => (P.mem_ltCoanalytic_iff hy).symm⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.bounded_of_analytic
statement:
theorem bounded_of_analytic {B : Set (ℕ → ℕ)} (hB : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet B)
    (hBA : B ⊆ A) :
    ∃ ξ : Ordinal.{0}, ξ < ω₁ ∧
      ∀ (x : ℕ → ℕ), ∀ hx : x ∈ B, P.rank x (hBA hx) < ξ
proof:
:= by
  have himage : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (P.treeCode '' B) :=
    hB.image_of_continuous P.continuous_treeCode
  have himageWF : P.treeCode '' B ⊆ wellFoundedTrees := by
    rintro T ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact P.wellFounded (hBA hx)
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hbound⟩ :=
    rank_bounded_of_analytic_subset_wellFounded himage himageWF
  refine ⟨ξ, hξ, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  simpa [rank] using
    hbound (P.treeCode x) ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ (P.wellFounded (hBA hx))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_coanalyticRankPresentation

    (Tree.continuouslyReduces_wellFoundedTrees_of_isCoanalytic hA).exists_map

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.continuouslyReduces_iff

    ContinuouslyReduces s t ↔
      ∃ f : X → Y, Continuous f ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ s ↔ f x ∈ t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, hpre⟩
    refine ⟨f, hf, fun x => ?_⟩
    exact (Set.ext_iff.mp hpre x).symm
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, hmem⟩
    exact continuouslyReduces_of_continuous f hf hmem

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ContinuouslyReduces.trans
proof:

  rcases htr with ⟨g, hg, hgr⟩
  refine ⟨g ∘ f, hg.comp hf, ?_⟩
  change f ⁻¹' (g ⁻¹' r) = s
  rw [hgr, hft]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ContinuouslyReduces.prod
statement:
theorem ContinuouslyReduces.prod {s : Set X} {t : Set Y}
    {X' : Type u'} {Y' : Type v'} [TopologicalSpace X'] [TopologicalSpace Y']
    {s' : Set X'} {t' : Set Y'} (h : ContinuouslyReduces s t)
    (h' : ContinuouslyReduces s' t') :
    ContinuouslyReduces (s ×ˢ s') (t ×ˢ t')
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨f, hf, hpre⟩
  rcases h' with ⟨g, hg, hpre'⟩
  refine ⟨fun z => (f z.1, g z.2),
    (hf.comp continuous_fst).prodMk (hg.comp continuous_snd), ?_⟩
  ext z
  exact and_congr (Set.ext_iff.mp hpre z.1) (Set.ext_iff.mp hpre' z.2)

    (h : ContinuouslyReduces s t) (e : X ≃ₜ X') (d : Y ≃ₜ Y') :
    ContinuouslyReduces (e '' s) (d '' t)
proof:

  (DescriptiveSetTheory.Homeomorph.image_continuouslyReduces e s).trans
    (h.trans (DescriptiveSetTheory.Homeomorph.continuouslyReduces_image d t))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.continuouslyReduces_image_iff
statement:
theorem continuouslyReduces_image_iff {s : Set X} {t : Set Y}
    {X' : Type u'} {Y' : Type v'} [TopologicalSpace X'] [TopologicalSpace Y']
    (e : X ≃ₜ X') (d : Y ≃ₜ Y') :
    ContinuouslyReduces (e '' s) (d '' t) ↔ ContinuouslyReduces s t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (DescriptiveSetTheory.Homeomorph.continuouslyReduces_image e s).trans
      (h.trans (DescriptiveSetTheory.Homeomorph.image_continuouslyReduces d t))

theorem eventualEqTail_subset_range_overwritePrefix (x : ℕ → Bool) (N : ℕ) :

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isNowhereDense_eventualEqTail
statement:
theorem isNowhereDense_eventualEqTail (x : ℕ → Bool) (N : ℕ) :
    IsNowhereDense (eventualEqTail x N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(isClosed_eventualEqTail x N).isNowhereDense_iff,
    interior_eq_empty_iff_dense_compl, dense_iff_inter_open]
  intro U hU hUne
  rcases hUne with ⟨z, hzU⟩
  rcases isTopologicalBasis_cantorCylinderBasis.exists_subset_of_mem_open hzU hU with
    ⟨C, ⟨c, k, rfl⟩, hzC, hCU⟩
  let m := max N k
  let y : ℕ → Bool := Function.update z m (!x m)
  have hyC : y ∈ PiNat.cylinder c k := by
    rw [PiNat.mem_cylinder_iff] at hzC ⊢
    intro i hi
    have him : i ≠ m := ne_of_lt (hi.trans_le (Nat.le_max_right N k))
    have hyi : y i = z i := by
      simp [y, him]
    rw [hyi]
    exact hzC i hi
  have hyTail : y ∉ eventualEqTail x N := by
    intro hy
    have hm := hy m (Nat.le_max_left N k)
    simp [y] at hm
  exact ⟨y, hCU hyC, hyTail⟩

proof:
