name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isMeagre_or_compl_isMeagre_of_baireMeasurable_eventualEqInvariant
statement:
theorem isMeagre_or_compl_isMeagre_of_baireMeasurable_eventualEqInvariant
    {s : Set (ℕ → Bool)} (hs : BaireMeasurableSet s) (hinv : IsEventualEqInvariant s) :
    IsMeagre s ∨ IsMeagre sᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rcases hs.residualEq_isOpen with ⟨U, hU, hsU⟩
  by_cases hUne : U.Nonempty
  · right
    rcases hUne with ⟨z, hzU⟩
    rcases isTopologicalBasis_cantorCylinderBasis.exists_subset_of_mem_open hzU hU with
      ⟨C, ⟨c, N, rfl⟩, _hzC, hCU⟩
    let bad : Set (ℕ → Bool) := {x | ¬ (x ∈ s ↔ x ∈ U)}
    have hbad : IsMeagre bad := by
      change badᶜ ∈ residual (ℕ → Bool)
      change ∀ᶠ x in residual (ℕ → Bool), x ∈ badᶜ
      filter_upwards [hsU.mem_iff] with x hx
      simpa [bad] using hx
    have hpre (d : Fin N → Bool) : IsMeagre ((prefixToggle N d) ⁻¹' bad) :=
      hbad.preimage_of_isOpenMap (prefixToggle N d).continuous (prefixToggle N d).isOpenMap
    refine (isMeagre_iUnion hpre).mono ?_
    intro x hxs
    simp only [mem_compl_iff, mem_iUnion] at hxs ⊢
    rcases exists_prefixToggle_mem_cylinder c x N with ⟨d, hd⟩
    refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
    change prefixToggle N d x ∈ bad
    have hnot : prefixToggle N d x ∉ s := by
      intro hmem
      exact hxs ((hinv (eventualEq_prefixToggle N d x)).2 hmem)
    intro hiff
    exact hnot (hiff.2 (hCU hd))
  · left
    change sᶜ ∈ residual (ℕ → Bool)
    have hUe : U = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hUne
    change ∀ᶠ x in residual (ℕ → Bool), x ∈ sᶜ
    filter_upwards [hsU.mem_iff] with x hx
    simpa [hUe] using hx

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_residualEq_const_of_measurable_completeInvariant
statement:
theorem exists_residualEq_const_of_measurable_completeInvariant
    {f : (ℕ → Bool) → (ℕ → Bool)} (hf : Measurable f)
    (hrel : ∀ x y, eventualEq x y ↔ f x = f y) :
    ∃ b : ℕ → Bool, ∀ᶠ x in residual (ℕ → Bool), f x = b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A : ℕ → Set (ℕ → Bool) := fun n ↦ {x | f x n = true}
  have hAmeas (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet (A n) := by
    exact measurableSet_eq_fun ((measurable_pi_apply n).comp hf) measurable_const
  have hAinv (n : ℕ) : IsEventualEqInvariant (A n) := by
    intro x y hxy
    have hfx : f x = f y := (hrel x y).1 hxy
    simp only [A, mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [hfx]
  have hAzero (n : ℕ) : IsMeagre (A n) ∨ IsMeagre (A n)ᶜ :=
    isMeagre_or_compl_isMeagre_of_baireMeasurable_eventualEqInvariant
      (hAmeas n).baireMeasurableSet (hAinv n)
  let b : ℕ → Bool := fun n ↦ if IsMeagre (A n) then false else true
  have hcoord (n : ℕ) : ∀ᶠ x in residual (ℕ → Bool), f x n = b n := by
    by_cases hAm : IsMeagre (A n)
    · have hbn : b n = false := by simp [b, hAm]
      rw [hbn]
      change ∀ᶠ x in residual (ℕ → Bool), f x n = false
      change (A n)ᶜ ∈ residual (ℕ → Bool) at hAm
      filter_upwards [hAm] with x hx
      change f x n ≠ true at hx
      cases hfx : f x n <;> simp_all
    · have hAcm : IsMeagre (A n)ᶜ := (hAzero n).resolve_left hAm
      have hAr : A n ∈ residual (ℕ → Bool) := by
        simpa [IsMeagre] using hAcm
      have hbn : b n = true := by simp [b, hAm]
      rw [hbn]
      exact hAr
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_countable_forall.2 hcoord] with x hx
  funext n
  exact hx n

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.not_isSmooth_eventualEq
statement: theorem not_isSmooth_eventualEq : ¬ IsSmooth eventualEq
proof:
:= by
  intro hsmooth
  rcases hsmooth with ⟨_, Y, mY, hY, f, hf, hrel⟩
  letI : MeasurableSpace Y := mY
  letI : StandardBorelSpace Y := hY
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hjinj⟩ :=
    MeasurableSpace.measurable_injection_nat_bool_of_countablySeparated Y
  let g : (ℕ → Bool) → (ℕ → Bool) := fun x ↦ j (f x)
  have hg : Measurable g := hj.comp hf
  have hgrel (x y : ℕ → Bool) : eventualEq x y ↔ g x = g y := by
    constructor
    · intro hxy
      exact congrArg j ((hrel x y).1 hxy)
    · intro hxy
      exact (hrel x y).2 (hjinj hxy)
  rcases exists_residualEq_const_of_measurable_completeInvariant hg hgrel with ⟨b, hb⟩
  let F : Set (ℕ → Bool) := {x | g x = b}
  have hFr : F ∈ residual (ℕ → Bool) := by
    exact hb
  have hFnm : ¬ IsMeagre F := not_isMeagre_of_mem_residual hFr
  rcases nonempty_of_not_isMeagre hFnm with ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hsub : F ⊆ equivalenceClass eventualEq x := by
    intro y hy
    exact (hgrel x y).2 (hx.trans hy.symm)
  exact hFnm ((isMeagre_equivalenceClass_eventualEq x).mono hsub)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.eventualEq_equivalence
statement: theorem eventualEq_equivalence : Equivalence eventualEq
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    exact ⟨0, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  · rintro x y ⟨N, hN⟩
    exact ⟨N, fun n hn => (hN n hn).symm⟩
  · rintro x y z ⟨N, hN⟩ ⟨M, hM⟩
    refine ⟨max N M, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    exact (hN n ((Nat.le_max_left N M).trans hn)).trans
      (hM n ((Nat.le_max_right N M).trans hn))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelReduces.trans
proof:
:= by
  rcases hrs with ⟨f, hf, hfs⟩
  rcases hst with ⟨g, hg, hgt⟩
  refine ⟨g ∘ f, hg.comp hf, fun x x' ↦ ?_⟩

    BorelReduces r (transportEquivalenceRelation e r)
proof:
:= by

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurableEquiv_transport_borelReduces
statement:
theorem measurableEquiv_transport_borelReduces [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    (e : X ≃ᵐ Y) (r : X → X → Prop) :
    BorelReduces (transportEquivalenceRelation e r) r
proof:
:=
  borelReduces_pullback e.symm e.symm.measurable r

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.borelReduces_transport_iff
statement:
theorem borelReduces_transport_iff
    {X' Y' : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    [MeasurableSpace X'] [MeasurableSpace Y']
    (e : X ≃ᵐ X') (d : Y ≃ᵐ Y')
    (r : X → X → Prop) (s : Y → Y → Prop) :
    BorelReduces (transportEquivalenceRelation e r) (transportEquivalenceRelation d s) ↔
      BorelReduces r s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (measurableEquiv_borelReduces_transport e r).trans
      (h.trans (measurableEquiv_transport_borelReduces d s))
  · intro h
    exact (measurableEquiv_transport_borelReduces e r).trans
      (h.trans (measurableEquiv_borelReduces_transport d s))

proof:

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsSmooth.standardBorelSpace
statement:

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isSmooth_iff_exists_borelReduces_eq
statement:
theorem isSmooth_iff_exists_borelReduces_eq [mX : MeasurableSpace X]
    [StandardBorelSpace X]
    {r : X → X → Prop} :
    IsSmooth r ↔
      ∃ (Y : Type u) (mY : MeasurableSpace Y),
        @StandardBorelSpace Y mY ∧ @BorelReduces X Y mX mY r (@Eq Y)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, Y, mY, hY, h⟩
    exact ⟨Y, mY, hY, (@borelReduces_eq_iff X Y mX mY r).2 h⟩
  · rintro ⟨Y, mY, hY, h⟩
    exact ⟨inferInstance, Y, mY, hY, (@borelReduces_eq_iff X Y mX mY r).1 h⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelReduces.isSmooth
statement:
theorem BorelReduces.isSmooth
    {X Y : Type u} [mX : MeasurableSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X]
    [mY : MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace Y]
    {r : X → X → Prop} {s : Y → Y → Prop}
    (hrs : BorelReduces r s) (hs : IsSmooth s) : IsSmooth r
proof:
:= by
  rcases (isSmooth_iff_exists_borelReduces_eq (r := s)).1 hs with ⟨Z, mZ, hZ, hseq⟩
  exact (isSmooth_iff_exists_borelReduces_eq (r := r)).2
    ⟨Z, mZ, hZ, hrs.trans hseq⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isSmooth_transport_iff
statement:
theorem isSmooth_transport_iff
    {X Y : Type u} [MeasurableSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace Y]
    (e : X ≃ᵐ Y) (r : X → X → Prop) :
    IsSmooth (transportEquivalenceRelation e r) ↔ IsSmooth r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun h ↦ (measurableEquiv_borelReduces_transport e r).isSmooth h
  · exact fun h ↦ (measurableEquiv_transport_borelReduces e r).isSmooth h

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsSmooth.equivalence
statement:
theorem IsSmooth.equivalence [MeasurableSpace X]
    {r : X → X → Prop} (h : IsSmooth r) : Equivalence r
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨_, Y, _, _, f, _, hrel⟩
  exact ⟨fun x ↦ (hrel x x).2 rfl,
    fun hxx' ↦ (hrel _ _).2 ((hrel _ _).1 hxx').symm,
    fun hxy hyz ↦ (hrel _ _).2 (((hrel _ _).1 hxy).trans ((hrel _ _).1 hyz))⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsSmooth.isBorelRelation
statement:
theorem IsSmooth.isBorelRelation [mX : MeasurableSpace X]
    {r : X → X → Prop} (h : IsSmooth r) : IsBorelRelation r
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨_, Y, mY, hY, f, hf, hrel⟩
  letI : MeasurableSpace Y := mY
  letI : StandardBorelSpace Y := hY
  have hr : r = pullbackEquivalenceRelation f (@Eq Y) := by
    funext x x'
    exact propext (hrel x x')
  rw [hr]
  exact (isCountableBorelEquivalenceRelation_eq (X := Y)).2.1.pullbackEquivalenceRelation hf

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isSmooth_pullback_eq
statement:
theorem isSmooth_pullback_eq [MeasurableSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X]
    {Y : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace Y]
    (f : X → Y) (hf : Measurable f) :
    IsSmooth (pullbackEquivalenceRelation f (@Eq Y))
proof:
:= by
  refine (isSmooth_iff_exists_borelReduces_eq (r := pullbackEquivalenceRelation f (@Eq Y))).2 ?_
  exact ⟨Y, inferInstance, inferInstance, borelReduces_pullback f hf (@Eq Y)⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isSmooth_of_countable
statement:
theorem isSmooth_of_countable [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X] [Countable X]
    {r : X → X → Prop} (hr : Equivalence r) : IsSmooth r
proof:
:= by
  let s : Setoid X := ⟨r, hr⟩
  let mQ : MeasurableSpace (Quotient s) := ⊤
  refine ⟨inferInstance, Quotient s, mQ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · letI : MeasurableSpace (Quotient s) := mQ
    infer_instance
  · letI : MeasurableSpace (Quotient s) := mQ
    refine ⟨fun x ↦ Quotient.mk'' (s₁ := s) x, measurable_of_countable _, fun x x' ↦ ?_⟩
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact @Quotient.sound' X s x x' h
    · intro h
      exact (@Quotient.eq' X s x x').mp h

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isSmooth_of_finite
statement:
theorem isSmooth_of_finite [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X] [Finite X]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isOpenEmbedding_botCompacts
statement:
private theorem isOpenEmbedding_botCompacts :
    IsOpenEmbedding (fun _ : PUnit => (⊥ : Compacts X))
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpenEmbedding.of_continuous_injective_isOpenMap continuous_const
    (fun _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  intro s hs
  by_cases h : s.Nonempty
  · convert Compacts.isClopen_singleton_bot.isOpen using 1
    ext K
    simp [h]
  · rw [not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h]
    simp

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.polishSpace_compacts_vietoris
statement: theorem polishSpace_compacts_vietoris [PolishSpace X] : PolishSpace (Compacts X)
proof:
:= by
  letI : PolishSpace (NonemptyCompacts X) := polishSpace_nonemptyCompacts_vietoris
  let f : PUnit ⊕ NonemptyCompacts X → Compacts X :=
    Sum.elim (fun _ => ⊥) NonemptyCompacts.toCompacts
  have hf : IsOpenEmbedding f := by
    apply isOpenEmbedding_botCompacts.sumElim NonemptyCompacts.isOpenEmbedding_toCompacts
    intro a b hab
    rcases a with a | K <;> rcases b with b | L
    · exact congrArg Sum.inl (Subsingleton.elim a b)
    · have hsets : (∅ : Set X) = (L : Set X) := by
        simpa using congrArg (fun C : Compacts X => (C : Set X)) hab
      exact (L.nonempty.ne_empty hsets.symm).elim
    · have hsets : (K : Set X) = ∅ := by
        simpa using congrArg (fun C : Compacts X => (C : Set X)) hab
      exact (K.nonempty.ne_empty hsets).elim
    · exact congrArg Sum.inr (NonemptyCompacts.toCompacts_injective hab)
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro K
    by_cases hK : K = ⊥
    · exact ⟨Sum.inl PUnit.unit, hK.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨Sum.inr ⟨K, Compacts.coe_nonempty.mpr hK⟩, rfl⟩
  exact (hf.isEmbedding.toHomeomorphOfSurjective hsurj).symm.isClosedEmbedding.polishSpace

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.standardBorelSpace_compacts
statement:
theorem standardBorelSpace_compacts [PolishSpace X] :
    @StandardBorelSpace (Compacts X) compactsBorelMeasurableSpace
proof:
:= by
  letI : PolishSpace (Compacts X) := polishSpace_compacts_vietoris
  letI : MeasurableSpace (Compacts X) := compactsBorelMeasurableSpace
  letI : BorelSpace (Compacts X) := ⟨rfl⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.standardBorelSpace_nonemptyCompacts
statement:
theorem standardBorelSpace_nonemptyCompacts [PolishSpace X] :
    @StandardBorelSpace (NonemptyCompacts X) nonemptyCompactsBorelMeasurableSpace
proof:
:= by
  letI : PolishSpace (NonemptyCompacts X) := polishSpace_nonemptyCompacts_vietoris
  letI : MeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts X) := nonemptyCompactsBorelMeasurableSpace
  letI : BorelSpace (NonemptyCompacts X) := ⟨rfl⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_closedHit
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_closedHit {F : Closeds X} {U : Set X} :
    F ∈ closedHit U ↔ ((F : Set X) ∩ U).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurableSet_closedHit
statement:
theorem measurableSet_closedHit {U : Set X} (hU : IsOpen U) :
    @MeasurableSet (Closeds X) (effrosMeasurableSpace X) (closedHit U)
proof:
:=
  measurableSet_generateFrom ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.effrosMeasurableSpace_le_iff
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurableSpace_le_iff (m : MeasurableSpace (Closeds X)) :
    effrosMeasurableSpace X ≤ m ↔
      ∀ U : Set X, IsOpen U → @MeasurableSet (Closeds X) m (closedHit U)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h U hU
    exact h _ (measurableSet_closedHit hU)
  · intro h
    apply generateFrom_le
    rintro A ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩
    exact h U hU

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurable_effros_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf U hU
    exact hf (measurableSet_closedHit hU)
  · intro hf
    apply measurable_generateFrom
    rintro A ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩
    exact hf U hU

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.basisEffrosMeasurableSpace_eq
statement:
theorem basisEffrosMeasurableSpace_eq (b : ℕ → Set X)
    (hb : IsTopologicalBasis (range b)) :
    basisEffrosMeasurableSpace b = effrosMeasurableSpace X
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply generateFrom_le
    rintro A ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact measurableSet_closedHit (hb.isOpen (mem_range_self n))
  · letI : MeasurableSpace (Closeds X) := basisEffrosMeasurableSpace b
    apply generateFrom_le
    rintro A ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩
    let H : ℕ → Set (Closeds X) := fun n => if b n ⊆ U then closedHit (b n) else ∅
    have hH : ∀ n, @MeasurableSet (Closeds X) (basisEffrosMeasurableSpace b) (H n) := by
      intro n
      by_cases hn : b n ⊆ U
      · change @MeasurableSet (Closeds X) (basisEffrosMeasurableSpace b)
          (if b n ⊆ U then closedHit (b n) else ∅)
        rw [if_pos hn]
        exact measurableSet_generateFrom (mem_range_self n)
      · change @MeasurableSet (Closeds X) (basisEffrosMeasurableSpace b)
          (if b n ⊆ U then closedHit (b n) else ∅)
        rw [if_neg hn]
        exact MeasurableSet.empty
    have hEq : closedHit U = ⋃ n, H n := by
      ext F
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, hxF, hxU⟩
        obtain ⟨V, hVB, hxV, hVU⟩ := hb.exists_subset_of_mem_open hxU hU
        obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hVB
        refine mem_iUnion.2 ⟨n, ?_⟩
        change F ∈ (if b n ⊆ U then closedHit (b n) else ∅)
        rw [if_pos hVU]
        exact ⟨x, hxF, hxV⟩
      · intro hF
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := mem_iUnion.1 hF
        by_cases hbn : b n ⊆ U
        · change F ∈ (if b n ⊆ U then closedHit (b n) else ∅) at hn
          rw [if_pos hbn] at hn
          obtain ⟨x, hxF, hxb⟩ : ((F : Set X) ∩ b n).Nonempty := hn
          exact ⟨x, hxF, hbn hxb⟩
        · change F ∈ (if b n ⊆ U then closedHit (b n) else ∅) at hn
          rw [if_neg hbn] at hn
          simp at hn
    rw [hEq]
    exact MeasurableSet.iUnion hH

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurable_compactsToCloseds
proof:
:= by
  letI : MeasurableSpace (Compacts X) := compactsBorelMeasurableSpace
  rw [measurable_effros_iff]
  intro U hU
  change @MeasurableSet (Compacts X) compactsBorelMeasurableSpace
    {K | ((K : Set X) ∩ U).Nonempty}
  exact measurableSet_compactsHit hU

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_closedMembership
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_closedMembership {F : Closeds X} {x : X} :
    (F, x) ∈ closedMembership ↔ x ∈ F
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurableSet_closedMembership_of_basis
statement:
theorem measurableSet_closedMembership_of_basis [mX : MeasurableSpace X]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace X] (b : ℕ → Set X) (hb : IsTopologicalBasis (range b)) :
    @MeasurableSet (Closeds X × X) ((effrosMeasurableSpace X).prod mX)
      closedMembership
proof:
:= by
  letI : MeasurableSpace (Closeds X) := effrosMeasurableSpace X
  let A : ℕ → Set (Closeds X × X) := fun n =>
    {p | p.2 ∉ b n} ∪ {p | p.1 ∈ closedHit (b n)}
  have hA : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (A n) := by
    intro n
    have hOpen : IsOpen (b n) := hb.isOpen (mem_range_self n)
    have hLeft : MeasurableSet {p : Closeds X × X | p.2 ∉ b n} := by
      change MeasurableSet (Prod.snd ⁻¹' (b n)ᶜ)
      exact measurable_snd hOpen.measurableSet.compl
    have hRight : MeasurableSet {p : Closeds X × X | p.1 ∈ closedHit (b n)} := by
      change MeasurableSet (Prod.fst ⁻¹' closedHit (b n))
      exact measurable_fst (measurableSet_closedHit hOpen)
    exact hLeft.union hRight
  have hEq : closedMembership = ⋂ n, A n := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · intro hp
      rw [mem_iInter]
      intro n
      by_cases hpn : p.2 ∈ b n
      · exact Or.inr ⟨p.2, hp, hpn⟩
      · exact Or.inl hpn
    · intro hp
      rw [mem_iInter] at hp
      by_contra hnot
      have hxCompl : p.2 ∈ ((p.1 : Set X)ᶜ) := hnot
      obtain ⟨V, hVB, hxV, hVF⟩ :=
        hb.exists_subset_of_mem_open hxCompl p.1.isClosed.isOpen_compl
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hVB
      rcases hp n with hxb | hhit
      · exact hxb hxV
      · obtain ⟨y, hyF, hyb⟩ := hhit
        exact (hVF hyb) hyF
  rw [hEq]
  exact MeasurableSet.iInter hA

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurableSet_closedMembership
statement:
theorem measurableSet_closedMembership [mX : MeasurableSpace X]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X] :
    @MeasurableSet (Closeds X × X) ((effrosMeasurableSpace X).prod mX)
      closedMembership
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_seq_basis X
  exact measurableSet_closedMembership_of_basis b hb

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_pointClosedMembership
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_pointClosedMembership {F : Closeds X} {x : X} :
    (x, F) ∈ pointClosedMembership ↔ x ∈ F
proof:
:=

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurableSet_pointClosedMembership
statement:
theorem measurableSet_pointClosedMembership [mX : MeasurableSpace X]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X] :
    @MeasurableSet (X × Closeds X) (mX.prod (effrosMeasurableSpace X))
      pointClosedMembership
proof:
:= by
  letI : MeasurableSpace (Closeds X) := effrosMeasurableSpace X
  change MeasurableSet (Prod.swap ⁻¹' closedMembership)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurable_singletonCloseds
proof:
:= by
  letI : MeasurableSpace X := borel X
  rw [measurable_effros_iff]
  intro U hU
  have hpre : ({·} : X → Closeds X) ⁻¹' closedHit U = U := by
    ext x
    simp [closedHit]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurable_const_emptyCloseds

:= by

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.measurableSet_iff_analyticSet_and_isCoanalytic
statement:
theorem measurableSet_iff_analyticSet_and_isCoanalytic {s : Set X} :
    MeasurableSet s ↔ MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s ∧ IsCoanalytic s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs
    exact ⟨hs.analyticSet, hs.isCoanalytic⟩
  · rintro ⟨hs, hsc⟩
    exact hs.measurableSet_of_compl (isCoanalytic_iff_analyticSet_compl.1 hsc)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_borelCode_iff_analyticSet_and_isCoanalytic
statement:
theorem exists_borelCode_iff_analyticSet_and_isCoanalytic {s : Set X} :
    (∃ c : BorelCode X, c.eval = s) ↔
      MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s ∧ IsCoanalytic s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← BorelCode.measurableSet_iff_exists_code]
  exact measurableSet_iff_analyticSet_and_isCoanalytic

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_borelCode_separator_of_disjoint_analytic
statement:
theorem exists_borelCode_separator_of_disjoint_analytic
    [T2Space X] {s t : Set X} (hs : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s)
    (ht : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet t) (hst : Disjoint s t) :
    ∃ c : BorelCode X, s ⊆ c.eval ∧ Disjoint t c.eval
proof:
:= by
  letI : MeasurableSpace X := borel X
  letI : OpensMeasurableSpace X := ⟨le_rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hsu, htu, hu⟩ := hs.measurablySeparable ht hst
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := BorelCode.borelMeasurableSet_iff_exists_code.1 hu
  exact ⟨c, hsu, htu⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.exists_borelCode_separator_projectedBody
statement:
theorem exists_borelCode_separator_projectedBody
    [TopologicalSpace A] [DiscreteTopology A]
    [PolishSpace (ℕ → A)]
    (S T : Descriptive.tree (A × ℕ))
    (h : Disjoint (projectedBody S) (projectedBody T)) :
    ∃ c : BorelCode (ℕ → A), projectedBody S ⊆ c.eval ∧
      Disjoint (projectedBody T) c.eval
proof:
:= by
  have hS : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (projectedBody S) :=
    (analyticSet_iff_exists_projectedBody (projectedBody S)).2 ⟨S, rfl⟩
  have hT : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (projectedBody T) :=
    (analyticSet_iff_exists_projectedBody (projectedBody T)).2 ⟨T, rfl⟩
  exact exists_borelCode_separator_of_disjoint_analytic hS hT h

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.exists_borelCode_separator_projectedBody_baire
statement:
theorem exists_borelCode_separator_projectedBody_baire
    (S T : Descriptive.tree (ℕ × ℕ))
    (h : Disjoint (projectedBody S) (projectedBody T)) :
    ∃ c : BorelCode (ℕ → ℕ), projectedBody S ⊆ c.eval ∧
      Disjoint (projectedBody T) c.eval
proof:
:=
  exists_borelCode_separator_projectedBody S T h

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.mem_treeOfSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_treeOfSet {s : Set (ℕ → A)} {l : List A} :
    l ∈ treeOfSet s ↔ ∃ x ∈ s, IsInitialSegmentOf l x
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.initialSegment_mem_treeOfSet
statement:
theorem initialSegment_mem_treeOfSet {s : Set (ℕ → A)} {x : ℕ → A} (hx : x ∈ s)
    (n : ℕ) : initialSegment x n ∈ treeOfSet s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨x, hx, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  simp [initialSegment]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.subset_body_treeOfSet
statement: theorem subset_body_treeOfSet (s : Set (ℕ → A)) : s ⊆ body (treeOfSet s)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx n
  exact initialSegment_mem_treeOfSet hx n

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.body_treeOfSet_eq_closure
statement:
theorem body_treeOfSet_eq_closure [TopologicalSpace A] [DiscreteTopology A]
    (s : Set (ℕ → A)) : body (treeOfSet s) = closure s
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro x hx
    refine (PiNat.isTopologicalBasis_cylinders fun _ : ℕ => A).mem_closure_iff.mpr ?_
    intro o ho hxo
    rcases ho with ⟨z, n, rfl⟩
    rcases hx n with ⟨y, hys, hy⟩
    refine ⟨y, ?_, hys⟩
    rw [PiNat.mem_cylinder_iff] at hxo ⊢
    intro i hi
    have hxy : x i = y i := by
      simpa [initialSegment] using hy i (by simpa using hi)
    exact hxy.symm.trans (hxo i hi)
  · exact closure_minimal (subset_body_treeOfSet s) (isClosed_body (treeOfSet s))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.body_treeOfSet_of_isClosed
statement:
theorem body_treeOfSet_of_isClosed [TopologicalSpace A] [DiscreteTopology A]
    {s : Set (ℕ → A)} (hs : IsClosed s) : body (treeOfSet s) = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [body_treeOfSet_eq_closure, hs.closure_eq]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.initialSegment_pairSequences
statement:
theorem initialSegment_pairSequences (x : ℕ → A) (y : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    initialSegment (pairSequences (x, y)) n =
      (initialSegment x n).zip (initialSegment y n)
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_get
  · simp
  · intro i hi₁ hi₂
    simp [initialSegment, pairSequences]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.continuous_pairSequences
statement:
theorem continuous_pairSequences [TopologicalSpace A] [TopologicalSpace B] :
    Continuous (pairSequences : ((ℕ → A) × (ℕ → B)) → ℕ → A × B)
proof:
:= by
  exact continuous_pi fun n =>
    ((continuous_apply n).comp continuous_fst).prodMk
      ((continuous_apply n).comp continuous_snd)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.continuous_unpairSequences
statement:
theorem continuous_unpairSequences [TopologicalSpace A] [TopologicalSpace B] :
    Continuous (unpairSequences : (ℕ → A × B) → (ℕ → A) × (ℕ → B))
proof:
:= by
  exact (continuous_pi fun n => (continuous_apply n).fst).prodMk
    (continuous_pi fun n => (continuous_apply n).snd)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.pairSequencesHomeomorph_apply

@[simp]
theorem pairSequencesHomeomorph_apply [TopologicalSpace A] [TopologicalSpace B]

:=

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.pairSequencesHomeomorph_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pairSequencesHomeomorph_symm_apply [TopologicalSpace A] [TopologicalSpace B]
    (z : ℕ → A × B) :
    (pairSequencesHomeomorph (A := A) (B := B)).symm z = unpairSequences z

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.isClosed_pairedBody
statement:
theorem isClosed_pairedBody [TopologicalSpace A] [DiscreteTopology A]
    [TopologicalSpace B] [DiscreteTopology B] (T : Descriptive.tree (A × B)) :
    IsClosed (pairedBody T)

:=
  (isClosed_body T).preimage continuous_pairSequences

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.mem_projectedBody
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_projectedBody {T : Descriptive.tree (A × B)} {x : ℕ → A} :
    x ∈ projectedBody T ↔ ∃ y : ℕ → B, pairSequences (x, y) ∈ body T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨p.2, hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    exact ⟨(x, y), hy, rfl⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.analyticSet_projectedBody
statement:
theorem analyticSet_projectedBody [TopologicalSpace A] [DiscreteTopology A]
    [TopologicalSpace B] [DiscreteTopology B] [PolishSpace (ℕ → A)]
    [PolishSpace (ℕ → B)] (T : Descriptive.tree (A × B)) :
    MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (projectedBody T)

:= by

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.continuous_comparisonMap
statement:
theorem continuous_comparisonMap (P : CoanalyticRankPresentation A)
    (Q : CoanalyticRankPresentation B) : Continuous (comparisonMap P Q)
proof:
:=
  P.continuous_treeCode.prodMk Q.continuous_treeCode

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.isCoanalytic_leftReduction
statement:
theorem isCoanalytic_leftReduction (P : CoanalyticRankPresentation A)
    (Q : CoanalyticRankPresentation B) : IsCoanalytic (leftReduction P Q)
proof:
:=
  isCoanalytic_treeRankLeCoanalytic.preimage (continuous_comparisonMap P Q)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.isCoanalytic_rightReduction
statement:
theorem isCoanalytic_rightReduction (P : CoanalyticRankPresentation A)
    (Q : CoanalyticRankPresentation B) : IsCoanalytic (rightReduction P Q)
proof:
:=
  isCoanalytic_treeRankLtCoanalytic.preimage (continuous_comparisonMap Q P)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.mem_leftReduction_iff
statement:
theorem mem_leftReduction_iff (P : CoanalyticRankPresentation A)
    (Q : CoanalyticRankPresentation B) (x : ℕ → ℕ) :
    x ∈ leftReduction P Q ↔
      ∃ hxA : x ∈ A, x ∉ B ∨
        ∃ hxB : x ∈ B, P.rank x hxA ≤ Q.rank x hxB
proof:
:= by
  change (P.treeCode x, Q.treeCode x) ∈ treeRankLeCoanalytic ↔ _
  rw [mem_treeRankLeCoanalytic_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hPA, hQB | ⟨hQB, hrank⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨(P.mem_iff x).2 hPA, Or.inl (fun hxB => hQB (Q.wellFounded hxB))⟩
    · let hxA : x ∈ A := (P.mem_iff x).2 hPA
      let hxB : x ∈ B := (Q.mem_iff x).2 hQB
      exact ⟨hxA, Or.inr ⟨hxB, by simpa [rank] using hrank⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨hxA, hxB | ⟨hxB, hrank⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨P.wellFounded hxA, Or.inl (fun hQB => hxB ((Q.mem_iff x).2 hQB))⟩
    · exact ⟨P.wellFounded hxA, Or.inr ⟨Q.wellFounded hxB,
        by simpa [rank] using hrank⟩⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.mem_rightReduction_iff
statement:
theorem mem_rightReduction_iff (P : CoanalyticRankPresentation A)
    (Q : CoanalyticRankPresentation B) (x : ℕ → ℕ) :
    x ∈ rightReduction P Q ↔
      ∃ hxB : x ∈ B, x ∉ A ∨
        ∃ hxA : x ∈ A, Q.rank x hxB < P.rank x hxA
proof:
:= by
  change (Q.treeCode x, P.treeCode x) ∈ treeRankLtCoanalytic ↔ _
  rw [mem_treeRankLtCoanalytic_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hQB, hPA | ⟨hPA, hrank⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨(Q.mem_iff x).2 hQB, Or.inl (fun hxA => hPA (P.wellFounded hxA))⟩
    · let hxB : x ∈ B := (Q.mem_iff x).2 hQB
      let hxA : x ∈ A := (P.mem_iff x).2 hPA
      exact ⟨hxB, Or.inr ⟨hxA, by simpa [rank] using hrank⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨hxB, hxA | ⟨hxA, hrank⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨Q.wellFounded hxB, Or.inl (fun hPA => hxA ((P.mem_iff x).2 hPA))⟩
    · exact ⟨Q.wellFounded hxB, Or.inr ⟨P.wellFounded hxA,
        by simpa [rank] using hrank⟩⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.leftReduction_subset
statement:
theorem leftReduction_subset (P : CoanalyticRankPresentation A)
    (Q : CoanalyticRankPresentation B) : leftReduction P Q ⊆ A
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact (mem_leftReduction_iff P Q x).1 hx |>.choose

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.rightReduction_subset
statement:
theorem rightReduction_subset (P : CoanalyticRankPresentation A)
    (Q : CoanalyticRankPresentation B) : rightReduction P Q ⊆ B
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact (mem_rightReduction_iff P Q x).1 hx |>.choose

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.disjoint_reductions
statement:
theorem disjoint_reductions (P : CoanalyticRankPresentation A)
    (Q : CoanalyticRankPresentation B) : Disjoint (leftReduction P Q) (rightReduction P Q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_iff]
  rintro x ⟨hxLeft, hxRight⟩
  obtain ⟨hxA, hleft⟩ := (mem_leftReduction_iff P Q x).1 hxLeft
  obtain ⟨hxB, hright⟩ := (mem_rightReduction_iff P Q x).1 hxRight
  rcases hleft with hxnotB | ⟨hxB', hle⟩
  · exact hxnotB hxB
  rcases hright with hxnotA | ⟨hxA', hlt⟩
  · exact hxnotA hxA
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hle) (by simpa using hlt)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.union_reductions
statement:
theorem union_reductions (P : CoanalyticRankPresentation A)
    (Q : CoanalyticRankPresentation B) :
    leftReduction P Q ∪ rightReduction P Q = A ∪ B
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact Set.union_subset_union (leftReduction_subset P Q) (rightReduction_subset P Q)
  · intro x hx
    rcases hx with hxA | hxB
    · by_cases hxB : x ∈ B
      · by_cases hle : P.rank x hxA ≤ Q.rank x hxB
        · exact Or.inl ((mem_leftReduction_iff P Q x).2 ⟨hxA, Or.inr ⟨hxB, hle⟩⟩)
        · exact Or.inr ((mem_rightReduction_iff P Q x).2
            ⟨hxB, Or.inr ⟨hxA, lt_of_not_ge hle⟩⟩)
      · exact Or.inl ((mem_leftReduction_iff P Q x).2 ⟨hxA, Or.inl hxB⟩)
    · by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
      · by_cases hle : P.rank x hxA ≤ Q.rank x hxB
        · exact Or.inl ((mem_leftReduction_iff P Q x).2 ⟨hxA, Or.inr ⟨hxB, hle⟩⟩)
        · exact Or.inr ((mem_rightReduction_iff P Q x).2
            ⟨hxB, Or.inr ⟨hxA, lt_of_not_ge hle⟩⟩)
      · exact Or.inr ((mem_rightReduction_iff P Q x).2 ⟨hxB, Or.inl hxA⟩)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.mem_rankStage_iff
statement:
theorem mem_rankStage_iff (P : CoanalyticRankPresentation A) (ξ : Ordinal.{0})
    (x : ℕ → ℕ) :
    x ∈ P.rankStage ξ ↔ ∃ hx : x ∈ A, P.rank x hx < ξ
proof:
:= by
  change P.treeCode x ∈ treeRankLT ξ ↔ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hWF, hrank⟩
    let hx : x ∈ A := (P.mem_iff x).2 hWF
    exact ⟨hx, by simpa [rank] using hrank⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hrank⟩
    exact ⟨P.wellFounded hx, by simpa [rank] using hrank⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.measurableSet_rankStage
statement:
theorem measurableSet_rankStage (P : CoanalyticRankPresentation A) {ξ : Ordinal.{0}}
    (hξ : ξ < ω₁) : MeasurableSet (P.rankStage ξ)
proof:
:= by
  letI : MeasurableSpace TreeCode := borel TreeCode
  letI : BorelSpace TreeCode := ⟨rfl⟩
  have hstage : MeasurableSet (treeRankLT ξ) := borelMeasurableSet_treeRankLT hξ
  have hanalytic : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (treeRankLT ξ) := hstage.analyticSet
  have hcoanalytic : IsCoanalytic (treeRankLT ξ) := hstage.isCoanalytic
  exact measurableSet_iff_analyticSet_and_isCoanalytic.mpr
    ⟨hanalytic.preimage P.continuous_treeCode,
      hcoanalytic.preimage P.continuous_treeCode⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.rankStage_subset
statement:
theorem rankStage_subset (P : CoanalyticRankPresentation A) (ξ : Ordinal.{0}) :
    P.rankStage ξ ⊆ A
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact (P.mem_rankStage_iff ξ x).1 hx |>.choose

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.CoanalyticRankPresentation.exists_borelCode_envelope_of_rank
statement:
theorem exists_borelCode_envelope_of_rank (P : CoanalyticRankPresentation A)
    {S : Set (ℕ → ℕ)} (hS : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet S) (hSA : S ⊆ A) :
    ∃ ξ : Ordinal.{0}, ξ < ω₁ ∧
      ∃ c : BorelCode (ℕ → ℕ), c.eval = P.rankStage ξ ∧
        S ⊆ c.eval ∧ c.eval ⊆ A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hbound⟩ := P.bounded_of_analytic hS hSA
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := BorelCode.measurableSet_iff_exists_code.mp
    (P.measurableSet_rankStage hξ)
  refine ⟨ξ, hξ, c, hc, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    rw [hc]
    exact (P.mem_rankStage_iff ξ x).2 ⟨hSA hx, hbound x hx⟩
  · rw [hc]
    exact P.rankStage_subset ξ

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_coanalytic_reduction
statement:
theorem exists_coanalytic_reduction {A B : Set (ℕ → ℕ)}
    (hA : IsCoanalytic A) (hB : IsCoanalytic B) :
    ∃ C D : Set (ℕ → ℕ), IsCoanalytic C ∧ IsCoanalytic D ∧
      C ⊆ A ∧ D ⊆ B ∧ Disjoint C D ∧ C ∪ D = A ∪ B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := exists_coanalyticRankPresentation hA
  obtain ⟨Q⟩ := exists_coanalyticRankPresentation hB
  exact ⟨P.leftReduction Q, P.rightReduction Q,
    P.isCoanalytic_leftReduction Q, P.isCoanalytic_rightReduction Q,
    P.leftReduction_subset Q, P.rightReduction_subset Q,
    P.disjoint_reductions Q, P.union_reductions Q⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_borelCode_separator_of_rank
statement:
theorem exists_borelCode_separator_of_rank {s t : Set (ℕ → ℕ)}
    (hs : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s) (ht : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet t)
    (hst : Disjoint s t) :
    ∃ c : BorelCode (ℕ → ℕ), s ⊆ c.eval ∧ Disjoint t c.eval
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := exists_coanalyticRankPresentation (isCoanalytic_compl_iff.2 hs)
  obtain ⟨Q⟩ := exists_coanalyticRankPresentation (isCoanalytic_compl_iff.2 ht)
  let C := P.leftReduction Q
  let D := P.rightReduction Q
  have hCco : IsCoanalytic C := P.isCoanalytic_leftReduction Q
  have hDco : IsCoanalytic D := P.isCoanalytic_rightReduction Q
  have hCsub : C ⊆ sᶜ := P.leftReduction_subset Q
  have hDsub : D ⊆ tᶜ := P.rightReduction_subset Q
  have hCD : Disjoint C D := P.disjoint_reductions Q
  have hcover : C ∪ D = Set.univ := by
    rw [P.union_reductions Q]
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro
      trivial
    · intro
      by_cases hxs : x ∈ s
      · exact Or.inr (fun hxt => hst.notMem_of_mem_left hxs hxt)
      · exact Or.inl hxs
  have hCcompl : Cᶜ = D := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hxnotC
      have hxuniv : x ∈ C ∪ D := by rw [hcover]; trivial
      rcases hxuniv with hxC | hxD
      · exact (hxnotC hxC).elim
      · exact hxD
    · intro hxD hxC
      exact hCD.notMem_of_mem_right hxD hxC
  have hDanalytic : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet D := by
    rw [← hCcompl]
    exact hCco
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
    exists_borelCode_iff_analyticSet_and_isCoanalytic.mpr ⟨hDanalytic, hDco⟩
  refine ⟨c, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hxs
    rw [hc]
    have hxuniv : x ∈ C ∪ D := by rw [hcover]; trivial
    rcases hxuniv with hxC | hxD
    · exact (hCsub hxC hxs).elim
    · exact hxD
  · rw [hc, Set.disjoint_iff]
    rintro x ⟨hxt, hxD⟩
    exact hDsub hxD hxt

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isCoanalytic_iff_analyticSet_compl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isCoanalytic_iff_analyticSet_compl {s : Set X} :

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isCoanalytic_compl_iff
statement:
theorem isCoanalytic_compl_iff {s : Set X} :

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.isCoanalytic_compl
statement:
theorem MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.isCoanalytic_compl {s : Set X}
    (hs : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s) : IsCoanalytic sᶜ
proof:

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsCoanalytic.preimage
statement:
protected theorem IsCoanalytic.preimage [TopologicalSpace Y] [PolishSpace X] [T2Space Y]
    {s : Set Y} (hs : IsCoanalytic s) {f : X → Y} (hf : Continuous f) :
    IsCoanalytic (f ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= by

name: MeasurableSet.isCoanalytic
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasurableSet.isCoanalytic [PolishSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X]

proof:

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.analyticSet_iff_exists_projectedBody
statement:
theorem analyticSet_iff_exists_projectedBody
    [TopologicalSpace A] [DiscreteTopology A] [PolishSpace (ℕ → A)]
    (s : Set (ℕ → A)) :
    MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s ↔
      ∃ T : Descriptive.tree (A × ℕ), projectedBody T = s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs
    rw [MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet] at hs
    rcases hs with rfl | ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨⊥, by simp [projectedBody, pairedBody]⟩
    · let graph : Set ((ℕ → A) × (ℕ → ℕ)) := {p | f p.2 = p.1}
      have hgraph : IsClosed graph := isClosed_eq (hf.comp continuous_snd) continuous_fst
      let codedGraph : Set (ℕ → A × ℕ) :=
        (pairSequencesHomeomorph (A := A) (B := ℕ)).symm ⁻¹' graph
      have hcodedGraph : IsClosed codedGraph :=
        hgraph.preimage (pairSequencesHomeomorph (A := A) (B := ℕ)).symm.continuous
      refine ⟨treeOfSet codedGraph, ?_⟩
      ext x
      rw [mem_projectedBody, body_treeOfSet_of_isClosed hcodedGraph]
      simp only [codedGraph, mem_preimage, pairSequencesHomeomorph_symm_apply,
        unpairSequences, graph, mem_setOf_eq, mem_range]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, hxy⟩
        exact ⟨y, hxy⟩
      · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨T, rfl⟩
    exact analyticSet_projectedBody T

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.analyticSet_iff_exists_projectedBody_baire
statement:
theorem analyticSet_iff_exists_projectedBody_baire (s : Set (ℕ → ℕ)) :
    MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s ↔
      ∃ T : Descriptive.tree (ℕ × ℕ), projectedBody T = s
proof:

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.Tree.analyticSet_iff_exists_projectedBody_cantor

theorem analyticSet_iff_exists_projectedBody_cantor (s : Set (ℕ → Bool)) :

      ∃ T : Descriptive.tree (Bool × ℕ), projectedBody T = s
proof:
:= by
  letI : MetricSpace (ℕ → Bool) :=
    PiNat.metricSpaceOfDiscreteUniformity fun _ => rfl
  exact analyticSet_iff_exists_projectedBody s

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.take_initialSegment_of_le
statement:
private theorem take_initialSegment_of_le {A : Type*} (x : ℕ → A) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    (initialSegment x n).take m = initialSegment x m
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp [length_initialSegment, hmn]
  · intro i hi₁ hi₂
    simp [initialSegment]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.bairePrefixCylinder_anti
statement:
theorem bairePrefixCylinder_anti {s t : List ℕ} (hst : s <+: t) :
    bairePrefixCylinder t ⊆ bairePrefixCylinder s
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  change initialSegment p t.length = t at hp
  change initialSegment p s.length = s
  have hlen : s.length ≤ t.length := hst.length_le
  calc
    initialSegment p s.length = (initialSegment p t.length).take s.length :=
      (take_initialSegment_of_le p hlen).symm
    _ = t.take s.length := congrArg (fun r => r.take s.length) hp
    _ = s := (List.prefix_iff_eq_take.mp hst).symm

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.prefixImage_anti
statement:
theorem prefixImage_anti (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X) {s t : List ℕ} (hst : s <+: t) :
    prefixImage f t ⊆ prefixImage f s
proof:
:=
  image_mono (bairePrefixCylinder_anti hst)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsLargePrefix.of_prefix
statement:
theorem IsLargePrefix.of_prefix (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X) {s t : List ℕ} (hst : s <+: t)
    (ht : IsLargePrefix f t) : IsLargePrefix f s
proof:
:= by
  intro hs
  exact ht (hs.mono (prefixImage_anti f hst))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.countable_countableLocalImage
statement:
theorem countable_countableLocalImage (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X) :
    (countableLocalImage f).Countable
proof:
:= by
  unfold countableLocalImage
  exact countable_iUnion fun s => countable_iUnion fun hs => hs

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isLargePrefix_of_mem_not_countableLocalImage
statement:
theorem isLargePrefix_of_mem_not_countableLocalImage (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X)
    {s : List ℕ} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ prefixImage f s) (hxbad : x ∉ countableLocalImage f) :
    IsLargePrefix f s
proof:
:= by
  intro hs
  exact hxbad (mem_iUnion_of_mem s (mem_iUnion_of_mem hs hx))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.not_countable_prefixImage_sdiff_countableLocalImage
statement:
theorem not_countable_prefixImage_sdiff_countableLocalImage (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X)
    {s : List ℕ} (hs : IsLargePrefix f s) :
    ¬(prefixImage f s \ countableLocalImage f).Countable
proof:
:= by
  intro hdiff
  exact hs (hdiff.of_sdiff (countable_countableLocalImage f))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.nontrivial_of_not_countable
statement: private theorem nontrivial_of_not_countable {A : Set X} (hA : ¬A.Countable) : A.Nontrivial
proof:
:= by
  by_contra htriv
  apply hA
  by_cases hne : A.Nonempty
  · rcases hne with ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact (countable_singleton x).mono fun y hy => by
      have hyx : y = x := by
        by_contra h
        exact htriv ⟨y, hy, x, hx, h⟩
      simp [hyx]
  · rw [not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne]
    exact countable_empty

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.IsLargePrefix.prefixImage_nonempty
statement:
theorem IsLargePrefix.prefixImage_nonempty (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X) {s : List ℕ}
    (hs : IsLargePrefix f s) : (prefixImage f s).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  apply hs
  rw [not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne]
  exact countable_empty

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_large_extension_image_subset
statement:
private theorem exists_large_extension_image_subset [TopologicalSpace X]
    (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X) (hf : Continuous f) {s : List ℕ} {p : ℕ → ℕ} {U : Set X}
    (hps : p ∈ bairePrefixCylinder s) (hpbad : f p ∉ countableLocalImage f)
    (hUopen : IsOpen U) (hfpU : f p ∈ U) :
    ∃ t : List ℕ, s <+: t ∧ s.length < t.length ∧ IsLargePrefix f t ∧
      prefixImage f t ⊆ U
proof:
:= by
  have hpreopen : IsOpen (f ⁻¹' U) := hUopen.preimage hf
  rcases (PiNat.isTopologicalBasis_cylinders (fun _ : ℕ => ℕ)).exists_subset_of_mem_open
      hfpU hpreopen with ⟨C, ⟨q, n, rfl⟩, hpC, hCsub⟩
  have hCsub' : PiNat.cylinder p n ⊆ f ⁻¹' U := by
    rw [PiNat.mem_cylinder_iff_eq.mp hpC]
    exact hCsub
  let m := max n (s.length + 1)
  let t := initialSegment p m
  have hsm : s.length ≤ m :=
    (Nat.le_succ s.length).trans (Nat.le_max_right n (s.length + 1))
  have hst : s <+: t := by
    have hprefix := Tree.initialSegment_prefix p hsm
    change initialSegment p s.length = s at hps
    simpa [t, hps] using hprefix
  have hslt : s.length < t.length := by
    calc
      s.length < m :=
        (Nat.lt_succ_self s.length).trans_le (Nat.le_max_right n (s.length + 1))
      _ = t.length := by simp [t]
  have htC : bairePrefixCylinder t ⊆ PiNat.cylinder p n := by
    change bairePrefixCylinder (initialSegment p m) ⊆ PiNat.cylinder p n
    rw [bairePrefixCylinder_initialSegment]
    exact PiNat.cylinder_anti p (Nat.le_max_left n (s.length + 1))
  have hlarge : IsLargePrefix f t := by
    apply isLargePrefix_of_mem_not_countableLocalImage f
    · exact ⟨p, by
          change p ∈ bairePrefixCylinder (initialSegment p m)
          rw [bairePrefixCylinder_initialSegment]
          exact PiNat.self_mem_cylinder p m, rfl⟩
    · exact hpbad
  refine ⟨t, hst, hslt, hlarge, ?_⟩
  rintro x ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
  exact hCsub' (htC hr)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.nonempty_largeImageSplit
statement:
private theorem nonempty_largeImageSplit [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X) (hf : Continuous f) (s : largePrefixTree f) :
    Nonempty (LargeImageSplit f s)
proof:
:= by
  have hremain := not_countable_prefixImage_sdiff_countableLocalImage f s.2
  rcases nontrivial_of_not_countable hremain with
    ⟨x, ⟨hx, hxbad⟩, y, ⟨hy, hybad⟩, hxy⟩
  rcases hx with ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
  rcases t2_separation hxy with ⟨U, V, hUopen, hVopen, hfpU, hfqV, hUV⟩
  rcases exists_large_extension_image_subset f hf hp hxbad hUopen hfpU with
    ⟨t, hst, hslt, htlarge, htU⟩
  rcases exists_large_extension_image_subset f hf hq hybad hVopen hfqV with
    ⟨u, hsu, hsul, hularge, huV⟩
  have hdis : Disjoint (prefixImage f t) (prefixImage f u) := hUV.mono htU huV
  have hinc : Tree.AreIncompatible t u := by
    constructor
    · intro htu
      rcases hularge.prefixImage_nonempty f with ⟨z, hz⟩
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdis (prefixImage_anti f htu hz) hz
    · intro hut
      rcases htlarge.prefixImage_nonempty f with ⟨z, hz⟩
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdis hz (prefixImage_anti f hut hz)
  exact ⟨{
    left := ⟨t, htlarge⟩
    right := ⟨u, hularge⟩
    prefix_left := hst
    prefix_right := hsu
    length_lt_left := hslt
    length_lt_right := hsul
    incompatible := hinc
    image_disjoint := hdis
  }⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ImageSplittingSystem.children_image_disjoint_of_ne
statement:
theorem children_image_disjoint_of_ne (s : List Bool) {b c : Bool} (hbc : b ≠ c) :
    Disjoint (prefixImage f (S.node (s ++ [b])))
      (prefixImage f (S.node (s ++ [c])))
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> cases c
  · exact (hbc rfl).elim
  · exact S.children_image_disjoint s
  · exact (S.children_image_disjoint s).symm
  · exact (hbc rfl).elim

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ImageSplittingSystem.sourceBranch_mem_nodeCylinder
statement:
theorem sourceBranch_mem_nodeCylinder (q : ℕ → Bool) (m : ℕ) :
    S.sourceBranch q ∈ bairePrefixCylinder (S.node (initialSegment q m))
proof:
:= by
  change initialSegment (S.sourceBranch q) (S.node (initialSegment q m)).length =
    S.node (initialSegment q m)
  exact (S.toBinarySplittingSystem.node_eq_initialSegment_branchMap q m).symm

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ImageSplittingSystem.continuous_cantorMap
statement: theorem continuous_cantorMap (hf : Continuous f) : Continuous S.cantorMap
proof:
:=
  hf.comp S.toBinarySplittingSystem.continuous_branchMap

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ImageSplittingSystem.injective_cantorMap
statement: theorem injective_cantorMap : Function.Injective S.cantorMap
proof:
:= by
  intro q r hqr
  have hsegments : ∀ n, initialSegment q n = initialSegment r n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
        have hbit : q n = r n := by
          by_contra hbit
          have hdis := S.children_image_disjoint_of_ne (initialSegment q n) hbit
          have hqmem : S.cantorMap q ∈
              prefixImage f (S.node (initialSegment q n ++ [q n])) := by
            refine ⟨S.sourceBranch q, ?_, rfl⟩
            simpa [initialSegment_succ] using S.sourceBranch_mem_nodeCylinder q (n + 1)
          have hrmem : S.cantorMap r ∈
              prefixImage f (S.node (initialSegment q n ++ [r n])) := by
            refine ⟨S.sourceBranch r, ?_, rfl⟩
            simpa [initialSegment_succ, ih] using S.sourceBranch_mem_nodeCylinder r (n + 1)
          exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdis hqmem (hqr ▸ hrmem)
        simp [initialSegment_succ, ih, hbit]
  funext n
  have h := hsegments (n + 1)
  rw [initialSegment_succ, initialSegment_succ, hsegments n] at h
  simpa using List.append_cancel_left h

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ImageSplittingSystem.range_cantorMap_subset_range
statement: theorem range_cantorMap_subset_range : range S.cantorMap ⊆ range f
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨q, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨S.sourceBranch q, rfl⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ImageSplittingSystem.isClosedEmbedding_cantorMap
statement:
theorem isClosedEmbedding_cantorMap [T2Space X] (hf : Continuous f) :
    IsClosedEmbedding S.cantorMap
proof:
:=
  (S.continuous_cantorMap hf).isClosedEmbedding S.injective_cantorMap

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ImageSplittingSystem.isEmbedding_cantorMap
statement: theorem isEmbedding_cantorMap [T2Space X] (hf : Continuous f) : IsEmbedding S.cantorMap
proof:
:=
  (S.isClosedEmbedding_cantorMap hf).isEmbedding

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ImageSplittingSystem.isClosed_range_cantorMap
statement:
theorem isClosed_range_cantorMap [T2Space X] (hf : Continuous f) :
    IsClosed (range S.cantorMap)
proof:
:=
  (S.isClosedEmbedding_cantorMap hf).isClosed_range

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.prefix_nextLargeNode
statement:
private theorem prefix_nextLargeNode [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X) (hf : Continuous f) (s : largePrefixTree f) (b : Bool) :
    s.1 <+: (nextLargeNode f hf s b).1
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> simp [nextLargeNode, (chosenLargeImageSplit f hf s).prefix_left,
    (chosenLargeImageSplit f hf s).prefix_right]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.length_lt_nextLargeNode
statement:
private theorem length_lt_nextLargeNode [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X) (hf : Continuous f) (s : largePrefixTree f) (b : Bool) :
    s.1.length < (nextLargeNode f hf s b).1.length
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> simp [nextLargeNode, (chosenLargeImageSplit f hf s).length_lt_left,
    (chosenLargeImageSplit f hf s).length_lt_right]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.nextLargeNodes_incompatible
statement:
private theorem nextLargeNodes_incompatible [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X) (hf : Continuous f) (s : largePrefixTree f) :
    Tree.AreIncompatible (nextLargeNode f hf s false).1 (nextLargeNode f hf s true).1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [nextLargeNode] using (chosenLargeImageSplit f hf s).incompatible

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.nextLargeNodes_image_disjoint
statement:
private theorem nextLargeNodes_image_disjoint [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X) (hf : Continuous f) (s : largePrefixTree f) :
    Disjoint (prefixImage f (nextLargeNode f hf s false).1)
      (prefixImage f (nextLargeNode f hf s true).1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [nextLargeNode] using (chosenLargeImageSplit f hf s).image_disjoint

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.prefixImage_nil
statement: private theorem prefixImage_nil (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X) : prefixImage f [] = range f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, _, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨p, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨p, by simp [bairePrefixCylinder], rfl⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.root_mem_largePrefixTree
statement:
private theorem root_mem_largePrefixTree (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X)
    (hunc : ¬(range f).Countable) : [] ∈ largePrefixTree f
proof:
:= by
  change IsLargePrefix f []
  rw [IsLargePrefix, prefixImage_nil]
  exact hunc

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.largeNodeAt_append
statement:
private theorem largeNodeAt_append [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X) (hf : Continuous f) (hunc : ¬(range f).Countable)
    (s : List Bool) (b : Bool) :
    largeNodeAt f hf hunc (s ++ [b]) = nextLargeNode f hf (largeNodeAt f hf hunc s) b
proof:
:= by
  simp [largeNodeAt]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_imageSplittingSystem
statement:
theorem exists_imageSplittingSystem [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X) (hf : Continuous f) (hunc : ¬(range f).Countable) :
    Nonempty (ImageSplittingSystem f)
proof:
:= by
  let S : ImageSplittingSystem f :=
    { node := fun s => (largeNodeAt f hf hunc s).1
      node_large := fun s => (largeNodeAt f hf hunc s).2
      node_prefix_child := fun s b => by
        rw [largeNodeAt_append]
        exact prefix_nextLargeNode f hf (largeNodeAt f hf hunc s) b
      node_length_lt_child := fun s b => by
        rw [largeNodeAt_append]
        exact length_lt_nextLargeNode f hf (largeNodeAt f hf hunc s) b
      children_incompatible := fun s => by
        rw [largeNodeAt_append, largeNodeAt_append]
        exact nextLargeNodes_incompatible f hf (largeNodeAt f hf hunc s)
      children_image_disjoint := fun s => by
        rw [largeNodeAt_append, largeNodeAt_append]
        exact nextLargeNodes_image_disjoint f hf (largeNodeAt f hf hunc s) }
  exact ⟨S⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor_of_continuous_range
statement:
theorem exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor_of_continuous_range [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X) (hf : Continuous f) (hunc : ¬(range f).Countable) :
    ∃ e : (ℕ → Bool) → X, IsClosedEmbedding e ∧ range e ⊆ range f
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_imageSplittingSystem f hf hunc with ⟨S⟩
  exact ⟨S.cantorMap, S.isClosedEmbedding_cantorMap hf, S.range_cantorMap_subset_range⟩

name: MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor
    [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] {s : Set X} (hs : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s)
    (hunc : ¬s.Countable) :
    ∃ e : (ℕ → Bool) → X, IsClosedEmbedding e ∧ range e ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet] at hs
  rcases hs with rfl | ⟨f, hf, hfs⟩
  · exact (hunc countable_empty).elim
  · have hunc' : ¬(range f).Countable := by simpa [hfs] using hunc
    rcases exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor_of_continuous_range f hf hunc' with
      ⟨e, he, herange⟩
    exact ⟨e, he, herange.trans (by simp [hfs])⟩

name: MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.exists_continuous_injective_cantor
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.exists_continuous_injective_cantor
    [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] {s : Set X} (hs : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s)
    (hunc : ¬s.Countable) :
    ∃ e : (ℕ → Bool) → X, Continuous e ∧ Function.Injective e ∧ range e ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  rcases hs.exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor hunc with ⟨e, he, hes⟩
  exact ⟨e, he.continuous, he.isEmbedding.injective, hes⟩

name: MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.exists_isEmbedding_cantor
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.exists_isEmbedding_cantor
    [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] {s : Set X} (hs : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s)
    (hunc : ¬s.Countable) :
    ∃ e : (ℕ → Bool) → X, IsEmbedding e ∧ range e ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  rcases hs.exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor hunc with ⟨e, he, hes⟩
  exact ⟨e, he.isEmbedding, hes⟩

name: MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.exists_closed_cantor_copy
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.exists_closed_cantor_copy
    [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] {s : Set X} (hs : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s)
    (hunc : ¬s.Countable) :
    ∃ C : Set X, C ⊆ s ∧ IsClosed C ∧ Nonempty ((ℕ → Bool) ≃ₜ C)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hs.exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor hunc with ⟨e, he, hes⟩
  exact ⟨range e, hes, he.isClosed_range, ⟨he.isEmbedding.toHomeomorph⟩⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.analyticSet_exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor_baire
proof:
:=
  hs.exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor hunc

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.analyticSet_exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor_cantor
proof:
:=
  hs.exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor hunc

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.not_countable_univ_cantor
statement: theorem not_countable_univ_cantor : ¬(univ : Set (ℕ → Bool)).Countable
proof:
:= by
  intro hcount
  rcases hcount.exists_eq_range univ_nonempty with ⟨g, hg⟩
  let diagonal : ℕ → Bool := fun n => !(g n n)
  have hd : diagonal ∈ range g := by rw [← hg]; exact mem_univ _
  rcases hd with ⟨n, hn⟩
  have hcoordinate := congrFun hn n
  cases h : g n n <;> simp [diagonal, h] at hcoordinate

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.not_countable_range_of_injective_cantor
statement:
theorem not_countable_range_of_injective_cantor (e : (ℕ → Bool) → X)
    (he : Function.Injective e) : ¬(range e).Countable
proof:
:= by
  intro hrange
  apply not_countable_univ_cantor
  apply countable_of_injective_of_countable_image he.injOn
  simpa only [image_univ] using hrange

name: Set.Countable.not_exists_injective_cantor_subset
statement:
theorem _root_.Set.Countable.not_exists_injective_cantor_subset {s : Set X} (hs : s.Countable) :
    ¬∃ e : (ℕ → Bool) → X, Function.Injective e ∧ range e ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨e, he, hes⟩
  exact not_countable_range_of_injective_cantor e he (hs.mono hes)

name: Set.Countable.not_exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor_subset
statement:
theorem _root_.Set.Countable.not_exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor_subset [TopologicalSpace X]
    {s : Set X} (hs : s.Countable) :
    ¬∃ e : (ℕ → Bool) → X, IsClosedEmbedding e ∧ range e ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨e, he, hes⟩
  exact hs.not_exists_injective_cantor_subset ⟨e, he.isEmbedding.injective, hes⟩

name: MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.countable_or_exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.countable_or_exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor
    [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] {s : Set X} (hs : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s) :
    s.Countable ∨
      ∃ e : (ℕ → Bool) → X, IsClosedEmbedding e ∧ range e ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact if hcount : s.Countable then Or.inl hcount else Or.inr
    (hs.exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor hcount)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.not_countable_and_exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor
statement:
theorem not_countable_and_exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor
    [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} :
    ¬(s.Countable ∧
      ∃ e : (ℕ → Bool) → X, IsClosedEmbedding e ∧ range e ⊆ s)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨hcount, he⟩
  exact hcount.not_exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor_subset he

name: MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.not_countable_iff_exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.not_countable_iff_exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor
    [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] {s : Set X} (hs : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s) :
    ¬s.Countable ↔
      ∃ e : (ℕ → Bool) → X, IsClosedEmbedding e ∧ range e ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact hs.exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor
  · rintro ⟨e, he, hes⟩ hcount
    exact hcount.not_exists_injective_cantor_subset
      ⟨e, he.isEmbedding.injective, hes⟩

name: MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.countable_iff_not_exists_injective_cantor
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.countable_iff_not_exists_injective_cantor
    [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] {s : Set X} (hs : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s) :
    s.Countable ↔
      ¬∃ e : (ℕ → Bool) → X, Function.Injective e ∧ range e ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact Set.Countable.not_exists_injective_cantor_subset
  · intro hnone
    by_contra hunc
    rcases hs.exists_continuous_injective_cantor hunc with ⟨e, _, he, hes⟩
    exact hnone ⟨e, he, hes⟩

name: MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.exists_uncountable_closed_subset
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.exists_uncountable_closed_subset
    [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] {s : Set X} (hs : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s)
    (hunc : ¬s.Countable) :
    ∃ C : Set X, C ⊆ s ∧ IsClosed C ∧ ¬C.Countable
proof:
:= by
  rcases hs.exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor hunc with ⟨e, he, hes⟩
  exact ⟨range e, hes, he.isClosed_range,
    not_countable_range_of_injective_cantor e he.isEmbedding.injective⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.analyticSet_countable_or_closedCantor_baire
statement:
theorem analyticSet_countable_or_closedCantor_baire {s : Set (ℕ → ℕ)}
    (hs : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s) :
    s.Countable ∨
      ∃ e : (ℕ → Bool) → (ℕ → ℕ), IsClosedEmbedding e ∧ range e ⊆ s
proof:
:=
  hs.countable_or_exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.analyticSet_countable_or_closedCantor_cantor
statement:
theorem analyticSet_countable_or_closedCantor_cantor {s : Set (ℕ → Bool)}
    (hs : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s) :
    s.Countable ∨
      ∃ e : (ℕ → Bool) → (ℕ → Bool), IsClosedEmbedding e ∧ range e ⊆ s
proof:
:=
  hs.countable_or_exists_isClosedEmbedding_cantor

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.prependSequence_tailSequence
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  cases n <;> rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.initialSegment_prependSequence
statement:
private theorem initialSegment_prependSequence (a : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    initialSegment (prependSequence a f) (n + 1) = [a] ++ initialSegment f n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [initialSegment_succ, initialSegment_zero]
      rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [initialSegment_succ, ih, initialSegment_succ]
      rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_subtreeSuslinOperation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_subtreeSuslinOperation {A : List ℕ → Set X} {s : List ℕ} {x : X} :
    x ∈ subtreeSuslinOperation A s ↔
      ∃ f : ℕ → ℕ, ∀ n, x ∈ A (s ++ initialSegment f n)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.subtreeSuslinOperation_subset
statement:
theorem subtreeSuslinOperation_subset (A : List ℕ → Set X) (s : List ℕ) :
    subtreeSuslinOperation A s ⊆ A s
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨f, hf⟩
  simpa using hf 0

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.subtreeSuslinOperation_eq_iUnion_children
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨f, hf⟩
    refine mem_iUnion.2 ⟨f 0, ?_⟩
    refine ⟨tailSequence f, fun n => ?_⟩
    have h := hf (n + 1)
    have hseg := initialSegment_prependSequence (f 0) (tailSequence f) n
    rw [prependSequence_tailSequence] at hseg
    rw [hseg] at h
    simpa [List.append_assoc] using h
  · rintro x hx
    rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨a, f, hf⟩
    refine ⟨prependSequence a f, ?_⟩
    intro n
    cases n with
    | zero =>
        have hchild : x ∈ A (s ++ [a]) := by simpa using hf 0
        have hroot : x ∈ A s :=
          hA (show s <+: s ++ [a] from ⟨[a], rfl⟩) hchild
        simpa using hroot
    | succ n =>
        rw [initialSegment_prependSequence]
        simpa [List.append_assoc] using hf n

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_initialSegment_branch
statement:
private theorem exists_initialSegment_branch {H : List ℕ → Set X} {x : X}
    (hroot : x ∈ H [])
    (hstep : ∀ s : List ℕ, x ∈ H s → ∃ a, x ∈ H (s ++ [a])) :
    ∃ f : ℕ → ℕ, ∀ n, x ∈ H (initialSegment f n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let next : List ℕ → ℕ := fun s =>
    if hs : x ∈ H s then Classical.choose (hstep s hs) else 0
  have hnext (s : List ℕ) (hs : x ∈ H s) : x ∈ H (s ++ [next s]) := by
    rw [show next s = Classical.choose (hstep s hs) by simp [next, hs]]
    exact Classical.choose_spec (hstep s hs)
  let path : ℕ → List ℕ := fun n =>
    Nat.rec [] (fun _ s => s ++ [next s]) n
  have path_zero : path 0 = [] := rfl
  have path_succ (n : ℕ) : path (n + 1) = path n ++ [next (path n)] := rfl
  have hpath : ∀ n, x ∈ H (path n) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa [path_zero] using hroot
    | succ n ih =>
        rw [path_succ]
        exact hnext (path n) ih
  let f : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => next (path n)
  refine ⟨f, fun n => ?_⟩
  have hsegments : ∀ m, initialSegment f m = path m := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp [path_zero]
    | succ m ih =>
        rw [initialSegment_succ, ih, path_succ]
  rw [hsegments n]
  exact hpath n

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isMeagre_symmDiff_of_residualEq
statement:
private theorem isMeagre_symmDiff_of_residualEq {s t : Set X} (h : s =ᵇ t) :
    IsMeagre (s ∆ t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsMeagre]
  filter_upwards [h] with x hx
  simp only [mem_compl_iff, mem_symmDiff]
  tauto

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.residualEq_of_isMeagre_symmDiff
statement:
private theorem residualEq_of_isMeagre_symmDiff {s t : Set X}
    (h : IsMeagre (s ∆ t)) : s =ᵇ t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Filter.eventuallyEq_set]
  rw [IsMeagre] at h
  filter_upwards [h] with x hx
  simp only [mem_compl_iff, mem_symmDiff] at hx
  tauto

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isOpen_smallBasisUnion
proof:
:= by
  apply isOpen_iUnion
  intro n
  apply isOpen_iUnion
  intro _
  exact hb.isOpen (mem_range_self n)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isMeagre_diff_compl_smallBasisUnion
statement:
private theorem isMeagre_diff_compl_smallBasisUnion (b : ℕ → Set X) (A : Set X) :
    IsMeagre (A \ (smallBasisUnion b A)ᶜ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show A \ (smallBasisUnion b A)ᶜ =
      ⋃ n, ⋃ (_ : IsMeagre (b n ∩ A)), A ∩ b n by
    ext x
    simp only [smallBasisUnion, mem_sdiff, mem_compl_iff, mem_iUnion, mem_inter_iff]
    aesop]
  apply isMeagre_iUnion
  intro n
  apply isMeagre_iUnion
  intro hn
  simpa [inter_comm] using hn

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.baireMeasurableSet_baireCoverWithBasis
proof:
:= by
  rw [show baireCoverWithBasis b A =
      (smallBasisUnion b A)ᶜ ∪ (A \ (smallBasisUnion b A)ᶜ) by
    ext x
    simp [baireCoverWithBasis]
    tauto]
  exact (isOpen_smallBasisUnion b hb A).baireMeasurableSet.compl.union
    (isMeagre_diff_compl_smallBasisUnion b A).baireMeasurableSet

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isMeagre_of_baireMeasurableSet_subset_cover_diff
statement:
private theorem isMeagre_of_baireMeasurableSet_subset_cover_diff
    (b : ℕ → Set X) (hb : TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis (range b))
    (A C : Set X) (hC : BaireMeasurableSet C)
    (hsub : C ⊆ baireCoverWithBasis b A \ A) : IsMeagre C
proof:
:= by
  rcases hC.residualEq_isOpen with ⟨U, hUopen, hCU⟩
  have herror : IsMeagre (C ∆ U) := isMeagre_symmDiff_of_residualEq hCU
  have hUA : IsMeagre (U ∩ A) := by
    apply herror.mono
    intro x hx
    have hnotC : x ∉ C := fun hxC => (hsub hxC).2 hx.2
    exact mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr ⟨hx.1, hnotC⟩)
  have hUsub : U ⊆ smallBasisUnion b A := by
    intro x hxU
    rcases hb.exists_subset_of_mem_open hxU hUopen with ⟨V, hVb, hxV, hVU⟩
    rcases hVb with ⟨n, rfl⟩
    have hn : IsMeagre (b n ∩ A) := by
      apply hUA.mono
      intro y hy
      exact ⟨hVU hy.1, hy.2⟩
    exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨n, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨hn, hxV⟩⟩
  apply herror.mono
  intro x hxC
  have hxcover := (hsub hxC).1
  have hxnotA := (hsub hxC).2
  have hxsmall : x ∉ smallBasisUnion b A := by
    rcases hxcover with hxA | hxcompl
    · exact (hxnotA hxA).elim
    · exact hxcompl
  exact mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl ⟨hxC, fun hxU => hxsmall (hUsub hxU)⟩)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_baireMeasurable_cover
statement:
theorem exists_baireMeasurable_cover [SecondCountableTopology X] (A : Set X) :
    ∃ B : Set X, A ⊆ B ∧ BaireMeasurableSet B ∧
      ∀ ⦃C : Set X⦄, BaireMeasurableSet C → C ⊆ B \ A → IsMeagre C
proof:
:= by
  rcases TopologicalSpace.exists_seq_basis X with ⟨b, hb⟩
  exact ⟨baireCoverWithBasis b A, subset_union_left,
    baireMeasurableSet_baireCoverWithBasis b hb A,
    isMeagre_of_baireMeasurableSet_subset_cover_diff b hb A⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BaireMeasurableSet.suslinOperation_of_regular
statement:
theorem suslinOperation_of_regular [SecondCountableTopology X] {A : List ℕ → Set X}
    (hcomponents : ∀ s, BaireMeasurableSet (A s))
    (hregular : IsRegularSuslinScheme A) :
    BaireMeasurableSet (suslinOperation A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose B hB using fun s : List ℕ =>
    exists_baireMeasurable_cover (subtreeSuslinOperation A s)
  have hsub (s : List ℕ) : subtreeSuslinOperation A s ⊆ B s :=
    (hB s).1
  have hBaire (s : List ℕ) : BaireMeasurableSet (B s) :=
    (hB s).2.1
  have hsmall (s : List ℕ) {C : Set X} (hC : BaireMeasurableSet C)
      (hCsub : C ⊆ B s \ subtreeSuslinOperation A s) : IsMeagre C :=
    (hB s).2.2 hC hCsub
  let H : List ℕ → Set X := fun s => B s ∩ A s
  let E : List ℕ → Set X := fun s => H s \ ⋃ a, H (s ++ [a])
  let M : Set X := ⋃ s, E s
  have hHBaire (s : List ℕ) : BaireMeasurableSet (H s) :=
    (hBaire s).inter (hcomponents s)
  have hvalueH (s : List ℕ) : subtreeSuslinOperation A s ⊆ H s := by
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨hsub s hx, subtreeSuslinOperation_subset A s hx⟩
  have hEBaire (s : List ℕ) : BaireMeasurableSet (E s) := by
    exact (hHBaire s).diff <| BaireMeasurableSet.iUnion fun a => hHBaire (s ++ [a])
  have hEsub (s : List ℕ) : E s ⊆ B s \ subtreeSuslinOperation A s := by
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨hx.1.1, fun hxvalue => ?_⟩
    have hxchildren : x ∈ ⋃ a, subtreeSuslinOperation A (s ++ [a]) := by
      rw [← subtreeSuslinOperation_eq_iUnion_children hregular s]
      exact hxvalue
    rcases mem_iUnion.1 hxchildren with ⟨a, hxa⟩
    exact hx.2 (mem_iUnion.2 ⟨a, hvalueH (s ++ [a]) hxa⟩)
  have hEMeagre (s : List ℕ) : IsMeagre (E s) :=
    hsmall s (hEBaire s) (hEsub s)
  have hMMeagre : IsMeagre M :=
    isMeagre_iUnion hEMeagre
  have hrootDiff : H [] \ M ⊆ suslinOperation A := by
    intro x hx
    have hstep (s : List ℕ) (hxs : x ∈ H s) : ∃ a, x ∈ H (s ++ [a]) := by
      have hxnotE : x ∉ E s := fun hxE => hx.2 (mem_iUnion.2 ⟨s, hxE⟩)
      have hxunion : x ∈ ⋃ a, H (s ++ [a]) := by
        by_contra hnot
        exact hxnotE ⟨hxs, hnot⟩
      exact mem_iUnion.1 hxunion
    rcases exists_initialSegment_branch hx.1 hstep with ⟨f, hf⟩
    exact ⟨f, fun n => (hf n).2⟩
  have hsymmSub : H [] ∆ suslinOperation A ⊆ M := by
    intro x hx
    rcases mem_symmDiff.1 hx with hxleft | hxright
    · by_contra hxM
      exact hxleft.2 (hrootDiff ⟨hxleft.1, hxM⟩)
    · exact (hxright.2 (hvalueH [] hxright.1)).elim
  have hresidual : H [] =ᵇ suslinOperation A :=
    residualEq_of_isMeagre_symmDiff (hMMeagre.mono hsymmSub)
  exact (hHBaire []).congr hresidual

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BaireMeasurableSet.regularizeScheme
statement:
theorem regularizeScheme (A : List ℕ → Set X)
    (hA : ∀ s, BaireMeasurableSet (A s)) (s : List ℕ) :
    BaireMeasurableSet (DescriptiveSetTheory.regularizeScheme A s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show DescriptiveSetTheory.regularizeScheme A s =
      ⋂ t : {t : List ℕ // t <+: s}, A t.1 by
    ext x
    simp [DescriptiveSetTheory.regularizeScheme]]
  exact BaireMeasurableSet.iInter fun t => hA t.1

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BaireMeasurableSet.suslinOperation
statement:
theorem suslinOperation [SecondCountableTopology X] (A : List ℕ → Set X)
    (hA : ∀ s, BaireMeasurableSet (A s)) :
    BaireMeasurableSet (DescriptiveSetTheory.suslinOperation A)
proof:
:= by
  have hregularized : ∀ s,
      BaireMeasurableSet (DescriptiveSetTheory.regularizeScheme A s) :=
    regularizeScheme A hA
  have hresult := suslinOperation_of_regular hregularized
    (isRegularSuslinScheme_regularizeScheme A)
  rw [DescriptiveSetTheory.suslinOperation_regularizeScheme] at hresult
  exact hresult

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.bairePrefixCylinder_initialSegment
statement:
theorem bairePrefixCylinder_initialSegment (p : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    bairePrefixCylinder (initialSegment p n) = PiNat.cylinder p n
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  change initialSegment q (initialSegment p n).length = initialSegment p n ↔
    ∀ i, i < n → q i = p i
  rw [length_initialSegment]
  constructor
  · intro h i hi
    have hfun : (fun j : Fin n => q j) = fun j : Fin n => p j :=
      List.ofFn_injective (by simpa [initialSegment] using h)
    exact congrFun hfun ⟨i, hi⟩
  · intro h
    change List.ofFn (fun j : Fin n => q j) = List.ofFn fun j : Fin n => p j
    exact congrArg List.ofFn (funext fun i => h i i.2)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isClosed_closedRangeScheme
statement:
theorem isClosed_closedRangeScheme [TopologicalSpace X] (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X) (s : List ℕ) :
    IsClosed (closedRangeScheme f s)
proof:
:=
  isClosed_closure

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.suslinOperation_closedRangeScheme
statement:
theorem suslinOperation_closedRangeScheme [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (f : (ℕ → ℕ) → X) (hf : Continuous f) :
    suslinOperation (closedRangeScheme f) = range f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
    have hxp : x = f p := by
      by_contra hne
      rcases t2_separation hne with ⟨U, V, hUopen, hVopen, hxU, hfpV, hUV⟩
      have hpreopen : IsOpen (f ⁻¹' V) := hVopen.preimage hf
      have hppre : p ∈ f ⁻¹' V := hfpV
      rcases (PiNat.isTopologicalBasis_cylinders (fun _ : ℕ => ℕ)).exists_subset_of_mem_open
          hppre hpreopen with ⟨C, ⟨q, n, rfl⟩, hpC, hCsub⟩
      have hcylinder : PiNat.cylinder p n ⊆ f ⁻¹' V := by
        rw [PiNat.mem_cylinder_iff_eq.1 hpC]
        exact hCsub
      have hxclosure : x ∈ closure (f '' PiNat.cylinder p n) := by
        simpa [closedRangeScheme, bairePrefixCylinder_initialSegment] using hp n
      rcases (mem_closure_iff.1 hxclosure U hUopen hxU) with ⟨z, hzU, y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hUV hzU (hcylinder hy)
    exact ⟨p, hxp.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨p, fun n => ?_⟩
    change f p ∈ closure (f '' bairePrefixCylinder (initialSegment p n))
    apply subset_closure
    refine ⟨p, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [bairePrefixCylinder_initialSegment]
    exact PiNat.self_mem_cylinder p n

name: MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.baireMeasurableSet
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.baireMeasurableSet [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] {s : Set X} (hs : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s) :
    BaireMeasurableSet s
proof:
:= by
  rw [MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet] at hs
  rcases hs with rfl | ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  · exact IsMeagre.empty.baireMeasurableSet
  · rw [← suslinOperation_closedRangeScheme f hf]
    exact BaireMeasurableSet.suslinOperation _ fun t =>
      (isClosed_closedRangeScheme f t).isOpen_compl.baireMeasurableSet.of_compl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.IsValid.exists_kindAt
statement:
theorem exists_kindAt (s : List ℕ) (hs : s ∈ c.tree) :
    ∃ kind, c.kindAt? s = some kind
proof:
:= by
  have hcoherent := IsValid.coherent h s hs
  cases hkind : c.kindAt? s with
  | none =>
      unfold Raw.IsCoherentAt IsCoherentLabel at hcoherent
      change NodeKind.ofCode? (c.labels s).1 = none at hkind
      rw [hkind] at hcoherent
      exact hcoherent.elim
  | some kind => exact ⟨kind, rfl⟩

theorem noChildren_of_kindAt?_eq_empty {s : List ℕ} (hs : s ∈ c.tree)

proof:

    simpa only [Raw.HasExpectedChildrenAt, hkind] using

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.IsValid.payload_eq_zero_of_kindAt?_eq
statement:
theorem payload_eq_zero_of_kindAt?_eq {s : List ℕ} (hs : s ∈ c.tree)
    {kind : NodeKind} (hkind : kind ≠ .basic) (htag : c.kindAt? s = some kind) :
    c.payloadAt s = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcoherent := IsValid.coherent h s hs
  unfold Raw.IsCoherentAt IsCoherentLabel at hcoherent
  change NodeKind.ofCode? (c.labels s).1 = some kind at htag
  rw [htag] at hcoherent
  cases kind with
  | basic => exact (hkind rfl).elim
  | empty | compl | iUnion => simpa [Raw.payloadAt] using hcoherent

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.accRank_lt_omega_one
statement:
private theorem accRank_lt_omega_one {c : Raw} {s : c.tree}
    (h : Acc (Tree.Child c.tree) s) : h.rank < (ω₁ : Ordinal.{0})
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | intro s hbelow ih =>
      rw [Acc.rank_eq]
      apply Ordinal.iSup_lt_omega_one
      intro child
      exact (isSuccLimit_omega 1).succ_lt (ih child.1 child.2)

  unfold Tree.nodeRank _root_.IsWellFounded.rank

  have hcontinuous : Continuous (fun c : Raw => c.kindAt? s) :=
