name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.hasLocalShape_iff
statement:
private theorem hasLocalShape_iff (c : Raw) (s : List ℕ) :
    HasLocalShape c s ↔ c.IsCoherentAt s ∧ c.HasExpectedChildrenAt s
proof:
:= by
  change HasLocalShape c s ↔
    (match c.kindAt? s with
      | some .basic => True
      | some _ => c.payloadAt s = 0
      | none => False) ∧ c.HasExpectedChildrenAt s
  cases hkind : c.kindAt? s with
  | none => simp [HasLocalShape, Raw.HasExpectedChildrenAt, hkind]
  | some kind =>
      cases kind <;> simp [HasLocalShape, Raw.HasExpectedChildrenAt, hkind]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.measurableSet_hasLocalShape
statement:
private theorem measurableSet_hasLocalShape (s : List ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet {c : Raw | HasLocalShape c s}
proof:
:= by
  have hnoChildren : MeasurableSet {c : Raw | ∀ n, s ++ [n] ∉ c.tree} := by
    rw [show {c : Raw | ∀ n, s ++ [n] ∉ c.tree} =
        ⋂ n, {c | s ++ [n] ∉ c.tree} by ext; simp]
    exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun n => measurableSet_notMemTree (s ++ [n])
  have hotherChildren :
      MeasurableSet {c : Raw | ∀ n, n ≠ 0 → s ++ [n] ∉ c.tree} := by
    rw [show {c : Raw | ∀ n, n ≠ 0 → s ++ [n] ∉ c.tree} =
        ⋂ n, if n = 0 then Set.univ else {c | s ++ [n] ∉ c.tree} by
      ext c
      simp]
    exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun n => by
      by_cases hn : n = 0
      · simp [hn]
      · simpa [hn] using measurableSet_notMemTree (s ++ [n])
  have hempty : MeasurableSet {c : Raw |
      c.kindAt? s = some .empty ∧ c.payloadAt s = 0 ∧
        ∀ n, s ++ [n] ∉ c.tree} :=
    (measurableSet_kindAt s .empty).inter
      ((isClopen_payloadCoordinate s 0).isOpen.measurableSet.inter hnoChildren)
  have hbasic : MeasurableSet {c : Raw |
      c.kindAt? s = some .basic ∧ ∀ n, s ++ [n] ∉ c.tree} :=
    (measurableSet_kindAt s .basic).inter hnoChildren
  have hcompl : MeasurableSet {c : Raw |
      c.kindAt? s = some .compl ∧ c.payloadAt s = 0 ∧
        s ++ [0] ∈ c.tree ∧ ∀ n, n ≠ 0 → s ++ [n] ∉ c.tree} :=
    (measurableSet_kindAt s .compl).inter
      ((isClopen_payloadCoordinate s 0).isOpen.measurableSet.inter
        ((measurableSet_memTree (s ++ [0])).inter hotherChildren))
  have hallChildren : MeasurableSet {c : Raw | ∀ n, s ++ [n] ∈ c.tree} := by
    rw [show {c : Raw | ∀ n, s ++ [n] ∈ c.tree} =
        ⋂ n, {c | s ++ [n] ∈ c.tree} by ext; simp]
    exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun n => measurableSet_memTree (s ++ [n])
  have hiUnion : MeasurableSet {c : Raw |
      c.kindAt? s = some .iUnion ∧ c.payloadAt s = 0 ∧
        ∀ n, s ++ [n] ∈ c.tree} :=
    (measurableSet_kindAt s .iUnion).inter
      ((isClopen_payloadCoordinate s 0).isOpen.measurableSet.inter hallChildren)
  exact hempty.union (hbasic.union (hcompl.union hiUnion))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.measurableSet_isLocallyValid
statement:
theorem measurableSet_isLocallyValid :
    MeasurableSet {c : Raw | IsLocallyValid c}
proof:
:= by
  rw [show {c : Raw | IsLocallyValid c} =
      {c | [] ∈ c.tree} ∩
        ⋂ s : List ℕ, {c | s ∉ c.tree} ∪ {c | HasLocalShape c s} by
    ext c
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_union]
    change IsLocallyValid c ↔
      [] ∈ c.tree ∧ ∀ s : List ℕ, s ∉ c.tree ∨ HasLocalShape c s
    constructor
    · intro h
      refine ⟨h.root_mem, fun s => ?_⟩
      by_cases hs : s ∈ c.tree
      · exact Or.inr ((hasLocalShape_iff c s).2
          ⟨h.coherent s hs, h.expectedChildren s hs⟩)
      · exact Or.inl hs
    · rintro ⟨hroot, hall⟩
      refine ⟨hroot, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro s hs
        rcases hall s with hnot | hshape
        · exact (hnot hs).elim
        · exact (hasLocalShape_iff c s).1 hshape |>.1
      · intro s hs
        rcases hall s with hnot | hshape
        · exact (hnot hs).elim
        · exact (hasLocalShape_iff c s).1 hshape |>.2]
  exact (measurableSet_memTree []).inter
    (MeasurableSet.iInter fun s =>
      (measurableSet_notMemTree s).union (measurableSet_hasLocalShape s))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.measurableSet_codeKindAtOnWitness
statement:
private theorem measurableSet_codeKindAtOnWitness (s : List ℕ) (kind : NodeKind) :
    MeasurableSet {p : ((Raw × X) × Valuation) | p.1.1.kindAt? s = some kind}
proof:
:=
  (measurableSet_kindAt s kind).preimage (measurable_fst.comp measurable_fst)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.measurableSet_codePayloadAtOnWitness
statement:
private theorem measurableSet_codePayloadAtOnWitness (s : List ℕ) (value : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet {p : ((Raw × X) × Valuation) | p.1.1.payloadAt s = value}
proof:
:=
  (isClopen_payloadCoordinate s value).isOpen.measurableSet.preimage
    (measurable_fst.comp measurable_fst)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.measurableSet_codeMemTreeOnWitness
statement:
private theorem measurableSet_codeMemTreeOnWitness (s : List ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet {p : ((Raw × X) × Valuation) | s ∈ p.1.1.tree}
proof:
:=
  (measurableSet_memTree s).preimage (measurable_fst.comp measurable_fst)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.measurableSet_codeNotMemTreeOnWitness
statement:
private theorem measurableSet_codeNotMemTreeOnWitness (s : List ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet {p : ((Raw × X) × Valuation) | s ∉ p.1.1.tree}
proof:
:=
  (measurableSet_notMemTree s).preimage (measurable_fst.comp measurable_fst)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.measurableSet_valuationCoordinate
statement:
private theorem measurableSet_valuationCoordinate (s : List ℕ) (truth : Bool) :
    MeasurableSet {p : ((Raw × X) × Valuation) | p.2 s = truth}
proof:
:= by
  have hmeasurable : Measurable (fun p : ((Raw × X) × Valuation) => p.2 s) :=
    (measurable_pi_apply s).comp measurable_snd
  simpa [Set.preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using
    hmeasurable (measurableSet_singleton truth)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.measurableSet_variableBasicMembership
proof:
:= by
  rw [show {p : ((Raw × X) × Valuation) |
      p.1.2 ∈ b (p.1.1.payloadAt s)} =
      ⋃ n : ℕ, {p | p.1.1.payloadAt s = n} ∩ {p | p.1.2 ∈ b n} by
    ext p
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_inter_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hp
      exact ⟨p.1.1.payloadAt s, rfl, hp⟩
    · rintro ⟨n, hn, hp⟩
      rwa [hn]]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n =>
    (measurableSet_codePayloadAtOnWitness s n).inter
      ((hb n).preimage (measurable_snd.comp measurable_fst))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.measurableSet_satisfiesAt
proof:
:= by
  have hvTrue := measurableSet_valuationCoordinate (X := X) s true
  have hvFalse := measurableSet_valuationCoordinate (X := X) s false
  have hbasicMem := measurableSet_variableBasicMembership b hb s
  have hbasicEq : MeasurableSet {p : ((Raw × X) × Valuation) |
      p.2 s = true ↔ p.1.2 ∈ b (p.1.1.payloadAt s)} := by
    rw [show {p : ((Raw × X) × Valuation) |
        (p.2 s = true ↔ p.1.2 ∈ b (p.1.1.payloadAt s))} =
        ({p | p.2 s = true} ∩
          {p | p.1.2 ∈ b (p.1.1.payloadAt s)}) ∪
        ({p | p.2 s = false} ∩
          {p | p.1.2 ∈ b (p.1.1.payloadAt s)}ᶜ) by
      ext p
      cases h : p.2 s <;> simp [h]]
    exact (hvTrue.inter hbasicMem).union (hvFalse.inter hbasicMem.compl)
  have hchildTrue := measurableSet_valuationCoordinate (X := X) (s ++ [0]) true
  have hchildFalse := measurableSet_valuationCoordinate (X := X) (s ++ [0]) false
  have hcomplEq : MeasurableSet {p : ((Raw × X) × Valuation) |
      p.2 s = true ↔ p.2 (s ++ [0]) = false} := by
    rw [show {p : ((Raw × X) × Valuation) |
        (p.2 s = true ↔ p.2 (s ++ [0]) = false)} =
        ({p | p.2 s = true} ∩ {p | p.2 (s ++ [0]) = false}) ∪
        ({p | p.2 s = false} ∩ {p | p.2 (s ++ [0]) = true}) by
      ext p
      cases hs : p.2 s <;> cases hc : p.2 (s ++ [0]) <;> simp [hs, hc]]
    exact (hvTrue.inter hchildFalse).union (hvFalse.inter hchildTrue)
  have hexistsTrue : MeasurableSet {p : ((Raw × X) × Valuation) |
      ∃ n, p.2 (s ++ [n]) = true} := by
    rw [show {p : ((Raw × X) × Valuation) | ∃ n, p.2 (s ++ [n]) = true} =
        ⋃ n, {p | p.2 (s ++ [n]) = true} by ext; simp]
    exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n =>
      measurableSet_valuationCoordinate (X := X) (s ++ [n]) true
  have hiUnionEq : MeasurableSet {p : ((Raw × X) × Valuation) |
      p.2 s = true ↔ ∃ n, p.2 (s ++ [n]) = true} := by
    rw [show {p : ((Raw × X) × Valuation) |
        (p.2 s = true ↔ ∃ n, p.2 (s ++ [n]) = true)} =
        ({p | p.2 s = true} ∩ {p | ∃ n, p.2 (s ++ [n]) = true}) ∪
        ({p | p.2 s = false} ∩ {p | ∃ n, p.2 (s ++ [n]) = true}ᶜ) by
      ext p
      cases h : p.2 s <;> simp [h]]
    exact (hvTrue.inter hexistsTrue).union (hvFalse.inter hexistsTrue.compl)
  rw [show {p : ((Raw × X) × Valuation) |
      SatisfiesAt b p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2 s} =
      ({p | p.1.1.kindAt? s = some .empty} ∩ {p | p.2 s = false}) ∪
      (({p | p.1.1.kindAt? s = some .basic} ∩
        {p | p.2 s = true ↔ p.1.2 ∈ b (p.1.1.payloadAt s)}) ∪
      (({p | p.1.1.kindAt? s = some .compl} ∩
        {p | p.2 s = true ↔ p.2 (s ++ [0]) = false}) ∪
      ({p | p.1.1.kindAt? s = some .iUnion} ∩
        {p | p.2 s = true ↔ ∃ n, p.2 (s ++ [n]) = true}))) by
    ext p
    cases hkind : p.1.1.kindAt? s with
    | none => simp [SatisfiesAt, hkind]
    | some kind => cases kind <;> simp [SatisfiesAt, hkind]]
  exact ((measurableSet_codeKindAtOnWitness (X := X) s .empty).inter hvFalse).union
    (((measurableSet_codeKindAtOnWitness (X := X) s .basic).inter hbasicEq).union
      (((measurableSet_codeKindAtOnWitness (X := X) s .compl).inter hcomplEq).union
        ((measurableSet_codeKindAtOnWitness (X := X) s .iUnion).inter hiUnionEq)))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.measurableSet_evaluationWitnesses
statement:
theorem measurableSet_evaluationWitnesses (b : ℕ → Set X)
    (hb : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (b n)) (truth : Bool) :
    MeasurableSet (evaluationWitnesses b truth)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show evaluationWitnesses b truth =
      (⋂ s : List ℕ,
        {p : ((Raw × X) × Valuation) | s ∉ p.1.1.tree} ∪
          {p | SatisfiesAt b p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2 s}) ∩
        {p | p.2 [] = truth} by
    ext p
    simp only [evaluationWitnesses, IsEvaluationWitness, Set.mem_inter_iff,
      Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hall, hroot⟩
      exact ⟨fun s => by
        by_cases hs : s ∈ p.1.1.tree
        · exact Or.inr (hall s hs)
        · exact Or.inl hs, hroot⟩
    · rintro ⟨hall, hroot⟩
      refine ⟨?_, hroot⟩
      intro s hs
      rcases hall s with hnot | hsat
      · exact (hnot hs).elim
      · exact hsat]
  exact (MeasurableSet.iInter fun s =>
    (measurableSet_codeNotMemTreeOnWitness (X := X) s).union
      (measurableSet_satisfiesAt b hb s)).inter
    (measurableSet_valuationCoordinate (X := X) [] truth)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.measurableSet_locallyInvalidPairs
statement:
theorem measurableSet_locallyInvalidPairs :
    MeasurableSet (locallyInvalidPairs : Set (Raw × X))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (locallyInvalidPairs : Set (Raw × X)) =
      (Prod.fst ⁻¹' {c : Raw | IsLocallyValid c})ᶜ by
    ext p
    simp [locallyInvalidPairs]]
  exact (measurableSet_isLocallyValid.preimage measurable_fst).compl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.analyticSet_hasEvaluationWitness
statement:
theorem analyticSet_hasEvaluationWitness (b : ℕ → Set X)
    (hb : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (b n)) (truth : Bool) :
    MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (hasEvaluationWitness b truth)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show hasEvaluationWitness b truth = Prod.fst '' evaluationWitnesses b truth by rfl]
  exact (measurableSet_evaluationWitnesses b hb truth).analyticSet_image measurable_fst

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.analyticSet_union
statement:
private theorem analyticSet_union {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {s t : Set Y} (hs : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet s)
    (ht : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet t) : MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (s ∪ t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show s ∪ t = ⋃ value : Bool, if value then s else t by
    ext y
    simp [or_comm]]
  exact MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet.iUnion fun value => by
    cases value <;> simp_all

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.analyticSet_locallyInvalidPairs
statement:
theorem analyticSet_locallyInvalidPairs :
    MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (locallyInvalidPairs : Set (Raw × X))
proof:
:= by
  have h := measurableSet_locallyInvalidPairs.analyticSet_image
    (f := (id : Raw × X → Raw × X)) measurable_id
  convert h using 1
  ext p
  simp

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.analyticSet_illFoundedPairs
statement:
theorem analyticSet_illFoundedPairs :
    MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (illFoundedPairs : Set (Raw × X))
proof:
:= by
  have hcontinuous : Continuous (fun p : Raw × X => p.1.treeCode) :=
    continuous_treeCode.comp continuous_fst
  simpa [illFoundedPairs, Tree.illFoundedTrees, Raw.tree] using
    Tree.analyticSet_illFoundedTrees.preimage hcontinuous

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.analyticSet_analyticEvaluation
statement:
theorem analyticSet_analyticEvaluation (b : ℕ → Set X)
    (hb : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (b n)) :
    MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet (analyticEvaluation b)
proof:
:=
  analyticSet_union
    (analyticSet_union analyticSet_locallyInvalidPairs analyticSet_illFoundedPairs)
    (analyticSet_hasEvaluationWitness b hb true)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.isCoanalytic_coanalyticEvaluation
statement:
theorem isCoanalytic_coanalyticEvaluation (b : ℕ → Set X)
    (hb : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (b n)) :
    IsCoanalytic (coanalyticEvaluation b)
proof:
:= by
  change MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet
    ((locallyInvalidPairs ∪ illFoundedPairs ∪ hasEvaluationWitness b false)ᶜ)ᶜ
  rw [compl_compl]
  exact analyticSet_union
    (analyticSet_union analyticSet_locallyInvalidPairs analyticSet_illFoundedPairs)
    (analyticSet_hasEvaluationWitness b hb false)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.completedTreeCode_apply_eq_true
statement:
@[simp]
theorem completedTreeCode_apply_eq_true {T : Tree.TreeCode} {s : List ℕ} :
    (completedTreeCode T).1 s = true ↔ s = [] ∨ T.1 s.dropLast = true
proof:
:= by
  change (if s = [] then true else T.1 s.dropLast) = true ↔ _
  by_cases hs : s = [] <;> simp [hs]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.mem_completedTreeCode
statement:
theorem mem_completedTreeCode {T : Tree.TreeCode} {s : List ℕ} :
    s ∈ Tree.decodeTree (completedTreeCode T) ↔
      s = [] ∨ s.dropLast ∈ Tree.decodeTree T
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Tree.mem_decodeTree] using
    (completedTreeCode_apply_eq_true (T := T) (s := s))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.body_completedTreeCode
statement:
theorem body_completedTreeCode (T : Tree.TreeCode) :
    Tree.body (Tree.decodeTree (completedTreeCode T)) =
      Tree.body (Tree.decodeTree T)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx n
    have hnext := hx (n + 1)
    rw [mem_completedTreeCode, Tree.initialSegment_succ,
      List.dropLast_concat] at hnext
    exact hnext.resolve_left (by simp [Tree.initialSegment])
  · intro hx n
    cases n with
    | zero =>
        change (if ([] : List ℕ) = [] then true else T.1 [].dropLast) = true
        simp
    | succ n =>
        rw [mem_completedTreeCode, Tree.initialSegment_succ,
          List.dropLast_concat]
        exact Or.inr (hx n)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.isWellFounded_completedTreeCode_iff
statement:
theorem isWellFounded_completedTreeCode_iff (T : Tree.TreeCode) :
    Tree.IsWellFounded (Tree.decodeTree (completedTreeCode T)) ↔
      Tree.IsWellFounded (Tree.decodeTree T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Tree.isWellFounded_iff_body_eq_empty,
    Tree.isWellFounded_iff_body_eq_empty, body_completedTreeCode]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.isLocallyValid_validityReduction
statement:
theorem isLocallyValid_validityReduction (T : Tree.TreeCode) :
    IsLocallyValid (validityReduction T)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [validityReduction, Raw.tree, Raw.treeCode, completedTreeCode]
  · intro s hs
    by_cases hT : T.1 s = true <;>
      simp [Raw.IsCoherentAt, IsCoherentLabel, Raw.labels, validityReduction, hT,
        NodeKind.code, NodeKind.ofCode?]
  · intro s hs
    by_cases hT : T.1 s = true
    · simp only [Raw.HasExpectedChildrenAt, Raw.kindAt?, Raw.kindCodeAt,
        Raw.labels, validityReduction, hT, if_pos, NodeKind.code,
        NodeKind.ofCode?]
      intro n
      change s ++ [n] ∈ Tree.decodeTree (completedTreeCode T)
      rw [mem_completedTreeCode, List.dropLast_concat]
      exact Or.inr hT
    · simp only [Raw.HasExpectedChildrenAt, Raw.kindAt?, Raw.kindCodeAt,
        Raw.labels, validityReduction, hT, NodeKind.code,
        NodeKind.ofCode?]
      intro n hchild
      change s ++ [n] ∈ Tree.decodeTree (completedTreeCode T) at hchild
      rw [mem_completedTreeCode, List.dropLast_concat] at hchild
      exact hT (hchild.resolve_left (by simp))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.isValid_validityReduction_iff
statement:
theorem isValid_validityReduction_iff (T : Tree.TreeCode) :
    IsValid (validityReduction T) ↔
      Tree.IsWellFounded (Tree.decodeTree T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isValid_iff_isLocallyValid_and_isWellFounded]
  simp only [isLocallyValid_validityReduction, true_and]
  exact isWellFounded_completedTreeCode_iff T

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.continuous_completedTreeCode
statement: theorem continuous_completedTreeCode : Continuous completedTreeCode
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  exact continuous_pi fun s => by
    by_cases hs : s = []
    · subst s
      simpa [completedTreeCode] using
        (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : Tree.TreeCode => true))
    · simpa only [completedTreeCode, hs, ↓reduceIte, Function.comp_def] using
        (continuous_listNatBoolCoordinate s.dropLast).comp continuous_subtype_val

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.continuous_validityReduction_labels
statement:
theorem continuous_validityReduction_labels :
    Continuous (fun T : Tree.TreeCode => (validityReduction T).labels)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.continuous_validityReduction
statement: theorem continuous_validityReduction : Continuous validityReduction

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.analyticSet_locallyInvalidCodes
statement:
private theorem analyticSet_locallyInvalidCodes :
    MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet locallyInvalidCodes
proof:
:= by
  have hm : MeasurableSet locallyInvalidCodes := by
    rw [show locallyInvalidCodes = {c : Raw | IsLocallyValid c}ᶜ by
      ext c
      simp [locallyInvalidCodes]]
    exact measurableSet_isLocallyValid.compl
  have h := hm.analyticSet_image (f := (id : Raw → Raw)) measurable_id
  convert h using 1
  ext c
  simp

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.analyticSet_illFoundedCodes
statement:
private theorem analyticSet_illFoundedCodes :
    MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet illFoundedCodes
proof:
:= by
  simpa [illFoundedCodes, Tree.illFoundedTrees, Raw.tree] using
    Tree.analyticSet_illFoundedTrees.preimage continuous_treeCode

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.isCoanalytic_validCodes
statement: theorem isCoanalytic_validCodes : IsCoanalytic validCodes
proof:
:= by
  change MeasureTheory.AnalyticSet validCodesᶜ
  rw [show validCodesᶜ = locallyInvalidCodes ∪ illFoundedCodes by
    ext c
    simp only [validCodes, locallyInvalidCodes, illFoundedCodes,
      Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_union]
    rw [isValid_iff_isLocallyValid_and_isWellFounded]
    constructor
    · intro h
      by_cases hlocal : IsLocallyValid c
      · exact Or.inr (fun hwf => h ⟨hlocal, hwf⟩)
      · exact Or.inl hlocal
    · rintro (hlocal | hwf) hvalid
      · exact hlocal hvalid.1
      · exact hwf hvalid.2]
  exact analyticSet_union analyticSet_locallyInvalidCodes analyticSet_illFoundedCodes

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.continuouslyReduces_wellFoundedTrees_validCodes
statement:
theorem continuouslyReduces_wellFoundedTrees_validCodes :
    ContinuouslyReduces Tree.wellFoundedTrees validCodes
proof:
:=
  continuouslyReduces_of_continuous validityReduction continuous_validityReduction fun T => by
    simpa [Tree.wellFoundedTrees, validCodes] using (isValid_validityReduction_iff T).symm

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.validCodes_complete
statement: theorem validCodes_complete : IsCoanalyticCompleteForBaire validCodes
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isCoanalytic_validCodes, ?_⟩
  intro s hs
  exact (Tree.continuouslyReduces_wellFoundedTrees_of_isCoanalytic hs).trans
    continuouslyReduces_wellFoundedTrees_validCodes

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.isValid_iff_isLocallyValid_and_isWellFounded
statement:
theorem isValid_iff_isLocallyValid_and_isWellFounded {c : Raw} :
    IsValid c ↔ IsLocallyValid c ∧ Tree.IsWellFounded c.tree
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨⟨h.root_mem, h.coherent, h.expectedChildren⟩, h.wellFounded⟩
  · rintro ⟨hlocal, hwf⟩
    exact ⟨hlocal.root_mem, hwf, hlocal.coherent, hlocal.expectedChildren⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.IsValid.isLocallyValid
statement: theorem IsValid.isLocallyValid {c : Raw} (h : IsValid c) : IsLocallyValid c
proof:
:=
  isValid_iff_isLocallyValid_and_isWellFounded.mp h |>.1

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.canonicalValuation_eq_true_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem canonicalValuation_eq_true_iff (b : ℕ → Set X) {c : Raw} (h : IsValid c)
    (x : X) {s : List ℕ} (hs : s ∈ c.tree) :
    canonicalValuation b c h x s = true ↔ x ∈ evalAt b c h ⟨s, hs⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [canonicalValuation, hs]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.canonicalValuation_eq_false_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem canonicalValuation_eq_false_iff (b : ℕ → Set X) {c : Raw} (h : IsValid c)
    (x : X) {s : List ℕ} (hs : s ∈ c.tree) :
    canonicalValuation b c h x s = false ↔ x ∉ evalAt b c h ⟨s, hs⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [canonicalValuation, hs]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.isEvaluationWitness_canonicalValuation
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨kind, hkind⟩ := h.exists_kindAt s hs
  cases kind with
  | empty =>
      simp [SatisfiesAt, hkind, canonicalValuation, hs,
        evalAt_eq_empty b h ⟨s, hs⟩ hkind]
  | basic =>
      simp [SatisfiesAt, hkind, canonicalValuation, hs,
        evalAt_eq_basic b h ⟨s, hs⟩ hkind]
  | compl =>
      have hchild := h.child_zero_mem_of_kindAt?_eq_compl hs hkind
      have hchildEq :
          (⟨s ++ [0], hchild⟩ : c.tree) = complChild h ⟨s, hs⟩ hkind :=
        Subtype.ext rfl
      simp [SatisfiesAt, hkind, canonicalValuation, hs, hchild,
        evalAt_eq_compl b h ⟨s, hs⟩ hkind, hchildEq]
  | iUnion =>
      have hchildren : ∀ n, s ++ [n] ∈ c.tree :=
        h.child_mem_of_kindAt?_eq_iUnion hs hkind
      simp only [SatisfiesAt, hkind]
      rw [canonicalValuation_eq_true_iff b h x hs,
        evalAt_eq_iUnion b h ⟨s, hs⟩ hkind]
      simp only [mem_iUnion]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
        exact ⟨n, (canonicalValuation_eq_true_iff b h x (hchildren n)).2 hn⟩
      · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
        exact ⟨n, (canonicalValuation_eq_true_iff b h x (hchildren n)).1 hn⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.IsEvaluationWitness.value_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem IsEvaluationWitness.value_eq_true_iff (b : ℕ → Set X) {c : Raw}
    (h : IsValid c) {x : X} {v : Valuation} (hv : IsEvaluationWitness b c x v)
    (s : c.tree) :
    v s.1 = true ↔ x ∈ evalAt b c h s
proof:
:= by
  let motive : c.tree → Prop := fun t =>
    v t.1 = true ↔ x ∈ evalAt b c h t
  change motive s
  apply h.wellFounded.induction s
  intro s ih
  change v s.1 = true ↔ x ∈ evalAt b c h s
  have hsatisfies := hv s.1 s.2
  obtain ⟨kind, hkind⟩ := h.exists_kindAt s.1 s.2
  cases kind with
  | empty =>
      have hsatisfies' : v s.1 = false := by
        simpa [SatisfiesAt, hkind] using hsatisfies
      simp [hsatisfies', evalAt_eq_empty b h s hkind]
  | basic =>
      have hsatisfies' : v s.1 = true ↔ x ∈ b (c.payloadAt s.1) := by
        simpa [SatisfiesAt, hkind] using hsatisfies
      simpa [evalAt_eq_basic b h s hkind] using hsatisfies'
  | compl =>
      have hchild := child_complChild h s hkind
      have hchildValue :
          v (complChild h s hkind).1 = true ↔
            x ∈ evalAt b c h (complChild h s hkind) := by
        simpa [motive] using ih (complChild h s hkind) hchild
      have hsatisfies' : v s.1 = true ↔ v (s.1 ++ [0]) = false := by
        simpa [SatisfiesAt, hkind] using hsatisfies
      rw [evalAt_eq_compl b h s hkind, mem_compl_iff]
      calc
        v s.1 = true ↔ v (s.1 ++ [0]) = false := hsatisfies'
        _ ↔ ¬v (s.1 ++ [0]) = true := by simp
        _ ↔ x ∉ evalAt b c h (complChild h s hkind) := by
          simpa [complChild] using not_congr hchildValue
  | iUnion =>
      have hsatisfies' : v s.1 = true ↔ ∃ n, v (s.1 ++ [n]) = true := by
        simpa [SatisfiesAt, hkind] using hsatisfies
      rw [evalAt_eq_iUnion b h s hkind, mem_iUnion]
      constructor
      · intro hs
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hsatisfies'.mp hs
        refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
        have hchildValue :
            v (iUnionChild h s hkind n).1 = true ↔
              x ∈ evalAt b c h (iUnionChild h s hkind n) := by
          simpa [motive] using
            ih (iUnionChild h s hkind n) (child_iUnionChild h s hkind n)
        exact hchildValue.mp (by simpa [iUnionChild] using hn)
      · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
        apply hsatisfies'.mpr
        have hchildValue :
            v (iUnionChild h s hkind n).1 = true ↔
              x ∈ evalAt b c h (iUnionChild h s hkind n) := by
          simpa [motive] using
            ih (iUnionChild h s hkind n) (child_iUnionChild h s hkind n)
        exact ⟨n, by simpa [iUnionChild] using hchildValue.mpr hn⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.IsEvaluationWitness.root_eq_true_iff
proof:
:= by
  simpa [eval, evalAt, decode, root] using
    hv.value_eq_true_iff b h (root h)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.IsEvaluationWitness.root_eq_false_iff
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Bool.not_eq_true]
  exact not_congr (hv.root_eq_true_iff b h)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.valid_not_mem_invalidPairs
statement:
theorem valid_not_mem_invalidPairs {c : Raw} (h : IsValid c) (x : X) :
    (c, x) ∉ locallyInvalidPairs ∪ illFoundedPairs
proof:
:= by
  rintro (hlocal | hill)
  · exact hlocal h.isLocallyValid
  · exact hill h.wellFounded

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.mem_analyticEvaluation_iff_of_isValid
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ((hlocal | hill) | ⟨⟨p, v⟩, ⟨hv, hroot⟩, hp⟩)
    · exact (hlocal h.isLocallyValid).elim
    · exact (hill h.wellFounded).elim
    · change p = (c, x) at hp
      subst p
      exact (hv.root_eq_true_iff b h).mp hroot
  · intro hx
    refine Or.inr ⟨((c, x), canonicalValuation b c h x), ?_, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨isEvaluationWitness_canonicalValuation b h x, ?_⟩
    exact (canonicalValuation_eq_true_iff b h x h.root_mem).2 (by
      simpa [eval, evalAt, decode, root] using hx)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.mem_coanalyticEvaluation_iff_of_isValid
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    change ¬((c, x) ∈ locallyInvalidPairs ∪ illFoundedPairs ∪
      hasEvaluationWitness b false) at hp
    by_contra hx
    apply hp
    refine Or.inr ⟨((c, x), canonicalValuation b c h x), ?_, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨isEvaluationWitness_canonicalValuation b h x, ?_⟩
    exact (canonicalValuation_eq_false_iff b h x h.root_mem).2 (by
      simpa [eval, evalAt, decode, root] using hx)
  · intro hx hp
    rcases hp with (hlocal | hill) | ⟨⟨p, v⟩, ⟨hv, hroot⟩, hp⟩
    · exact hlocal h.isLocallyValid
    · exact hill h.wellFounded
    · change p = (c, x) at hp
      subst p
      exact (hv.root_eq_false_iff b h).mp hroot hx

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.evaluation_agrees_of_isValid
statement:
theorem evaluation_agrees_of_isValid (b : ℕ → Set X) {c : Raw}
    (h : IsValid c) (x : X) :
    ((c, x) ∈ analyticEvaluation b ↔ x ∈ eval b c h) ∧
      ((c, x) ∈ coanalyticEvaluation b ↔ x ∈ eval b c h) ∧
      ((c, x) ∈ analyticEvaluation b ↔ (c, x) ∈ coanalyticEvaluation b)
proof:
:=
  ⟨mem_analyticEvaluation_iff_of_isValid b h x,
    mem_coanalyticEvaluation_iff_of_isValid b h x,
    (mem_analyticEvaluation_iff_of_isValid b h x).trans
      (mem_coanalyticEvaluation_iff_of_isValid b h x).symm⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.evaluation_disagrees_of_not_isValid
proof:
:= by
  have hinvalid : ¬IsLocallyValid c ∨ ¬Tree.IsWellFounded c.tree := by
    by_contra hboth
    push Not at hboth
    exact h (isValid_iff_isLocallyValid_and_isWellFounded.mpr hboth)
  rcases hinvalid with hlocal | hill
  · exact ⟨Or.inl (Or.inl hlocal), fun hco => hco (Or.inl (Or.inl hlocal))⟩
  · exact ⟨Or.inl (Or.inr hill), fun hco => hco (Or.inl (Or.inr hill))⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.evaluation_agrees_iff_isValid
statement:
theorem evaluation_agrees_iff_isValid (b : ℕ → Set X) (c : Raw) (x : X) :
    ((c, x) ∈ analyticEvaluation b ↔ (c, x) ∈ coanalyticEvaluation b) ↔
      IsValid c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hagree
    by_contra hinvalid
    obtain ⟨ha, hc⟩ := evaluation_disagrees_of_not_isValid b hinvalid x
    exact hc (hagree.mp ha)
  · intro h
    exact (evaluation_agrees_of_isValid b h x).2.2

proof:
:= by

  split <;> simp_all

statement:
theorem decodeAt_eq_basic (b : ℕ → Set X) {c : Raw} (h : IsValid c) (s : c.tree)
    (hkind : c.kindAt? s.1 = some .basic) :
    decodeAt b c h s = .basic (c.payloadAt s.1)
proof:
:= by

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.decodeAt_eq_compl
statement:
theorem decodeAt_eq_compl (b : ℕ → Set X) {c : Raw} (h : IsValid c) (s : c.tree)
    (hkind : c.kindAt? s.1 = some .compl) :
    decodeAt b c h s = .compl (decodeAt b c h (complChild h s hkind))
proof:
:= by
  rw [decodeAt, WellFounded.fix_eq]
  split <;> simp_all
  have hother : c.kindAt? s.1 = some .iUnion := by assumption
  have hcontra : NodeKind.compl = NodeKind.iUnion :=
    Option.some.inj (hkind.symm.trans hother)
  cases hcontra

    decodeAt b c h s = .iUnion (fun n => decodeAt b c h (iUnionChild h s hkind n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [decodeAt, WellFounded.fix_eq]
  split <;> simp_all
  have hother : c.kindAt? s.1 = some .compl := by assumption
  have hcontra : NodeKind.iUnion = NodeKind.compl :=
    Option.some.inj (hkind.symm.trans hother)
  cases hcontra

proof:

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.evalAt_eq_basic
statement:
theorem evalAt_eq_basic (b : ℕ → Set X) {c : Raw} (h : IsValid c) (s : c.tree)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.evalAt_eq_compl
statement:
theorem evalAt_eq_compl (b : ℕ → Set X) {c : Raw} (h : IsValid c) (s : c.tree)

    evalAt b c h s = (evalAt b c h (complChild h s hkind))ᶜ
proof:

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.eval_proof_irrel

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.subcodeAt_append
statement:
private theorem subcodeAt_append (d : GeneratedCode b) (s t : List ℕ) :
    subcodeAt d (s ++ t) = (subcodeAt d s).bind fun e => subcodeAt e t
proof:
:= by
  induction s generalizing d with
  | nil => simp [subcodeAt]
  | cons n s ih =>
      cases d with
      | basic i => simp [subcodeAt]
      | empty => simp [subcodeAt]
      | compl d =>
          by_cases hn : n = 0
          · subst n
            simp [subcodeAt, ih]
          · simp [subcodeAt, hn]
      | iUnion d => simp [subcodeAt, ih]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.subcodeAt_isSome_of_mem
statement:
private theorem subcodeAt_isSome_of_mem (d : GeneratedCode b) {s : List ℕ}
    (hs : s ∈ (encode d).tree) : (subcodeAt d s).isSome = true
proof:
:= by
  exact hs

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.encodedNodeRank_lt_of_child
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hnode⟩ := hst
  have hsSome := subcodeAt_isSome_of_mem d s.2
  have htSome := subcodeAt_isSome_of_mem d t.2
  cases hparent : subcodeAt d t.1 with
  | none => simp [hparent] at htSome
  | some parent =>
      have hchild : subcodeAt d s.1 = subcodeAt parent [n] := by
        rw [hnode, subcodeAt_append, hparent]
        rfl
      cases parent with
      | basic i =>
          have hnone : subcodeAt d s.1 = none := by
            simpa only [subcodeAt] using hchild
          rw [hnone] at hsSome
          contradiction
      | empty =>
          have hnone : subcodeAt d s.1 = none := by
            simpa only [subcodeAt] using hchild
          rw [hnone] at hsSome
          contradiction
      | compl e =>
          by_cases hn : n = 0
          · subst n
            have hchild' : subcodeAt d s.1 = some e := by
              simpa [subcodeAt] using hchild
            unfold encodedNodeRank
            rw [hchild', hparent]
            exact Order.lt_succ _
          · have hchild' : subcodeAt d s.1 = none := by
              simpa [subcodeAt, hn] using hchild
            rw [hchild'] at hsSome
            contradiction
      | iUnion e =>
          have hchild' : subcodeAt d s.1 = some (e n) := by
            simpa [subcodeAt] using hchild
          unfold encodedNodeRank
          rw [hchild', hparent]
          exact GeneratedCode.constructionRank_lt_iUnion e n

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.encodedTree_wellFounded
statement:
private theorem encodedTree_wellFounded (d : GeneratedCode b) :
    Tree.IsWellFounded (encode d).tree
proof:
:=
  (@WellFounded.onFun _ _ _ (encodedNodeRank d) Ordinal.lt_wf).mono fun _ _ hst =>
    encodedNodeRank_lt_of_child d hst

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.isValid_encode
statement: theorem isValid_encode (d : GeneratedCode b) : IsValid (encode d)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, encodedTree_wellFounded d, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (subcodeAt d []).isSome = true
    simp [subcodeAt]
  · intro s hs
    have hsSome := subcodeAt_isSome_of_mem d hs
    cases hsub : subcodeAt d s with
    | none => simp [hsub] at hsSome
    | some e =>
        cases e <;>
          simp [Raw.IsCoherentAt, IsCoherentLabel, Raw.labels, encode, labelOf, hsub,
            NodeKind.code, NodeKind.ofCode?]
  · intro s hs
    have hsSome := subcodeAt_isSome_of_mem d hs
    cases hsub : subcodeAt d s with
    | none => simp [hsub] at hsSome
    | some e =>
        cases e with
        | basic i =>
            have hkind : (encode d).kindAt? s = some .basic := by
              simp [Raw.kindAt?, Raw.kindCodeAt, Raw.labels, encode, labelOf, hsub,
                NodeKind.code, NodeKind.ofCode?]
            simp only [Raw.HasExpectedChildrenAt, hkind]
            intro n hmem
            have hsome := subcodeAt_isSome_of_mem d hmem
            rw [subcodeAt_append, hsub] at hsome
            simp [subcodeAt] at hsome
        | empty =>
            have hkind : (encode d).kindAt? s = some .empty := by
              simp [Raw.kindAt?, Raw.kindCodeAt, Raw.labels, encode, labelOf, hsub,
                NodeKind.code, NodeKind.ofCode?]
            simp only [Raw.HasExpectedChildrenAt, hkind]
            intro n hmem
            have hsome := subcodeAt_isSome_of_mem d hmem
            rw [subcodeAt_append, hsub] at hsome
            simp [subcodeAt] at hsome
        | compl e =>
            have hkind : (encode d).kindAt? s = some .compl := by
              simp [Raw.kindAt?, Raw.kindCodeAt, Raw.labels, encode, labelOf, hsub,
                NodeKind.code, NodeKind.ofCode?]
            simp only [Raw.HasExpectedChildrenAt, hkind]
            constructor
            · change (subcodeAt d (s ++ [0])).isSome = true
              rw [subcodeAt_append, hsub]
              simp [subcodeAt]
            · intro n hn hmem
              have hsome := subcodeAt_isSome_of_mem d hmem
              rw [subcodeAt_append, hsub] at hsome
              simp [subcodeAt, hn] at hsome
        | iUnion e =>
            have hkind : (encode d).kindAt? s = some .iUnion := by
              simp [Raw.kindAt?, Raw.kindCodeAt, Raw.labels, encode, labelOf, hsub,
                NodeKind.code, NodeKind.ofCode?]
            simp only [Raw.HasExpectedChildrenAt, hkind]
            intro n
            change (subcodeAt d (s ++ [n])).isSome = true
            rw [subcodeAt_append, hsub]
            simp [subcodeAt]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.kindAt?_encode_of_subcodeAt_eq
proof:
:= by
  simp [Raw.kindAt?, Raw.kindCodeAt, Raw.labels, encode, hsub]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.decodeAt_encode_of_subcodeAt_eq
proof:
:= by
  induction e generalizing s with
  | basic i =>
      have hkind : (encode d).kindAt? s.1 = some .basic := by
        simpa [labelOf, NodeKind.code, NodeKind.ofCode?] using
          kindAt?_encode_of_subcodeAt_eq d (.basic i) hsub
      rw [decodeAt_eq_basic b (isValid_encode d) s hkind]
      simp [Raw.payloadAt, Raw.labels, encode, hsub, labelOf]
  | empty =>
      have hkind : (encode d).kindAt? s.1 = some .empty := by
        simpa [labelOf, NodeKind.code, NodeKind.ofCode?] using
          kindAt?_encode_of_subcodeAt_eq d (.empty : GeneratedCode b) hsub
      exact decodeAt_eq_empty b (isValid_encode d) s hkind
  | compl e ih =>
      have hkind : (encode d).kindAt? s.1 = some .compl := by
        simpa [labelOf, NodeKind.code, NodeKind.ofCode?] using
          kindAt?_encode_of_subcodeAt_eq d (.compl e) hsub
      rw [decodeAt_eq_compl b (isValid_encode d) s hkind]
      apply congrArg GeneratedCode.compl
      apply ih
      change subcodeAt d (s.1 ++ [0]) = some e
      rw [subcodeAt_append, hsub]
      simp [subcodeAt]
  | iUnion e ih =>
      have hkind : (encode d).kindAt? s.1 = some .iUnion := by
        simpa [labelOf, NodeKind.code, NodeKind.ofCode?] using
          kindAt?_encode_of_subcodeAt_eq d (.iUnion e) hsub
      rw [decodeAt_eq_iUnion b (isValid_encode d) s hkind]
      apply congrArg GeneratedCode.iUnion
      funext n
      apply ih n
      change subcodeAt d (s.1 ++ [n]) = some (e n)
      rw [subcodeAt_append, hsub]
      simp [subcodeAt]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.decode_encode
statement:
@[simp]
theorem decode_encode (d : GeneratedCode b) :
    decode b (encode d) (isValid_encode d) = d
proof:
:= by
  apply decodeAt_encode_of_subcodeAt_eq d d (root (isValid_encode d))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.BorelTreeCode.exists_valid_encode_eq_borelCode_eval

    (hb : TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis (range b)) (c : BorelCode X) :

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.surjective_differenceLevelSequence
statement:
theorem surjective_differenceLevelSequence (i : Ordinal.{0})
    (hi : 0 < i) (hic : IsCountableBorelLevel i) :
    Function.Surjective (differenceLevelSequence i hi hic)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Countable (Set.Iio i) := countable_Iio_of_isCountableBorelLevel hic
  rw [← Set.range_eq_univ]
  simpa [differenceLevelSequence] using
    (Set.range_enumerateCountable_of_mem (Set.countable_univ :
      (Set.univ : Set (Set.Iio i)).Countable)
      (Set.mem_univ (⟨0, hi⟩ : Set.Iio i)))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isOpen_baireDifferenceOpenComponent
statement:
theorem isOpen_baireDifferenceOpenComponent {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {b : ℕ → Set X} (hb : ∀ n, IsOpen (b n)) (n : ℕ) :
    IsOpen (baireDifferenceOpenComponent b n)
proof:

    (((continuous_baireUnpack n).comp continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_snd)

:= by

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.hausdorffDifference_baireUniversalDifference
statement:
theorem hausdorffDifference_baireUniversalDifference {X : Type u}
    [TopologicalSpace X] {b : ℕ → Set X} (hb : ∀ n, IsOpen (b n))
    {i : Ordinal.{0}} (hi : 0 < i) (hic : IsCountableBorelLevel i) :
    HausdorffDifference i (baireUniversalDifference b i hi hic)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨hi, hic, baireUniversalDifferenceFamily b i hi hic,
    monotone_baireUniversalDifferenceFamily b i hi hic,
    isOpen_baireUniversalDifferenceFamily hb i hi hic, rfl⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_verticalSection_baireUniversalDifferenceFamily
proof:
:= by
  simp [verticalSection, baireDifferenceOpenComponent,
    baireUniversalDifferenceFamily]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.verticalSection_baireUniversalDifference
proof:
:= by
  have hpre := preimage_difference (fun x : X => (p, x)) i
    (baireUniversalDifferenceFamily b i hi hic)
  ext x
  change x ∈ (fun y : X => (p, y)) ⁻¹'
      difference i (baireUniversalDifferenceFamily b i hi hic) ↔
    x ∈ difference i (fun j => (fun y : X => (p, y)) ⁻¹'
      baireUniversalDifferenceFamily b i hi hic j)
  exact Set.ext_iff.mp hpre x

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isUniversalFor_baireUniversalDifference
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  constructor
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨_, _, A, hA, hAOpen, hAs⟩ := hs
    have hUniversal := isUniversalFor_baireParameterUniversalOpen hb
    choose c hc using fun j => (hUniversal (A j)).1 (hAOpen j)
    let p : ℕ → ℕ := bairePack (fun n => c (differenceLevelSequence i hi hic n))
    have hStage (j : Set.Iio i) :
        verticalSection (baireUniversalDifferenceFamily b i hi hic j) p = A j := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        obtain ⟨n, hnj, hxn⟩ :=
          mem_verticalSection_baireUniversalDifferenceFamily.1 hx
        have hxc : x ∈ verticalSection (baireParameterUniversalOpen b)
            (c (differenceLevelSequence i hi hic n)) := by
          simpa [p] using hxn
        rw [hc] at hxc
        exact hA hnj hxc
      · intro hx
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := surjective_differenceLevelSequence i hi hic j
        apply mem_verticalSection_baireUniversalDifferenceFamily.2
        refine ⟨n, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hn]
        · have hxc : x ∈ verticalSection (baireParameterUniversalOpen b) (c j) := by
            rw [hc]
            exact hx
          simpa [p, hn] using hxc
    refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
    rw [verticalSection_baireUniversalDifference]
    simpa only [hStage] using hAs
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    let f : X → (ℕ → ℕ) × X := fun x => (p, x)
    have hf : Continuous f := continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id
    have hpre := (hausdorffDifference_baireUniversalDifference
      (fun n => hb.isOpen (Set.mem_range_self n)) hi hic).preimage hf
    change HausdorffDifference i (f ⁻¹' baireUniversalDifference b i hi hic)
    exact hpre

statement:

  change x ∈ (fun y : X => (p, y)) ⁻¹'
      difference i (cantorUniversalDifferenceFamily b i hi hic) ↔

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isUniversalFor_cantorUniversalDifference
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  constructor
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨_, _, A, hA, hAOpen, hAs⟩ := hs
    have hUniversal := (isUniversalOpen_universalOpen hb).2
    choose c hc using fun j => (hUniversal (A j)).1 (hAOpen j)
    let p : ℕ → Bool := cantorPack (fun n => c (differenceLevelSequence i hi hic n))
    have hStage (j : Set.Iio i) :
        verticalSection (cantorUniversalDifferenceFamily b i hi hic j) p = A j := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        obtain ⟨n, hnj, hxn⟩ :=
          mem_verticalSection_cantorUniversalDifferenceFamily.1 hx
        have hxc : x ∈ verticalSection (universalOpen b)
            (c (differenceLevelSequence i hi hic n)) := by
          simpa [p] using hxn
        rw [hc] at hxc
        exact hA hnj hxc
      · intro hx
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := surjective_differenceLevelSequence i hi hic j
        apply mem_verticalSection_cantorUniversalDifferenceFamily.2
        refine ⟨n, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hn]
        · have hxc : x ∈ verticalSection (universalOpen b) (c j) := by
            rw [hc]
            exact hx
          simpa [p, hn] using hxc
    refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
    rw [verticalSection_cantorUniversalDifference]
    simpa only [hStage] using hAs
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    let f : X → (ℕ → Bool) × X := fun x => (p, x)
    have hf : Continuous f := continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id
    have hpre := (hausdorffDifference_cantorUniversalDifference
      (fun n => hb.isOpen (Set.mem_range_self n)) hi hic).preimage hf
    change HausdorffDifference i (f ⁻¹' cantorUniversalDifference b i hi hic)
    exact hpre

theorem IsUniversalFor.not_hausdorffDifference_baireDiagonalComplement

      (baireHausdorffDifferenceStrictWitness i hi hic)

    (fun n => isTopologicalBasis_range_baireCylinderBasisSequence.isOpen
