name: DescriptiveSetTheory.disjoint_differenceLayer
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxj hxk
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (fun h => hjk (Subtype.ext h)) with hjk' | hkj'
  · have hnot := (mem_differenceLayer.1 hxk).2 ⟨j.1, hjk'⟩
    exact hnot (by simpa using (mem_differenceLayer.1 hxj).1)
  · have hnot := (mem_differenceLayer.1 hxj).2 ⟨k.1, hkj'⟩
    exact hnot (by simpa using (mem_differenceLayer.1 hxk).1)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.iUnion_differenceLayer
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hxj⟩
    exact ⟨j, (mem_differenceLayer.1 hxj).1⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hxj⟩
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmin⟩ :=
      wellFounded_lt.has_min {k : Set.Iio i | x ∈ A k} ⟨j, hxj⟩
    refine ⟨m, mem_differenceLayer.2 ⟨hm, ?_⟩⟩
    intro k hxk
    let k' : Set.Iio i :=
      ⟨k.1, (show k.1 < m.1 from k.2).trans (show m.1 < i from m.2)⟩
    exact hmin k' hxk k.2

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.difference_eq_iUnion
statement:
theorem difference_eq_iUnion {X : Type u} (i : Ordinal.{0})
    (A : Set.Iio i → Set X) :
    difference i A =
      ⋃ j, if ordinalParity j.1 ≠ ordinalParity i then differenceLayer A j else ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change (∃ j : Set.Iio i,
      ordinalParity j.1 ≠ ordinalParity i ∧ x ∈ differenceLayer A j) ↔ _
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hjParity, hxj⟩
    exact ⟨j, by simpa [hjParity] using hxj⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hxj⟩
    by_cases hjParity : ordinalParity j.1 ≠ ordinalParity i
    · exact ⟨j, hjParity, by simpa [hjParity] using hxj⟩
    · simp [hjParity] at hxj

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.codifference_eq_iUnion
statement:
theorem codifference_eq_iUnion {X : Type u} (i : Ordinal.{0})
    (A : Set.Iio i → Set X) :
    codifference i A =
      ⋃ j, if ordinalParity j.1 = ordinalParity i then differenceLayer A j else ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [codifference]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.compl_difference
statement:
theorem compl_difference {X : Type u} (i : Ordinal.{0})
    (A : Set.Iio i → Set X) :
    (difference i A)ᶜ = (⋃ j, A j)ᶜ ∪ codifference i A
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    by_cases hxu : x ∈ ⋃ j, A j
    · right
      rw [← iUnion_differenceLayer A] at hxu
      obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hxu
      refine ⟨j, ?_, hxj⟩
      by_contra hjParity
      exact hx ⟨j, hjParity, hxj⟩
    · exact Or.inl hxu
  · rintro (hxu | ⟨j, hjParity, hxj⟩) hx
    · obtain ⟨k, _, hxk⟩ := hx
      exact hxu (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨k, (mem_differenceLayer.1 hxk).1⟩)
    · obtain ⟨k, hkParity, hxk⟩ := hx
      have hjk : j ≠ k := by
        intro hjk
        subst k
        exact hkParity hjParity
      exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_differenceLayer hjk) hxj hxk

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.preimage_differenceLayer
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [mem_differenceLayer]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.preimage_difference
statement:
theorem preimage_difference {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} (f : X → Y)
    (i : Ordinal.{0}) (A : Set.Iio i → Set Y) :
    f ⁻¹' difference i A = difference i (fun j => f ⁻¹' A j)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [mem_difference]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.HausdorffDifference.preimage
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hi, hic, A, hA, hAOpen, rfl⟩ := hs
  refine ⟨hi, hic, fun j => f ⁻¹' A j, fun _ _ hjk => preimage_mono (hA hjk),
    fun j => (hAOpen j).preimage hf, ?_⟩
  exact (preimage_difference f i A).symm

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_shiftDifferenceFamily
statement:
theorem mem_shiftDifferenceFamily {X : Type u} {i : Ordinal.{0}}
    {A : Set.Iio i → Set X} {j : Set.Iio (i + 1)} {x : X} :
    x ∈ shiftDifferenceFamily A j ↔
      ∃ k : Set.Iio i, k.1 + 1 ≤ j.1 ∧ x ∈ A k
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftDifferenceFamily]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.monotone_shiftDifferenceFamily
statement:
theorem monotone_shiftDifferenceFamily {X : Type u} {i : Ordinal.{0}}
    (A : Set.Iio i → Set X) : Monotone (shiftDifferenceFamily A)
proof:
:= by
  intro j k hjk x hx
  obtain ⟨m, hmj, hxm⟩ := mem_shiftDifferenceFamily.1 hx
  exact mem_shiftDifferenceFamily.2 ⟨m, hmj.trans hjk, hxm⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isOpen_shiftDifferenceFamily
statement:
theorem isOpen_shiftDifferenceFamily {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {i : Ordinal.{0}} {A : Set.Iio i → Set X} (hAOpen : ∀ j, IsOpen (A j))
    (j : Set.Iio (i + 1)) : IsOpen (shiftDifferenceFamily A j)
proof:
:= by
  apply isOpen_iUnion
  intro k
  split_ifs
  · exact hAOpen k
  · exact isOpen_empty

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.difference_shiftDifferenceFamily
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rw [mem_difference]
    rintro ⟨j, hjParity, hxj, hjLeast⟩
    obtain ⟨a, haj, hxa⟩ := mem_shiftDifferenceFamily.1 hxj
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmin⟩ :=
      wellFounded_lt.has_min {k : Set.Iio i | x ∈ A k} ⟨a, hxa⟩
    have hma : m.1 ≤ a.1 := le_of_not_gt (hmin a hxa)
    have hmaSucc : m.1 + 1 ≤ a.1 + 1 := by
      change Order.succ m.1 ≤ Order.succ a.1
      exact Order.succ_le_succ hma
    have hmj : m.1 + 1 ≤ j.1 := hmaSucc.trans haj
    have hjm : j.1 ≤ m.1 + 1 := by
      apply le_of_not_gt
      intro hmjlt
      have hmSuccLeI : m.1 + 1 ≤ i := Order.add_one_le_iff.2 m.2
      let m' : Set.Iio (i + 1) :=
        ⟨m.1 + 1, hmSuccLeI.trans_lt (Order.lt_succ i)⟩
      have hm'j : m' < j := hmjlt
      have hxShift : x ∈ shiftDifferenceFamily A m' :=
        mem_shiftDifferenceFamily.2 ⟨m, le_rfl, hm⟩
      exact (hjLeast ⟨m'.1, hm'j⟩) hxShift
    have hjEq : j.1 = m.1 + 1 := le_antisymm hjm hmj
    rw [mem_difference]
    refine ⟨m, ?_, hm, ?_⟩
    · have hjParity' : ordinalParity (m.1 + 1) ≠ ordinalParity (i + 1) := by
        simpa [hjEq] using hjParity
      simpa using hjParity'
    · intro k hxk
      let k' : Set.Iio i :=
        ⟨k.1, (show k.1 < m.1 from k.2).trans (show m.1 < i from m.2)⟩
      exact hmin k' hxk k.2
  · rw [mem_difference]
    rintro ⟨m, hmParity, hm, hmLeast⟩
    have hmSuccLeI : m.1 + 1 ≤ i := Order.add_one_le_iff.2 m.2
    let m' : Set.Iio (i + 1) :=
      ⟨m.1 + 1, hmSuccLeI.trans_lt (Order.lt_succ i)⟩
    rw [mem_difference]
    refine ⟨m', ?_, mem_shiftDifferenceFamily.2 ⟨m, le_rfl, hm⟩, ?_⟩
    · simpa [m'] using hmParity
    · intro j hxj
      obtain ⟨k, hkj, hxk⟩ := mem_shiftDifferenceFamily.1 hxj
      have hkSuccLt : k.1 + 1 < m.1 + 1 := hkj.trans_lt j.2
      have hkm : k.1 < m.1 := by
        change Order.succ k.1 < Order.succ m.1 at hkSuccLt
        exact Order.succ_lt_succ_iff.1 hkSuccLt
      exact hmLeast ⟨k.1, hkm⟩ (by simpa using hxk)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.HausdorffDifference.mono_add_one
statement:
theorem HausdorffDifference.mono_add_one {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {i : Ordinal.{0}} {s : Set X} (hs : HausdorffDifference i s) :
    HausdorffDifference (i + 1) s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hi, hic, A, _, hAOpen, hAs⟩ := hs
  refine ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt bot_le (Order.lt_succ i),
    Cardinal.isSuccLimit_omega 1 |>.add_one_lt hic,
    shiftDifferenceFamily A, monotone_shiftDifferenceFamily A,
    isOpen_shiftDifferenceFamily hAOpen, ?_⟩
  rw [difference_shiftDifferenceFamily, hAs]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_extendDifferenceFamily
proof:
:= by
  simp [extendDifferenceFamily]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.monotone_extendDifferenceFamily
statement:
theorem monotone_extendDifferenceFamily {X : Type u} {i k : Ordinal.{0}}
    (A : Set.Iio i → Set X) : Monotone (extendDifferenceFamily k A)
proof:
:= by
  intro j l hjl x hx
  obtain ⟨a, haj, hxa⟩ := mem_extendDifferenceFamily.1 hx
  exact mem_extendDifferenceFamily.2 ⟨a, haj.trans hjl, hxa⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isOpen_extendDifferenceFamily
statement:
theorem isOpen_extendDifferenceFamily {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {i k : Ordinal.{0}} {A : Set.Iio i → Set X} (hAOpen : ∀ j, IsOpen (A j))
    (j : Set.Iio k) : IsOpen (extendDifferenceFamily k A j)
proof:
:= by
  apply isOpen_iUnion
  intro a
  split_ifs
  · exact hAOpen a
  · exact isOpen_empty

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.difference_extendDifferenceFamily
statement:
theorem difference_extendDifferenceFamily {X : Type u} {i k : Ordinal.{0}}
    (hik : i ≤ k) (hParity : ordinalParity i = ordinalParity k)
    (A : Set.Iio i → Set X) :
    difference k (extendDifferenceFamily k A) = difference i A
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rw [mem_difference]
    rintro ⟨j, hjParity, hxj, hjLeast⟩
    obtain ⟨a, haj, hxa⟩ := mem_extendDifferenceFamily.1 hxj
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmin⟩ :=
      wellFounded_lt.has_min {b : Set.Iio i | x ∈ A b} ⟨a, hxa⟩
    have hma : m.1 ≤ a.1 := le_of_not_gt (hmin a hxa)
    have hmj : m.1 ≤ j.1 := hma.trans haj
    have hjm : j.1 ≤ m.1 := by
      apply le_of_not_gt
      intro hmjlt
      have hmk : m.1 < k := m.2.trans_le hik
      let m' : Set.Iio k := ⟨m.1, hmk⟩
      have hm'j : m' < j := hmjlt
      have hxm' : x ∈ extendDifferenceFamily k A m' :=
        mem_extendDifferenceFamily.2 ⟨m, le_rfl, hm⟩
      exact (hjLeast ⟨m'.1, hm'j⟩) hxm'
    have hjEq : j.1 = m.1 := le_antisymm hjm hmj
    rw [mem_difference]
    refine ⟨m, ?_, hm, ?_⟩
    · simpa [hjEq, hParity] using hjParity
    · intro b hxb
      let b' : Set.Iio i :=
        ⟨b.1, (show b.1 < m.1 from b.2).trans (show m.1 < i from m.2)⟩
      exact hmin b' hxb b.2
  · rw [mem_difference]
    rintro ⟨m, hmParity, hm, hmLeast⟩
    have hmk : m.1 < k := m.2.trans_le hik
    let m' : Set.Iio k := ⟨m.1, hmk⟩
    rw [mem_difference]
    refine ⟨m', ?_, mem_extendDifferenceFamily.2 ⟨m, le_rfl, hm⟩, ?_⟩
    · simpa [m', hParity] using hmParity
    · intro j hxj
      obtain ⟨a, haj, hxa⟩ := mem_extendDifferenceFamily.1 hxj
      have ham : a.1 < m.1 := haj.trans_lt j.2
      exact hmLeast ⟨a.1, ham⟩ (by simpa using hxa)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.HausdorffDifference.mono
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hik with rfl | hik'
  · exact hs
  · have hsSucc := HausdorffDifference.mono_add_one hs
    obtain ⟨hi, _, A, _, hAOpen, hAs⟩ := hs
    by_cases hParity : ordinalParity i = ordinalParity k
    · refine ⟨hi.trans_le hik, ?_, extendDifferenceFamily k A,
        monotone_extendDifferenceFamily A, isOpen_extendDifferenceFamily hAOpen, ?_⟩
      · exact hk
      · rw [difference_extendDifferenceFamily hik hParity, hAs]
    · have hiSuccLe : i + 1 ≤ k := Order.add_one_le_iff.2 hik'
      have hParitySucc : ordinalParity (i + 1) = ordinalParity k := by
        rw [ordinalParity_add_one]
        cases hiParity : ordinalParity i <;> cases hkParity : ordinalParity k <;>
          simp [hiParity, hkParity] at hParity ⊢
      obtain ⟨_, _, B, _, hBOpen, hBs⟩ := hsSucc
      refine ⟨hi.trans_le hik, hk,
        extendDifferenceFamily k B, monotone_extendDifferenceFamily B,
        isOpen_extendDifferenceFamily hBOpen, ?_⟩
      rw [difference_extendDifferenceFamily hiSuccLe hParitySucc, hBs]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ordinalSigma0_two_empty
statement:
private theorem ordinalSigma0_two_empty {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [PerfectlyNormalSpace X] : OrdinalSigma0 2 (∅ : Set X)
proof:
:=
  ordinalSigma0_of_isClopen (by norm_num) isOpen_empty isClosed_empty

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ordinalSigma0_two_of_isClosed
statement:
private theorem ordinalSigma0_two_of_isClosed {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {s : Set X} (hs : IsClosed s) : OrdinalSigma0 2 s
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordinalSigma0_two_iff_eq_iUnion_isClosed]
  refine ⟨fun _ => s, fun _ => hs, ?_⟩
  ext x
  simp

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.OrdinalSigma0.iUnion_countable
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := Countable.exists_injective_nat ι
  let g : ℕ → Set X := fun n => ⋃ a : ι, ⋃ (_ : e a = n), s a
  have hg : ∀ n, OrdinalSigma0 2 (g n) := by
    intro n
    by_cases hn : ∃ a, e a = n
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hn
      have hga : g n = s a := by
        ext x
        simp only [g, Set.mem_iUnion]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨b, hb, hxb⟩
          have hba : b = a := he (hb.trans ha.symm)
          simpa [hba] using hxb
        · intro hxa
          exact ⟨a, ha, hxa⟩
      rw [hga]
      exact hs a
    · have hge : g n = ∅ := by
        ext x
        simp only [g, Set.mem_iUnion]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨a, ha, _⟩
          exact (hn ⟨a, ha⟩).elim
        · intro hx
          simp at hx
      rw [hge]
      exact ordinalSigma0_two_empty
  have hUnion : (⋃ a, s a) = ⋃ n, g n := by
    ext x
    simp only [g, Set.mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, hxa⟩
      exact ⟨e a, a, rfl, hxa⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, a, _, hxa⟩
      exact ⟨a, hxa⟩
  rw [hUnion]
  exact OrdinalSigma0.iUnion hg

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.differenceLayer_ordinalSigma0_two
statement:
private theorem differenceLayer_ordinalSigma0_two {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [PerfectlyNormalSpace X] {i : Ordinal.{0}} (A : Set.Iio i → Set X)
    (hAOpen : ∀ j, IsOpen (A j)) (j : Set.Iio i) :
    OrdinalSigma0 2 (differenceLayer A j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show differenceLayer A j =
      A j ∩ (⋃ k : Set.Iio j.1,
        A ⟨k.1, (show k.1 < j.1 from k.2).trans (show j.1 < i from j.2)⟩)ᶜ by
    simp [differenceLayer, sdiff_eq]]
  apply OrdinalSigma0.inter
  · exact (ordinalSigma0_one_iff.2 (hAOpen j)).mono (by norm_num)
  · apply ordinalSigma0_two_of_isClosed
    exact (isOpen_iUnion fun (k : Set.Iio j.1) => hAOpen
      ⟨k.1, (show k.1 < j.1 from k.2).trans (show j.1 < i from j.2)⟩).isClosed_compl

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.HausdorffDifference.ordinalDelta0_two
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, hic, A, _, hAOpen, rfl⟩ := hs
  letI := countable_Iio_of_isCountableBorelLevel hic
  have hLayer : ∀ j, OrdinalSigma0 2 (differenceLayer A j) :=
    differenceLayer_ordinalSigma0_two A hAOpen
  have hSigma : OrdinalSigma0 2 (difference i A) := by
    rw [difference_eq_iUnion]
    apply OrdinalSigma0.iUnion_countable
    intro j
    split_ifs
    · exact hLayer j
    · exact ordinalSigma0_two_empty
  have hComplSigma : OrdinalSigma0 2 (difference i A)ᶜ := by
    rw [compl_difference]
    apply OrdinalSigma0.union
    · apply ordinalSigma0_two_of_isClosed
      exact (isOpen_iUnion hAOpen).isClosed_compl
    · rw [codifference_eq_iUnion]
      apply OrdinalSigma0.iUnion_countable
      intro j
      split_ifs
      · exact hLayer j
      · exact ordinalSigma0_two_empty
  exact ⟨hSigma, (ordinalSigma0_compl_iff_pi0 2 (difference i A)).1 hComplSigma⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.monotone_appendUnivDifferenceFamily
proof:
:= by
  intro j k hjk
  by_cases hk : k.1 < i
  · have hjkVal : j.1 ≤ k.1 := hjk
    have hj : j.1 < i := hjkVal.trans_lt hk
    simp only [appendUnivDifferenceFamily, dif_pos hj, dif_pos hk]
    exact hA hjkVal
  · simp [appendUnivDifferenceFamily, hk]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isOpen_appendUnivDifferenceFamily
statement:
theorem isOpen_appendUnivDifferenceFamily {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {i : Ordinal.{0}} {A : Set.Iio i → Set X} (hA : ∀ j, IsOpen (A j))
    (j : Set.Iio (i + 1)) : IsOpen (appendUnivDifferenceFamily A j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [appendUnivDifferenceFamily]
  split_ifs
  · exact hA _
  · exact isOpen_univ

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.difference_appendUnivDifferenceFamily
proof:
:= by
  rw [compl_difference]
  ext x
  constructor
  · rw [mem_difference]
    rintro ⟨j, hjParity, hxj, hjLeast⟩
    by_cases hji : j.1 < i
    · right
      refine ⟨⟨j.1, hji⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have hp : ordinalParity j.1 = ordinalParity i := by
          simpa only [ordinalParity_add_one, Bool.ne_not] using hjParity
        exact hp
      · rw [mem_differenceLayer]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa [appendUnivDifferenceFamily, hji] using hxj
        · intro k
          let k' : Set.Iio j.1 := ⟨k.1, k.2⟩
          have hkI : k.1 < i := k.2.trans hji
          have hnot := hjLeast k'
          simpa [appendUnivDifferenceFamily, hkI, k'] using hnot
    · left
      have hjiLe : j.1 ≤ i := Order.lt_add_one_iff.mp j.2
      have hjiEq : j.1 = i := le_antisymm hjiLe (le_of_not_gt hji)
      intro hxUnion
      obtain ⟨k, hxk⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hxUnion
      have hkj : k.1 < j.1 := by
        rw [hjiEq]
        exact k.2
      let k' : Set.Iio j.1 := ⟨k.1, hkj⟩
      have hnot := hjLeast k'
      apply hnot
      change x ∈ if hk : k.1 < i then A ⟨k.1, hk⟩ else Set.univ
      simp only [dif_pos (show k.1 < i from k.2)]
      exact hxk
  · rintro (hxOutside | hxCo)
    · rw [mem_difference]
      let j : Set.Iio (i + 1) := ⟨i, Order.lt_succ i⟩
      refine ⟨j, by simp [j], ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [appendUnivDifferenceFamily, j]
      · intro k hxk
        have hki : k.1 < i := by
          have hk := k.2
          change k.1 < j.1 at hk
          simpa only [j] using hk
        have hxA : x ∈ A ⟨k.1, hki⟩ := by
          simpa [appendUnivDifferenceFamily, hki] using hxk
        exact hxOutside (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨k.1, hki⟩, hxA⟩)
    · obtain ⟨j, hjParity, hxj⟩ := hxCo
      rw [mem_differenceLayer] at hxj
      rw [mem_difference]
      let j' : Set.Iio (i + 1) := ⟨j.1, j.2.trans (Order.lt_succ i)⟩
      refine ⟨j', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [j', hjParity]
      · change x ∈ if hj : j.1 < i then A ⟨j.1, hj⟩ else Set.univ
        split
        · exact hxj.1
        · rename_i h
          exact (h j.2).elim
      · intro k
        let k' : Set.Iio j.1 := ⟨k.1, k.2⟩
        have hki : k.1 < i := k.2.trans j.2
        have hnot := hxj.2 k'
        simpa [appendUnivDifferenceFamily, hki, j', k'] using hnot

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.HausdorffDifference.compl_add_one
statement:
theorem HausdorffDifference.compl_add_one {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {i : Ordinal.{0}} {s : Set X} (hs : HausdorffDifference i s) :
    HausdorffDifference (i + 1) sᶜ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hi, hic, A, hA, hAOpen, hAs⟩ := hs
  refine ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt bot_le (Order.lt_succ i),
    Cardinal.isSuccLimit_omega 1 |>.add_one_lt hic,
    appendUnivDifferenceFamily A,
    monotone_appendUnivDifferenceFamily hA,
    isOpen_appendUnivDifferenceFamily hAOpen, ?_⟩
  rw [difference_appendUnivDifferenceFamily, hAs]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.HausdorffDifference.atMost
statement:
theorem HausdorffDifference.atMost {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {i : Ordinal.{0}} {s : Set X} (hs : HausdorffDifference i s) :
    HausdorffDifferenceAtMost i s
proof:
:=
  ⟨i, le_rfl, hs⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.HausdorffDifferenceAtMost.mono
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hji, hj⟩ := hs
  exact ⟨j, hji.trans hik, hj⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.HausdorffDifferenceAtMost.ordinalDelta0_two
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, hj⟩ := hs
  exact hj.ordinalDelta0_two

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.HausdorffDifference.measurableSet
proof:
:=
  hs.ordinalDelta0_two.measurableSet

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ordinalParity_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem ordinalParity_zero : ordinalParity 0 = false
proof:
:= by
  simp [ordinalParity]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ordinalParity_add_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem ordinalParity_add_one (i : Ordinal.{0}) :
    ordinalParity (i + 1) = !ordinalParity i
proof:
:= by
  simp [ordinalParity]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ordinalParity_one
statement: @[simp] theorem ordinalParity_one : ordinalParity 1 = true
proof:
:= by
  simpa using ordinalParity_add_one 0

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ordinalParity_two
statement: @[simp] theorem ordinalParity_two : ordinalParity 2 = false
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ordinalParity 2 = ordinalParity (1 + 1) := by norm_num
    _ = !ordinalParity 1 := ordinalParity_add_one 1
    _ = false := by simp

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ordinalParity_three
statement: @[simp] theorem ordinalParity_three : ordinalParity 3 = true
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ordinalParity 3 = ordinalParity (2 + 1) := by norm_num
    _ = !ordinalParity 2 := ordinalParity_add_one 2
    _ = true := by simp

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ordinalParity_of_isSuccLimit
statement:
theorem ordinalParity_of_isSuccLimit {i : Ordinal.{0}} (hi : Order.IsSuccLimit i) :
    ordinalParity i = false
proof:
:= by
  simp [ordinalParity, hi]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ordinalParity_two_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem ordinalParity_two_mul (i : Ordinal.{0}) :
    ordinalParity (2 * i) = false
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Ordinal.limitRecOn with
  | zero => simp
  | add_one i ih =>
      rw [mul_add_one]
      nth_rw 2 [show (2 : Ordinal) = 1 + 1 by norm_num]
      rw [← add_assoc]
      rw [ordinalParity_add_one, ordinalParity_add_one, ih]
      simp
  | limit i hi ih =>
      exact ordinalParity_of_isSuccLimit
        (Ordinal.isSuccLimit_mul_right (by norm_num) hi)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ordinalParity_two_mul_add_one
statement:
theorem ordinalParity_two_mul_add_one (i : Ordinal.{0}) :
    ordinalParity (2 * i + 1) = true
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_differenceLayer
statement:
theorem mem_differenceLayer {X : Type u} {i : Ordinal.{0}} {A : Set.Iio i → Set X}
    {j : Set.Iio i} {x : X} :
    x ∈ differenceLayer A j ↔
      x ∈ A j ∧ ∀ k : Set.Iio j.1,
        x ∉ A ⟨k.1, (show k.1 < j.1 from k.2).trans (show j.1 < i from j.2)⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [differenceLayer]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_difference
statement:
theorem mem_difference {X : Type u} {i : Ordinal.{0}} {A : Set.Iio i → Set X} {x : X} :
    x ∈ difference i A ↔ ∃ j : Set.Iio i,
      ordinalParity j.1 ≠ ordinalParity i ∧
        x ∈ A j ∧ ∀ k : Set.Iio j.1,
          x ∉ A ⟨k.1, (show k.1 < j.1 from k.2).trans (show j.1 < i from j.2)⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [difference, mem_differenceLayer]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.difference_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem difference_zero {X : Type u} (A : Set.Iio (0 : Ordinal) → Set X) :
    difference 0 A = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [mem_difference]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.difference_one
statement:
theorem difference_one {X : Type u} (A : Set.Iio (1 : Ordinal) → Set X) :
    difference 1 A = A ⟨0, by norm_num⟩
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rw [mem_difference]
    rintro ⟨j, _, hjA, _⟩
    have hj0 : j.1 = 0 := Order.lt_one_iff.mp j.2
    have hj : j = (⟨0, by norm_num⟩ : Set.Iio (1 : Ordinal)) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hj0
    simpa [hj] using hjA
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_difference]
    refine ⟨⟨0, by norm_num⟩, by simp, hx, ?_⟩
    intro k
    have hk : k.1 < (0 : Ordinal) := k.2
    exact (not_lt_zero hk).elim

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.difference_two
statement:
theorem difference_two {X : Type u} (A : Set.Iio (2 : Ordinal) → Set X) :
    difference 2 A =
      A ⟨1, by norm_num⟩ \ A ⟨0, by norm_num⟩
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rw [mem_difference]
    rintro ⟨j, hjParity, hjA, hjLeast⟩
    have hjle : j.1 ≤ (1 : Ordinal) := by
      have hjlt : j.1 < (1 : Ordinal) + 1 := by
        rw [show (1 : Ordinal) + 1 = 2 by norm_num]
        exact j.2
      exact Order.lt_add_one_iff.mp hjlt
    have hj1 : j.1 = 1 := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hjle with hj1 | hjlt
      · exact hj1
      · have hj0 : j.1 = 0 := Order.lt_one_iff.mp hjlt
        have hparity : ordinalParity j.1 = ordinalParity 2 := by simp [hj0]
        exact (hjParity hparity).elim
    have hj : j = (⟨1, by norm_num⟩ : Set.Iio (2 : Ordinal)) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hj1
    refine ⟨by simpa [hj] using hjA, ?_⟩
    have h0j : (0 : Ordinal) < j.1 := by rw [hj1]; norm_num
    have hleast := hjLeast ⟨0, h0j⟩
    simpa [hj] using hleast
  · rintro ⟨hx1, hx0⟩
    rw [mem_difference]
    refine ⟨⟨1, by norm_num⟩, by simp, hx1, ?_⟩
    intro k
    have hk0 : k.1 = 0 := Order.lt_one_iff.mp k.2
    have hk : k = (⟨0, by norm_num⟩ : Set.Iio (1 : Ordinal)) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hk0
    simpa [hk] using hx0

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.difference_three
statement:
theorem difference_three {X : Type u} (A : Set.Iio (3 : Ordinal) → Set X)
    (hA : Monotone A) :
    difference 3 A =
      A ⟨0, by norm_num⟩ ∪
        (A ⟨2, by change (2 : Ordinal) < 2 + 1; exact Order.lt_succ 2⟩ \
          A ⟨1, by norm_num⟩)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rw [mem_difference]
    rintro ⟨j, hjParity, hjA, hjLeast⟩
    have hjle : j.1 ≤ (2 : Ordinal) := by
      have hjlt : j.1 < (2 : Ordinal) + 1 := by
        rw [show (2 : Ordinal) + 1 = 3 by norm_num]
        exact j.2
      exact Order.lt_add_one_iff.mp hjlt
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hjle with hj2 | hjlt2
    · right
      have hj : j =
          (⟨2, by change (2 : Ordinal) < 2 + 1; exact Order.lt_succ 2⟩ :
            Set.Iio (3 : Ordinal)) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hj2
      refine ⟨by simpa [hj] using hjA, ?_⟩
      have h1j : (1 : Ordinal) < j.1 := by rw [hj2]; norm_num
      have hleast := hjLeast ⟨1, h1j⟩
      simpa [hj] using hleast
    · have hjlt2' : j.1 < (1 : Ordinal) + 1 := by
        rw [show (1 : Ordinal) + 1 = 2 by norm_num]
        exact hjlt2
      have hjle1 : j.1 ≤ (1 : Ordinal) := Order.lt_add_one_iff.mp hjlt2'
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hjle1 with hj1 | hjlt1
      · have hparity : ordinalParity j.1 = ordinalParity 3 := by simp [hj1]
        exact (hjParity hparity).elim
      · left
        have hj0 : j.1 = 0 := Order.lt_one_iff.mp hjlt1
        have hj : j = (⟨0, by norm_num⟩ : Set.Iio (3 : Ordinal)) := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          exact hj0
        simpa [hj] using hjA
  · rintro (hx0 | ⟨hx2, hx1⟩)
    · rw [mem_difference]
      refine ⟨⟨0, by norm_num⟩, by simp, hx0, ?_⟩
      intro k
      have hk : k.1 < (0 : Ordinal) := k.2
      exact (not_lt_zero hk).elim
    · rw [mem_difference]
      refine ⟨⟨2, by change (2 : Ordinal) < 2 + 1; exact Order.lt_succ 2⟩,
        by simp, hx2, ?_⟩
      intro k
      have hklt : k.1 < (1 : Ordinal) + 1 := by
        rw [show (1 : Ordinal) + 1 = 2 by norm_num]
        exact k.2
      have hkle : k.1 ≤ (1 : Ordinal) := Order.lt_add_one_iff.mp hklt
      exact fun hk => hx1 (hA hkle hk)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_difference_add_one
statement:
theorem mem_difference_add_one {X : Type u} {i : Ordinal.{0}}
    {A : Set.Iio (i + 1) → Set X} {x : X} :
    x ∈ difference (i + 1) A ↔ ∃ j : Set.Iio (i + 1),
      ordinalParity j.1 = ordinalParity i ∧
        x ∈ A j ∧ ∀ k : Set.Iio j.1,
          x ∉ A ⟨k.1, (show k.1 < j.1 from k.2).trans (show j.1 < i + 1 from j.2)⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_difference]
  simp only [ordinalParity_add_one, Bool.ne_not]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_difference_of_isSuccLimit
statement:
theorem mem_difference_of_isSuccLimit {X : Type u} {i : Ordinal.{0}}
    (hi : Order.IsSuccLimit i) {A : Set.Iio i → Set X} {x : X} :
    x ∈ difference i A ↔ ∃ j : Set.Iio i,
      ordinalParity j.1 = true ∧
        x ∈ A j ∧ ∀ k : Set.Iio j.1,
          x ∉ A ⟨k.1, (show k.1 < j.1 from k.2).trans (show j.1 < i from j.2)⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_difference, ordinalParity_of_isSuccLimit hi]
  simp only [Bool.not_eq_false]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.HausdorffDifference.index_pos
statement:
theorem HausdorffDifference.index_pos {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {i : Ordinal.{0}} {s : Set X} (hs : HausdorffDifference i s) : 0 < i

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.HausdorffDifference.index_countable
statement:
theorem HausdorffDifference.index_countable {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {i : Ordinal.{0}} {s : Set X} (hs : HausdorffDifference i s) :
    IsCountableBorelLevel i

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.HausdorffDifference.exists_open_family
statement:
theorem HausdorffDifference.exists_open_family {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {i : Ordinal.{0}} {s : Set X} (hs : HausdorffDifference i s) :
    ∃ A : Set.Iio i → Set X, Monotone A ∧ (∀ j, IsOpen (A j)) ∧ difference i A = s

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.hausdorffDerivative_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem hausdorffDerivative_zero {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] (s : Set X) :
    hausdorffDerivative s 0 = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  simp [hausdorffDerivative]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.hausdorffDerivative_add_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem hausdorffDerivative_add_one {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (s : Set X) (i : Ordinal.{0}) :
    hausdorffDerivative s (i + 1) =
      closure (hausdorffDerivative s i ∩ s) ∩
        closure (hausdorffDerivative s i ∩ sᶜ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [hausdorffDerivative]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.hausdorffDerivative_of_isSuccLimit
statement:
theorem hausdorffDerivative_of_isSuccLimit {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (s : Set X) {i : Ordinal.{0}} (hi : Order.IsSuccLimit i) :
    hausdorffDerivative s i = ⋂ j : Set.Iio i, hausdorffDerivative s j.1
proof:
:= by
  simp [hausdorffDerivative, hi]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isClosed_hausdorffDerivative
statement:
theorem isClosed_hausdorffDerivative {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (s : Set X) (i : Ordinal.{0}) : IsClosed (hausdorffDerivative s i)
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Ordinal.limitRecOn with
  | zero => simp
  | add_one i ih =>
      rw [hausdorffDerivative_add_one]
      exact isClosed_closure.inter isClosed_closure
  | limit i hi ih =>
      rw [hausdorffDerivative_of_isSuccLimit s hi]
      exact isClosed_iInter fun j => ih j.1 j.2

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.hausdorffDerivative_add_one_subset
statement:
theorem hausdorffDerivative_add_one_subset {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (s : Set X) (i : Ordinal.{0}) :
    hausdorffDerivative s (i + 1) ⊆ hausdorffDerivative s i
proof:
:= by
  rw [hausdorffDerivative_add_one]
  exact (inter_subset_left.trans
    (closure_minimal inter_subset_left (isClosed_hausdorffDerivative s i)))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.antitone_hausdorffDerivative
statement:
theorem antitone_hausdorffDerivative {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (s : Set X) : Antitone (hausdorffDerivative s)
proof:
:= by
  intro i k hik x hx
  induction k using WellFoundedLT.induction generalizing i x with
  | ind k ih =>
      rcases Ordinal.zero_or_succ_or_isSuccLimit k with rfl | hsucc | hlim
      · have hi : i = 0 := bot_unique hik
        subst i
        exact hx
      · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hsucc
        change i ≤ j + 1 at hik
        change x ∈ hausdorffDerivative s (j + 1) at hx
        by_cases hij : i ≤ j
        · exact ih j (Order.lt_succ j) hij
            (hausdorffDerivative_add_one_subset s j hx)
        · have hji : j < i := lt_of_not_ge hij
          have hjiSucc : j + 1 ≤ i := Order.add_one_le_iff.2 hji
          have hi : i = j + 1 := le_antisymm hik hjiSucc
          subst i
          exact hx
      · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hik with rfl | hik'
        · exact hx
        · rw [hausdorffDerivative_of_isSuccLimit s hlim] at hx
          exact Set.mem_iInter.1 hx ⟨i, hik'⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.not_countable_Iio_omega_one
statement: theorem not_countable_Iio_omega_one : ¬Countable (Set.Iio (ω₁ : Ordinal))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hm : #(Set.Iio (ω₁ : Ordinal)) ≤ ℵ₀ := Cardinal.mk_le_aleph0_iff.mpr h
  rw [Cardinal.mk_Iio_ordinal, Ordinal.card_omega] at hm
  exact Cardinal.aleph0_lt_aleph_one.2 (Cardinal.lift_le_aleph0.mp hm)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_eq_add_one_of_antitone_isClosed
statement:
theorem exists_eq_add_one_of_antitone_isClosed {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] (H : Ordinal.{0} → Set X) (hH : Antitone H)
    (hClosed : ∀ i, IsClosed (H i)) :
    ∃ i : Ordinal.{0}, i < ω₁ ∧ H i = H (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Drop := {i : Set.Iio (ω₁ : Ordinal) // H i.1 ≠ H (i.1 + 1)}
  have hdrop (d : Drop) : ∃ x, x ∈ H d.1.1 ∧ x ∉ H (d.1.1 + 1) := by
    have hsub : H (d.1.1 + 1) ⊆ H d.1.1 := hH (Order.le_succ d.1.1)
    have hnsub : ¬H d.1.1 ⊆ H (d.1.1 + 1) := by
      intro hreverse
      exact d.2 (Subset.antisymm hreverse hsub)
    exact Set.not_subset.1 hnsub
  choose x hxH hxNot using hdrop
  have hBasis (d : Drop) :
      ∃ U ∈ countableBasis X, x d ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ (H (d.1.1 + 1))ᶜ := by
    exact (isBasis_countableBasis X).exists_subset_of_mem_open (hxNot d)
      (hClosed (d.1.1 + 1)).isOpen_compl
  choose U hU_basis hxU hU_sub using hBasis
  let code : Drop → countableBasis X := fun d => ⟨U d, hU_basis d⟩
  have hcode : Function.Injective code := by
    intro d e hde
    by_contra hne
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (fun h => hne (Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext h))) with hlt | hgt
    · have hSuccLe : d.1.1 + 1 ≤ e.1.1 := Order.add_one_le_iff.2 hlt
      have hxeH : x e ∈ H (d.1.1 + 1) := hH hSuccLe (hxH e)
      have hxeNotU : x e ∉ U d := fun hmem => (hU_sub d hmem) hxeH
      have hUeq : U d = U e := congrArg Subtype.val hde
      exact hxeNotU (hUeq ▸ hxU e)
    · have hSuccLe : e.1.1 + 1 ≤ d.1.1 := Order.add_one_le_iff.2 hgt
      have hxdH : x d ∈ H (e.1.1 + 1) := hH hSuccLe (hxH d)
      have hxdNotU : x d ∉ U e := fun hmem => (hU_sub e hmem) hxdH
      have hUeq : U d = U e := congrArg Subtype.val hde
      exact hxdNotU (hUeq.symm ▸ hxU d)
  letI : Countable Drop := hcode.countable
  by_contra hnone
  push Not at hnone
  have hAllDrop : Function.Injective
      (fun i : Set.Iio (ω₁ : Ordinal) =>
        (⟨i, hnone i.1 i.2⟩ : Drop)) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun d : Drop => d.1.1) hij)
  exact not_countable_Iio_omega_one hAllDrop.countable

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_hausdorffDerivative_eq_add_one
statement:
theorem exists_hausdorffDerivative_eq_add_one {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] (s : Set X) :
    ∃ i : Ordinal.{0}, i < ω₁ ∧
      hausdorffDerivative s i = hausdorffDerivative s (i + 1)
proof:
:=
  exists_eq_add_one_of_antitone_isClosed (hausdorffDerivative s)
    (antitone_hausdorffDerivative s) (isClosed_hausdorffDerivative s)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.hausdorffDerivative_eq_empty_of_eq_add_one
statement:
theorem hausdorffDerivative_eq_empty_of_eq_add_one {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [PolishSpace X] {s : Set X} (hs : OrdinalDelta0 2 s) {i : Ordinal.{0}}
    (hfix : hausdorffDerivative s i = hausdorffDerivative s (i + 1)) :
    hausdorffDerivative s i = ∅
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H : Set X := hausdorffDerivative s i
  have hHClosed : IsClosed H := isClosed_hausdorffDerivative s i
  by_contra hne
  have hHNonempty : H.Nonempty := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 hne
  letI : Nonempty H := ⟨⟨hHNonempty.choose, hHNonempty.choose_spec⟩⟩
  letI : IsCompletelyMetrizableSpace H := hHClosed.isCompletelyMetrizableSpace
  let S : Set H := {x | x.1 ∈ s}
  let C : Set H := {x | x.1 ∈ sᶜ}
  have hHSubS : H ⊆ closure (H ∩ s) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ hausdorffDerivative s (i + 1) := hfix ▸ hx
    rw [hausdorffDerivative_add_one] at hx'
    exact hx'.1
  have hHSubC : H ⊆ closure (H ∩ sᶜ) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ hausdorffDerivative s (i + 1) := hfix ▸ hx
    rw [hausdorffDerivative_add_one] at hx'
    exact hx'.2
  have hvalS : ((fun x : H => x.1) '' S : Set X) = H ∩ s := by
    ext x
    simp [H, S, and_comm]
  have hvalC : ((fun x : H => x.1) '' C : Set X) = H ∩ sᶜ := by
    ext x
    simp [H, C, and_comm]
  have hSDense : Dense S := by
    rw [Subtype.dense_iff, hvalS]
    exact hHSubS
  have hCDense : Dense C := by
    rw [Subtype.dense_iff, hvalC]
    exact hHSubC
  obtain ⟨F, hFClosed, hFs⟩ := ordinalSigma0_two_iff_eq_iUnion_isClosed.1 hs.1
  have hsCompl : OrdinalSigma0 2 sᶜ := (ordinalSigma0_compl_iff_pi0 2 s).2 hs.2
  obtain ⟨G, hGClosed, hGs⟩ := ordinalSigma0_two_iff_eq_iUnion_isClosed.1 hsCompl
  let pieces : ℕ ⊕ ℕ → Set H
    | Sum.inl n => (fun x : H => x.1) ⁻¹' F n
    | Sum.inr n => (fun x : H => x.1) ⁻¹' G n
  have hPiecesClosed : ∀ q, IsClosed (pieces q) := by
    rintro (n | n)
    · exact (hFClosed n).preimage continuous_subtype_val
    · exact (hGClosed n).preimage continuous_subtype_val
  have hPiecesCover : ⋃ q, pieces q = Set.univ := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
    by_cases hxs : x.1 ∈ s
    · rw [hFs] at hxs
      obtain ⟨n, hxn⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hxs
      exact ⟨Sum.inl n, hxn⟩
    · have hxc : x.1 ∈ sᶜ := hxs
      rw [hGs] at hxc
      obtain ⟨n, hxn⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hxc
      exact ⟨Sum.inr n, hxn⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := nonempty_interior_of_iUnion_of_closed hPiecesClosed hPiecesCover
  rcases q with n | n
  · obtain ⟨x, hxC, hxInterior⟩ := hCDense.exists_mem_open isOpen_interior hq
    have hxPiece : x ∈ pieces (Sum.inl n) := interior_subset hxInterior
    have hxF : x.1 ∈ F n := by
      change x.1 ∈ F n at hxPiece
      exact hxPiece
    have hxS : x.1 ∈ s := by
      rw [hFs]
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨n, hxF⟩
    exact hxC hxS
  · obtain ⟨x, hxS, hxInterior⟩ := hSDense.exists_mem_open isOpen_interior hq
    have hxPiece : x ∈ pieces (Sum.inr n) := interior_subset hxInterior
    have hxG : x.1 ∈ G n := by
      change x.1 ∈ G n at hxPiece
      exact hxPiece
    have hxC : x.1 ∈ sᶜ := by
      rw [hGs]
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨n, hxG⟩
    exact hxC hxS

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_hausdorffDerivative_eq_empty
statement:
theorem exists_hausdorffDerivative_eq_empty {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [PolishSpace X] {s : Set X} (hs : OrdinalDelta0 2 s) :
    ∃ i : Ordinal.{0}, i < ω₁ ∧ hausdorffDerivative s i = ∅
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hfix⟩ := exists_hausdorffDerivative_eq_add_one s
  exact ⟨i, hi, hausdorffDerivative_eq_empty_of_eq_add_one hs hfix⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.mem_hausdorffDifferenceFamily
statement:
theorem mem_hausdorffDifferenceFamily {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {s : Set X} {i : Ordinal.{0}} {j : Set.Iio (2 * i)} {x : X} :
    x ∈ hausdorffDifferenceFamily s i j ↔
      (∃ q : Set.Iio i, 2 * q.1 ≤ j.1 ∧ x ∈ hausdorffEvenStage s q.1) ∨
      ∃ q : Set.Iio i, 2 * q.1 + 1 ≤ j.1 ∧ x ∈ hausdorffOddStage s q.1
proof:
:= by
  simp [hausdorffDifferenceFamily]

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.monotone_hausdorffDifferenceFamily
statement:
theorem monotone_hausdorffDifferenceFamily {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (s : Set X) (i : Ordinal.{0}) : Monotone (hausdorffDifferenceFamily s i)
proof:
:= by
  intro j k hjk x hx
  rcases mem_hausdorffDifferenceFamily.1 hx with ⟨q, hqj, hxq⟩ | ⟨q, hqj, hxq⟩
  · exact mem_hausdorffDifferenceFamily.2 <| Or.inl ⟨q, hqj.trans hjk, hxq⟩
  · exact mem_hausdorffDifferenceFamily.2 <| Or.inr ⟨q, hqj.trans hjk, hxq⟩

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.isOpen_hausdorffDifferenceFamily
statement:
theorem isOpen_hausdorffDifferenceFamily {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (s : Set X) (i : Ordinal.{0}) (j : Set.Iio (2 * i)) :
    IsOpen (hausdorffDifferenceFamily s i j)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpen.union
  · apply isOpen_iUnion
    intro q
    split_ifs
    · exact isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl
    · exact isOpen_empty
  · apply isOpen_iUnion
    intro q
    split_ifs
    · exact (isClosed_hausdorffDerivative s (q.1 + 1)).isOpen_compl
    · exact isOpen_empty

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_hausdorffDerivative_exit
statement:
theorem exists_hausdorffDerivative_exit {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {s : Set X} {i : Ordinal.{0}} {x : X} (hx : x ∉ hausdorffDerivative s i) :
    ∃ q : Ordinal.{0}, q < i ∧ x ∈ hausdorffDerivative s q ∧
      x ∉ hausdorffDerivative s (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hmin⟩ :=
    wellFounded_lt.has_min {j : Ordinal.{0} | x ∉ hausdorffDerivative s j} ⟨i, hx⟩
  have hdi : d ≤ i := le_of_not_gt (hmin i hx)
  rcases Ordinal.zero_or_succ_or_isSuccLimit d with rfl | ⟨q, rfl⟩ | hdlim
  · simp at hd
  · have hqMem : x ∈ hausdorffDerivative s q := by
      by_contra hq
      exact hmin q hq (Order.lt_succ q)
    exact ⟨q, (Order.lt_succ q).trans_le hdi, hqMem, hd⟩
  · change x ∉ hausdorffDerivative s d at hd
    rw [hausdorffDerivative_of_isSuccLimit s hdlim] at hd
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter] at hd
    push Not at hd
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hd
    exact (hmin j.1 hj j.2).elim

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.two_mul_lt_two_mul
statement:
private theorem two_mul_lt_two_mul {q r : Ordinal.{0}} (hqr : q < r) :
    2 * q < 2 * r
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hqr (by norm_num)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.two_mul_add_one_lt_two_mul_add_one_iff
statement:
private theorem two_mul_add_one_lt_two_mul_add_one_iff (q r : Ordinal.{0}) :
    2 * q + 1 < 2 * r + 1 ↔ q < r
proof:
:= by
  change Order.succ (2 * q) < Order.succ (2 * r) ↔ q < r
  rw [Order.succ_lt_succ_iff]
  exact (mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ (by norm_num : (0 : Ordinal) < 2))

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.le_of_two_mul_lt_two_mul_add_one
statement:
private theorem le_of_two_mul_lt_two_mul_add_one {q r : Ordinal.{0}}
    (h : 2 * q < 2 * r + 1) : q ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_not_gt
  intro hrq
  have hmul : 2 * r < 2 * q := two_mul_lt_two_mul hrq
  have hle : 2 * r + 1 ≤ 2 * q := Order.add_one_le_iff.2 hmul
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hle) h

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.two_mul_add_one_lt
statement:
private theorem two_mul_add_one_lt {q i : Ordinal.{0}} (hqi : q < i) :
    2 * q + 1 < 2 * i
proof:
:= by
  have hqSucc : q + 1 ≤ i := Order.add_one_le_iff.2 hqi
  have hstage : 2 * q + 1 < 2 * (q + 1) := by
    rw [mul_add_one]
    exact (add_lt_add_iff_left (2 * q)).2 (by norm_num)
  exact hstage.trans_le (mul_le_mul_right hqSucc 2)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.two_mul_lt_omega_one
statement:
private theorem two_mul_lt_omega_one {i : Ordinal.{0}} (hi : i < ω₁) :
    2 * i < ω₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cardinal.lt_omega_iff_card_lt, Ordinal.card_mul,
    Cardinal.lt_aleph_one_iff]
  have hi' : i.card ≤ ℵ₀ :=
    Cardinal.lt_aleph_one_iff.mp (Cardinal.lt_omega_iff_card_lt.mp hi)
  calc
    (2 : Ordinal).card * i.card ≤ ℵ₀ * ℵ₀ :=
      mul_le_mul' (by simp) hi'
    _ = ℵ₀ := Cardinal.aleph0_mul_aleph0

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.difference_hausdorffDifferenceFamily
statement:
theorem difference_hausdorffDifferenceFamily {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {s : Set X} {i : Ordinal.{0}} (hi : hausdorffDerivative s i = ∅) :
    difference (2 * i) (hausdorffDifferenceFamily s i) = s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_difference] at hx
    obtain ⟨j, hjParity, hxj, hjLeast⟩ := hx
    rcases mem_hausdorffDifferenceFamily.1 hxj with
      ⟨q, hqj, hxEven⟩ | ⟨q, hqj, hxOdd⟩
    · have hjStage : j.1 ≤ 2 * q.1 := by
        apply le_of_not_gt
        intro hstagej
        let k : Set.Iio j.1 := ⟨2 * q.1, hstagej⟩
        have hxk : x ∈ hausdorffDifferenceFamily s i
            ⟨k.1, (show k.1 < j.1 from k.2).trans
              (show j.1 < 2 * i from j.2)⟩ :=
          mem_hausdorffDifferenceFamily.2 <| Or.inl ⟨q, le_rfl, hxEven⟩
        exact (hjLeast k) (by simpa [k] using hxk)
      have hjEq : j.1 = 2 * q.1 := le_antisymm hjStage hqj
      have hsame : ordinalParity j.1 = ordinalParity (2 * i) := by
        simp [hjEq]
      exact (hjParity hsame).elim
    · have hjStage : j.1 ≤ 2 * q.1 + 1 := by
        apply le_of_not_gt
        intro hstagej
        let k : Set.Iio j.1 := ⟨2 * q.1 + 1, hstagej⟩
        have hxk : x ∈ hausdorffDifferenceFamily s i
            ⟨k.1, (show k.1 < j.1 from k.2).trans
              (show j.1 < 2 * i from j.2)⟩ :=
          mem_hausdorffDifferenceFamily.2 <| Or.inr ⟨q, le_rfl, hxOdd⟩
        exact (hjLeast k) (by simpa [k] using hxk)
      have hjEq : j.1 = 2 * q.1 + 1 := le_antisymm hjStage hqj
      have hevenLt : 2 * q.1 < j.1 := by
        rw [hjEq]
        exact Order.lt_succ (2 * q.1)
      let k : Set.Iio j.1 := ⟨2 * q.1, hevenLt⟩
      have hxNotEvenFamily := hjLeast k
      have hxNotEven : x ∉ hausdorffEvenStage s q.1 := by
        intro hxEven
        apply hxNotEvenFamily
        exact mem_hausdorffDifferenceFamily.2 <| Or.inl ⟨q, le_rfl, hxEven⟩
      have hxClosure : x ∈ closure (hausdorffDerivative s q.1 ∩ s) := by
        simpa [hausdorffEvenStage] using hxNotEven
      have hxNotSucc : x ∉ hausdorffDerivative s (q.1 + 1) := by
        simpa [hausdorffOddStage] using hxOdd
      by_contra hxs
      have hxH : x ∈ hausdorffDerivative s q.1 :=
        closure_minimal inter_subset_left
          (isClosed_hausdorffDerivative s q.1) hxClosure
      have hxComplClosure :
          x ∈ closure (hausdorffDerivative s q.1 ∩ sᶜ) :=
        subset_closure ⟨hxH, hxs⟩
      apply hxNotSucc
      rw [hausdorffDerivative_add_one]
      exact ⟨hxClosure, hxComplClosure⟩
  · intro hxs
    have hxi : x ∉ hausdorffDerivative s i := by
      rw [hi]
      simp
    obtain ⟨q, hqi, hxH, hxNotSucc⟩ := exists_hausdorffDerivative_exit hxi
    let j : Set.Iio (2 * i) := ⟨2 * q + 1, two_mul_add_one_lt hqi⟩
    rw [mem_difference]
    refine ⟨j, by simp [j], ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact mem_hausdorffDifferenceFamily.2 <|
        Or.inr ⟨⟨q, hqi⟩, le_rfl, by simpa [hausdorffOddStage] using hxNotSucc⟩
    · intro k hxk
      have hkStage : k.1 < 2 * q + 1 := by
        have hk := k.2
        change k.1 < j.1 at hk
        simpa only [j] using hk
      rcases mem_hausdorffDifferenceFamily.1 hxk with
        ⟨r, hrk, hxEven⟩ | ⟨r, hrk, hxOdd⟩
      · have hrq : r.1 ≤ q :=
          le_of_two_mul_lt_two_mul_add_one (hrk.trans_lt hkStage)
        have hxHr : x ∈ hausdorffDerivative s r.1 :=
          antitone_hausdorffDerivative s hrq hxH
        exact hxEven (subset_closure ⟨hxHr, hxs⟩)
      · have hstage : 2 * r.1 + 1 < 2 * q + 1 := hrk.trans_lt hkStage
        have hrq : r.1 < q :=
          (two_mul_add_one_lt_two_mul_add_one_iff r.1 q).1 hstage
        have hrSuccLe : r.1 + 1 ≤ q := Order.add_one_le_iff.2 hrq
        exact hxOdd (antitone_hausdorffDerivative s hrSuccLe hxH)

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.exists_hausdorffDifference_of_ordinalDelta0_two
statement:
theorem exists_hausdorffDifference_of_ordinalDelta0_two
    {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] {s : Set X}
    (hs : OrdinalDelta0 2 s) :
    ∃ i : Ordinal.{0}, HausdorffDifference i s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hiCount, hiEmpty⟩ := exists_hausdorffDerivative_eq_empty hs
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    have hUniv : (Set.univ : Set X) = ∅ := by
      simpa using hiEmpty
    have hsEmpty : s = ∅ := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · intro x hx
        have hxUniv : x ∈ (Set.univ : Set X) := Set.mem_univ x
        rw [hUniv] at hxUniv
        exact hxUniv
      · exact Set.empty_subset s
    let A : Set.Iio (1 : Ordinal) → Set X := fun _ => ∅
    refine ⟨(1 : Ordinal), by norm_num,
      (by simpa using (isCountableBorelLevel_nat 1)), A,
      monotone_const, fun _ => isOpen_empty, ?_⟩
    rw [difference_one]
    simp [A, hsEmpty]
  · have hiPos : 0 < i := pos_iff_ne_zero.2 hi0
    refine ⟨2 * i, mul_pos (by norm_num) hiPos,
      two_mul_lt_omega_one hiCount,
      hausdorffDifferenceFamily s i,
      monotone_hausdorffDifferenceFamily s i,
      isOpen_hausdorffDifferenceFamily s i, ?_⟩
    exact difference_hausdorffDifferenceFamily hiEmpty

name: DescriptiveSetTheory.ordinalDelta0_two_iff_exists_hausdorffDifference
statement:
theorem ordinalDelta0_two_iff_exists_hausdorffDifference
    {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] {s : Set X} :
    OrdinalDelta0 2 s ↔ ∃ i : Ordinal.{0}, HausdorffDifference i s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact exists_hausdorffDifference_of_ordinalDelta0_two
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact hi.ordinalDelta0_two
